title: "Pane level skinning failure"
description: """Pane level skinning is faulty in DNN6.   Pane level skinning is the assignment of a default container for any given content pane. A description of pane level skinning is here: http://www.dotnetnuke.com/Resources/Wiki/Page/Set-default-Container-for-Panes-in-your-Skin.aspx  This bug took many hours of trial and error to figure out, so make sure you follow the steps accurately.   Steps to reproduce      Create a blank DNN site with the DarkKnight skin     Create a blank page with an HTML module on it.     In Admin, Site Settings, assign """"Home-Standard-Menu"""" as the site skin.     Specify """"Aside"""" as the default site container.     Edit the Home-Standard-Menu.ascx skin file and set the Right content pane to use """"PageTitle_Red"""" as the default pane container. Do this by changing line 52 to:      <div id=""""RightPane"""" runat=""""server"""" containertype=""""G"""" containername=""""DarkKnight"""" containersrc=""""PageTitle_Red.ascx""""></div>     Place the HTML module in the Content pane and confirm it uses the assigned default """"Aside"""" container.     Now move that module to the right pane and confirm it uses the """"PageTitle_Red"""" container as is assigned to that pane.     So far all is correct.     Now manually change the container in the module settings for that module to the """"PageTitle_Blue container"""" - It will change as expected.     Now manually change the container for that module to the """"Aside"""" container - It will incorrectly revert back to the """"PageTitle_Red"""" container.  The expected behavior is that one can assign any container to any module and the module will use that container. It has always worked fine back to DNN3 like this.  The incorrect behaviour is that this fails when the manually-assigned container is also the site default container, and the module is in a content pane that has a default container applied via pane-level-skinning.  Naturally I'm still stuck on DNN5 until this is resolved, so I'm ranking it up :)"""

title: "JavaScript.RequestRegistration - File Order Issue"
description: """We're running into issues with the core implementation of JavaScript.RequestRegistration.  We have installed a newer version of Knockout.js thus creating a newer entry in the JavaScriptLibraries folder. Due to the default nature of how these are registered - it's the file order priority that screws this up.      Example:  Knockout.js 3.3.0 is installed.  Also added are Kncokout.Mapping 2.4.1, and we install Knockout.validation.js 2.0.3  During development - we upgrade to knockout.js 3.4.1 - install the extension as per the rules.  Because Mapping and validation are not also updated (they don't need to be) we run into issues.    It's in the JavaScript.cs file ([located here|https://github.com/dnnsoftware/Dnn.Platform/blob/development/DNN%20Platform/Library/Framework/JavaScriptLibraries/JavaScript.cs]) at lines 449 - the private static in GetFileOrder function.    If the javascript library isn't one of the default core (jquery, hoverintent, etc) - it gets the DefaultPriority (100) PLUS the JavaScriptLibrary table's Package ID.    Thus - but upgrading our knockout version - it has a Primary key ID of 165 (plus 100 = 265) which is higher than the validation package id.    This breaks our custom modules even though we are following DNN best practices.  The work around is to change the knockout.js extension to load in the HEAD But this is not the preferred solution!!!    It would be ideal if we could pass a priority into the JavaScript.RequestRegistration call - that takes the overall highest priority(?) or something similar.  Or best if because the dependencies are known by knockout.mapping and knockout.validation - that it would load knockout.js first.    Here's a screenshot of the JavaScriptLibraries table: https://www.screencast.com/t/zbi1ISQE"""

title: "All pages except home page return 404"
description: """Hi there,  We've noticed that sporadically our sites will return a 404 response for all pages except the home page. We've witnessed that the behavior always starts to be exhibited directly after the application pool is recycled. Once  the 404 results start occurring the only resolution is to recycle the application pool again which then clears the tab dictionary from cache so that it can be reloaded again.    I've reviewed the code & believe that the root cause of the issue is due to the fact that the code that builds the tab index, portalDepths dictionary &  tabPaths dictionary is not thread safe. I can see code in the method TabIndexController.FetchTabDictionary is using SharedDictionary classes to store the tab dictionaries, however the code is not threadsafe when adding the dictionaries to the cache. Therefore when multiple threads are executing the FetchTabDictionary method it's possible for an empty dictionary to be added to the cache.     To resolve this issue the code needs to be updated so that only one thread can add the dictionaries at a time.  I have provided an updated version of the TabIndexController class with the FetchTabDictionary method modified as an attachment. I've also added another private helper method called PortalExistsIndex in the TabIndexController class, that is used by the FetchTabDictionary to determine if the portal has already been added to the index.     This is an issue that seems to have been in DNN for some time. Here are a couple of links to others that have experienced similar behavior which seems like it might be due to the same issue.  http://www.dnnsoftware.com/forums/threadid/525944/scope/posts/404-error-for-all-pages-except-home-page  http://www.dnnsoftware.com/forums/threadid/524447/scope/posts/http-error-code-404-page-not-found  """

description: """The issue is the logic check with using the 'Use Javascript Libraries CDN' setting in Host Settings. Looking through the source code, this appears this is the problem:    {code:C#}  public override void RenderControl(HtmlTextWriter writer)          {              writer.AddAttribute(HtmlTextWriterAttribute.Type, """"text/javascript"""");              writer.RenderBeginTag(HtmlTextWriterTag.Script);                if (ObjectName.Contains("""".""""))              {                  //generate function check                  writer.Write(""""if (typeof """" + ObjectName + """" != 'function') {"""");              }              else              {                  //generate object check                  writer.Write(""""if (typeof """" + ObjectName + """" == 'undefined') {"""");              }                writer.Write(""""document.write('<script src=\"""""""" + FileName + """"\"""" type=\""""text/javascript\""""></' + 'script>');"""");              writer.Write(""""}"""");              writer.RenderEndTag();          }  {code}    The ko.validation object contains a """"."""" so the check ends up seeing if it is a function, when it is really an object.  The check fails and then injects the script tag again causing double validation.    We would like to use this feature, but we depend on knockout and ko.validation.  Without changing the source code or the ko.validation library this cannot be resolved.  """

title: "SI: Module Settings - Publish Date: Allow Roles with Edit Rights to view module"
description: """Currently, if a specific role has access to view/edit/manage settings for a module then the role would be able to see the module during its publication date. Nevertheless, if the Start date is in the future or if the end date has already passed (in other words if the module is no longer published), then the module would not be visible for the role with edits right and will not be able to work on it.    The use case where this feature is needed is when one has a custom role managing important information/announcement banners which are not always visible; and the users in this role should have the rights to edit and publish these modules. However, once the publish date does not match the ranges between start and end dates, users in that role are no longer able to view nor edit the module."""

title: "PB General: Unexpected Postbacks occurring when toggling Edit mode."
description: """When a user is in view mode & clicks the Edit button on the Persona bar to enter edit mode the script within the handleEdit function within the file main.js in the Persona Bar scripts folder calls window.parent.location.reload();    This causes the browser to reload the last request that was made. If the last request happens to be a POST request then that POST request will be made again, rather than the page being refreshed using a a GET request, which I believe was the intention of calling reload.     Re-issuing a POST request can have unintended consequences if the POST caused server state to be updated. For example, if the page has a module on with a grid in it and the user clicks delete to delete an item from the grid this could be done via a postback. If the user then subsequently clicked the edit button to enter edit mode the postback would be issued again as though the item was being deleted again, however the item has already been deleted so the next item in the grid would be deleted.    To verify the issue load a module that has controls which call do_postback & reload the same page, a gridview for example. Click on a control to perform the postback, then click the edit button to enter edit mode. If you use Fiddler to inspect the request issued after the edit button was clicked it will be a post with the event target & argument of the control that was clicked before the edit button.    The simple fix is to change calls to location.reload() so that instead the href is updated. E.g replace   window.parent.location.reload();  with  window.top.document.location.href = window.top.document.location.href;    It seems this has already been done in other places within the EditBar scripts so reload is not used."""

title: "Null reference exception happened when the page is redirected in SSLOffload environment"
description: """When a page is setup to redirect to the existing page in SSLOffload environment, null reference exception occurs when the page is typed in from the browser  In this scenario Page2 is setup to redirect to Page3. In our opinion for this scenario, checking the IsSecure of the Active Tab is not related to determining whethere a request is secure or not.    Our suggestion on fixing is as following.      public static bool IsSecureConnectionOrSslOffload(HttpRequest request)          {              if (request.IsSecureConnection)              {                  return true;              }              string ssloffloadheader = HostController.Instance.GetString(""""SSLOffloadHeader"""", """""""");              //if the ssloffloadheader variable has been set check to see if a request header with that type exists              if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ssloffloadheader))              {                  string ssloffload = request.Headers[ssloffloadheader];                  if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ssloffload))                  {                      return true;                  }              }              return false;          }  """

title: "Password Reset process only partially directs the user about a proper password format"

title: "SI: Module Settings - Allow Index Setting"
description: """When a new module is created, the tabmodule settings for the module are not created; therefore, if a user goes into the settings of the module and tries to disable the default allow index option, it will not work, and the POST request would not send any details for the allow index option.    On the other hand, if the user first saves the module settings with the default allow index enabled; then the data is sent on the request and gets added to the database; furthermore, the user can disable it once this is done. title: "Journal posts in private groups visible to all users (/w solution)"
description: """A while back someone decided to do a bit of work with Journal API. Presumably to fix the issue with posts appearing for everyone when the Private (selectable option from privacy menu) was used. Thus the SecuritySet parsing function was born PrepareSecuritySet(...). But as it turns out the new implementation broke private group posts by not setting the appropriate security set and thus making posts appear for everyone to see outside of Social Groups module.    I do not know the exact version of DNN Platform that the breaking change was introduced because I am lazy to look it up, but I do know that to this day the GitHub repository still has the same code and thus presumably the bug remains unreported.    Steps to reproduce the issue:    1. Download and install DNN Platform  1.1 DNN 7.1.1 is tested as working  1.2 DNN 7.4.2 is tested as not working  2. Create two pages: Journal Feed and Social Groups  3. Add Journal module to Journal Feed page  4. Add Social Groups module to Social Groups page and hit auto configure button  5. Configure Social Groups module by allowing Registered users to create groups  6. Create 1+ test user (as many as you like)  6.1 user1 - for example, but you can get a little more creative  7. As user1 create a private group and share a couple of posts  8. As (host) user visit Journal Feed page    Expected results:  (host) user (and any other user not a member of the same group) should not be able to see user1 posts    Actual result:  (host) user can see user1 posts    OK, by definition (host) user should be able to see everything but in this case, we're not concerned with Journal posts so feel free to sub (host) user for any regular user (user2, user3 - be creative) who is not a member of user1 group.      The following block of code dealing with setting appropriate security set for the private group posts before the breaking change:    {{        if (journalItem.SocialGroupId > 0)        {              JournalItem item = journalItem;              RoleInfo role = TestableRoleController.Instance.GetRole(journalItem.PortalId, r => r.SecurityMode != SecurityMode.SecurityRole && r.RoleID == item.SocialGroupId);              if (role != null)              {                    if (currentUser.IsInRole(role.RoleName))                    {                          journalItem.SecuritySet += """"R"""" + journalItem.SocialGroupId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + """","""";                          if (!role.IsPublic)                          {                                journalItem.SecuritySet = journalItem.SecuritySet.Replace(""""E,"""", String.Empty);                          }                    }              }        }  }}    Part of which looks like it was replaced with:    {{        ...        else if (journalItem.SecuritySet == """"R,"""")        {            if (journalItem.SocialGroupId > 0)                journalItem.SecuritySet += """"R"""" + journalItem.SocialGroupId + """","""";        }  }}    And the bulk of the logic was modified to take the following form:    {{        if (journalItem.SocialGroupId > 0 && originalSecuritySet.Contains(""""U,""""))        {            var item = journalItem;            var role = RoleController.Instance.GetRole(journalItem.PortalId,                r => r.SecurityMode != SecurityMode.SecurityRole && r.RoleID == item.SocialGroupId);              if (role != null && !role.IsPublic)            {                journalItem.SecuritySet = journalItem.SecuritySet.Replace(""""E,"""", String.Empty).Replace(""""C,"""", String.Empty);            }        }  }}    And see two lines of code that indicate to the issue:          1. else if (journalItem.SecuritySet == """"R,"""")        2. if (journalItem.SocialGroupId > 0 && originalSecuritySet.Contains(""""U,""""))    I failed to find code reference where the condition to meet (1) is getting set.  I think the solution failed to consider that (originalSecuritySet.Contains(""""U,"""")) is only available outside Social Groups module [~\DesktopModules\Journal\View.ascx].    Of course, replacing existing solution with original is not going to fix the problem that the change was supposed to fix. Allow me to propose the following solution as a compromise between the two.    {{        // this block of code can be left as is in place because:        // 1. i do not understand the circumstance required to meet the condition        // 2. duplicates get cleaned up just before the function returns        // so this block of code should not affect anything        ...        else if (journalItem.SecuritySet == """"R,"""")        {            if (journalItem.SocialGroupId > 0)                journalItem.SecuritySet += """"R"""" + journalItem.SocialGroupId + """","""";        }  }}    Proposed change:    {{        if (journalItem.SocialGroupId > 0)        {              var item = journalItem;              var role = RoleController.Instance.GetRole(journalItem.PortalId, r => r.SecurityMode != SecurityMode.SecurityRole && r.RoleID == item.SocialGroupId);              if (role != null)              {                    if (currentUser.IsInRole(role.RoleName) || originalSecuritySet.Contains(""""U,""""))                    {                          journalItem.SecuritySet += """"R"""" + journalItem.SocialGroupId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + """","""";                          if (!role.IsPublic)                          {                                journalItem.SecuritySet = journalItem.SecuritySet.Replace(""""E,"""", String.Empty).Replace(""""C,"""", String.Empty);                          }                    }              }        }  }}    The proposed change only affects one file: ~/DNN Platform/Library/Services/Journal/JournalControllerImpl.cs  """

title: "Move Liquid Content from Microservice to Platform"
description: """We want to move Liquid Content from the Evoq Microservice into modules and extensions within DNN Platform.      Important items to consider:  # Content Library, Content Types, Visualizers and API Keys need to be ported.    # Visualizer module needs to be ported.    # Search Integration  # Database structure/storage     Features not being migrated:  # Content Library -> Facebook, Twitter and LinkedIn Publishing      *Engineering Considerations*  # We need to have proper separation of concerns between web API, business layer and repository layers  # Where possible we should .Net Standard 2.0 class libraries  # Where possible remove dependencies of DNN Dlls  # Must support DNN's native:  ## Permission  ## Localization  ## Workflow   ## Search  # The above systems should be integrated using Dependency Injection  # Must use SQL Server for data storage, but the repository layer should be abstractable, where other data storage (e.g. MongoDB) can be used. Current Liquid Content uses DocumentDB which is Azure only service  ## We may require newer version of SQL Server, e.g. 2016 (especially if we want to take advantage of Json data types)   # Have source code in a new repository outside of Dnn.Platform. Our goal is to keep things as decoupled as possible - continue to slim down Platform, and certainly not more.  ## This should be Library type extension.   ## In theory, one could choose not to install Structured Content on DNN.  ## Any module taking advantage of SC must specify dependency on this library.  # Should be scalable, must support 1M+ content items with ease (of course depends on hardware). Solution should linearly scale with more hardware resources.     """

title: "SI: If the DB Server Restarts, DNN site goes down until Apppool Restart"
description: """If a DB Server restart or gets shut down for a little time, DNN will start timing out which is expected; nevertheless, once the DB Server is backup DNN/IIS would still use the old connection pool and would keep timing out until the application pool is restarted which restarts the connection to the DB. title: "Redirect_AfterLogin setting is no longer useful"
description: """Hello DNN experts,    I wanted to share some of my findings and see if I am right.    So I have a dnn website which has a requirement to redirect to specific page after login.  The website used to run on dnn 6 and redirection was behaving perfectly fine.  I have updated the website to dnn 9.1.1 recently and redirection is no longer working properly.    It works only if:  1.open browser and type in website root url and do not browse anywhere in the site  2.click login (returnurl query string is blank)  3. fill in username and password and click login  4. user gets redirected where it suppose to.    It does not work if:  1.open browser and type in website root url and  browse anywhere in the site.  2.click login  (returnurl query string is populated with the url of previous page)  3. fill in username and password and click login  4. user gets redirected where it was previously (It should redirect to the """"Redirect_AfterLogin"""" set in the portalsettings)    I thought that something is wrong with my dnn configuration but could not find what is wrong.  Then started to browse git dnn source code and I saw some changes in this area.    Please see the code [before change|https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B2F6xp3Xz79XVlBXRGtkdGFxbEk/view?usp=sharing] and [after change|https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B2F6xp3Xz79XLVc1OWwycEtPbFU/view?usp=sharing].    So based on that code analysis I believe that in dnn 7.5 > """"Redirect_AfterLogin"""" setting kicks off only when returnurl query string is blank    otherwise it redirects you to returnurl query string parameter.    I would say this is a bug. DNN never behaved like that       Thanks    Tadas"""

It works only if: 1.open browser and type in website root url and do not browse anywhere in the site 2.click login (returnurl query string is blank) 3. fill in username and password and click login 4. user gets redirected where it suppose to. It does not work if: 1.open browser and type in website root url and browse anywhere in the site. 2.click login (returnurl query string is populated with the url of previous page) 3. fill in username and password and click login 4. user gets redirected where it was previously (It should redirect to the """"Redirect_AfterLogin"""" set in the portalsettings) I thought that something is wrong with my dnn configuration but could not find what is wrong. title: "ResourceFileInstaller fails to update resource files"
description: """It seems that in some cases during upgrade of resource files dnn9 tries to create new resource file while old version has not been deleted yet.     We see this error on our production environments where we have separate hosting machine (VM03) and web-site files on different server (VM07). The problems occur with upgrade of modules containing large resource files. Symptoms: upgrade of modules fail on random resource files. For example:         Additional information from dnn log shows """"The process cannot access the file xxx because it is being used by another process."""":      It is known problem in .NET that after deletion of the file it takes some time before the file actually disappears, and instead of try to relay on File.Exists function it's better to wait until file will be unlocked using [FileSystemWatcher|https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/system.io.filesystemwatcher.aspx]."""

title: "SMTP Username overwrites mailMessage.Sender and fails with Azure SendGrid"
description: """TLDR Description:  If your SMTP server settings requires a username and that username has an """"@"""" symbol in it, the mailMessage.Sender field may be overwritten with the SMTP Username setting.    Description:  We migrated our website to Azure recently and configured our email to use the SendGrid azure implementation.  By default, when signing up for SendGrid through Azure, your username is in the form of 'azure_[numbers]@azure.com'. This is used for the SMTP authentication when sending emails.  We also configured SendGrid with WhiteLabels so that emails sent from our website will properly show to customers instead of getting the annoying """"Sent on behalf of"""" From name.    We then configured our host account to the name 'noreply@[domain].com'.  Generally, we use this email form when configuring a site as we don't want people replying to messages automatically sent from the system.  When we call any of the methods of DotNetNuke.Services.Mail.Mail.SendMail(...), and manually specifying an email address of 'noreply@[domain].com', all our messages are not WhiteLabeled and the headers are incorrect for the sender (see dnn_BadHeaders.png -- the header on the left is bad, the right is good).  The right is good because we were sending from webmaster@ instead of the usual noreply.    I decompiled the DotnetNuke.Services.Mail information to see how the SendMailInternal function handled my sender fields and if there was a work around I could use.  And I found the code explicitly overwrites the sender information with the SMTP username in a certain condition.  See dnn_SendMailInternal.png.    This should be updated so that you can have SMTP usernames with @ signs in them as that is the default for Azure SendGrid implementations."""

Description: ""TLDR Description: If your SMTP server settings requires a username and that username has an """"@"""" symbol in it, the mailMessage.Sender field may be overwritten with the SMTP Username setting. Description: We migrated our website to Azure recently and configured our email to use the SendGrid azure implementation. By default, when signing up for SendGrid through Azure, your username is in the form of 'azure_[numbers]@azure.com'. This is used for the SMTP authentication when sending emails. We also configured SendGrid with WhiteLabels so that emails sent from our website will properly show to customers instead of getting the annoying """"Sent on behalf of"""" From name. We then configured our host account to the name 'noreply@[domain].com'. Generally, we use this email form when configuring a site as we don't want people replying to messages automatically sent from the system. When we call any of the methods of DotNetNuke.Services.Mail.Mail.SendMail(...), and manually specifying an email address of 'noreply@[domain].com', all our messages are not WhiteLabeled and the headers are incorrect for the sender (see dnn_BadHeaders.png -- the header on the left is bad, the right is good). The right is good because we were sending from webmaster@ instead of the usual noreply. I decompiled the DotnetNuke.Services.Mail information to see how the SendMailInternal function handled my sender fields and if there was a work around I could use. And I found the code explicitly overwrites the sender information with the SMTP username in a certain condition. See dnn_SendMailInternal.png. title: "Installing modules very slow with many portals"
description: """The module install page (/Install/Install.aspx?mode=installresources) is very slow on sites with a lot of portals due to a high number of database calls.  That process currently calls GetPortalDesktopModules for every module on every portal.    I've implemented a fix which only calls GetPortalDesktopModules once per module in the outer loop and then passes that dictionary of modules down to the inner loop.  The new dictionary parameter is optional, and if the parameter is not provided it will fall back on the old mechanism (fetching from the database).  This maintains backwards compatibility and isolates the changes to the module install page.    Our DNN instance has 35 modules and over 3600 portals.  We did a database trace and found that this was making over 100,000 database calls.  This was causing our install process to take over 31 minutes with no load (about an hour with load).    After implementing the change, we have significantly reduced our install time from 31 minutes to under 1.5 minutes (from 58 to under 4 minutes with load).    The patch file for this fix is attached, I have discussed it with [~accountid:<USER> and will submit a pull request shortly."""

title: "Password history should support a minimum time before reuse"
description: """As part of a security audit, it came up that we couldn't set a minimum timeframe before a password can be reused.  So, while we can say that you can't reuse your last six (for example) passwords, there's nothing to stop you from changing you password six times in a row and reusing your original password.    I'd like to propose adding a new setting with the minimum number of days before passwords can be reused (our client's requirements are six months, but I would plan to default to zero, for backwards compatibility, unless y'all think there should be a default)."""

title: "I/E: Pages Export/Import"
description: """We previously allowed a page to be exported (prior to 9.1) and this wrote the tab settings (most of them), modules and module settings (along with tab module settings) to the export file (in xml). We want to retain everything it previously did (not necessarily how it did things before) and then account for additional concerns. When """"Include Content"""" is chosen as part of the export process, this is when the modules and the module settings (along with TabModuleSettings) should be included (like older versions). When a page exists in the import, the import process needs to replace it (in the end, the page should look identical to the place it was exported from and nothing should be in the recycle bin in the destination related to the page).     *Page Settings to Export*  - Details:   -- Page Type (Based on type, all values surfaced like PermanentRedirect, DisableLink), Name, Title, Description, Keywords, Tags, Display in menu, Link Tracking, Enable Scheduling (start/end dates if applicable), Workflow  - Permissions:  -- Include all role and user permissions that are applied ONLY if permissions are selected as part of export  - Advanced:   -- Appearance: Page Theme, Layout & container along with stylesheet  -- SEO: Sitemap Priority, Page Header Tags, Allow Indexing (moving from More Tab see [DNN-9301]), URLs  -- More: Secure Connection, Disable Page (adding, see [DNN-9301]), Output Cache Provider  - No UI:  -- CultureCode, IconFileLarge, IconFile    Related Jira Notes:  - [DNN-9628]: This is something that is determined as part of the export process.   - [CONTENT-6092]: We are only including published pages in the export and therefore all imported pages should be published upon successful import.   - [DNN-9212]: We will continue to include taburls but it shouldn't be based on any id (on the name, instead)  - [DNN-8219]: Including CSS files  - [DNN-9543]: We need to include the setting """"allow indexing""""  - [DNN-7700]: Culture Code should be part of page export (and import)  - [DNN-8856]: We need to include page tags (and categories)    Note in Scope:  - Page content items  - Module content items  - TabAliasSkin  - Tab Versions"""

title: "Scheduler Exception on CoreMessaging : Subquery returns more than 1 value "
description: """+Bug+    When a set of users are sent the same message, is possible to get records in the Core_Messaging_Message_Recipients and Core_Messaging_Messages such that when combined, the results of vw_MessagesForDispatch fail with the following exception:        The underlying cause is sending a single message to multiple users.  This can be done by having multiple Content Managers in a site when activating an Evoq Microservice such as Structured Content.  The Content Managers are each sent a notification of the activation, and as such the user notifications preference will fail because of duplicate results in the subquery.    I think this requires having multiple host users and multiple content managers, then activating a microservice.    This will be in the following stack trace:      I think this might be related to having duplicate messages inserted for activation of Microservices - I could be wrong on this however.      The error comes from the stored procedure CoreMessaging_GetNextMessagesForInstantDispatch which then calls the view vw_MessagesForDispatch.    That view has two subqueries in it to get the notification period:      This code effectively joins together the CoreMessaging_Messages and CoreMessaging_MessageRecipients and the CoreMessaging_UserPreferences tables.    +Workaround+  The workaround for this bug is to delete the messages and message recipients for the messages with duplicate records.  This is sufficient to get the core messaging processing again, but it does lose the messages.    +Fix+  The SQL View should be fixed to return the Message Notification or User Notification Preference without doing a subquery - probably by just including the Core_Messaging_UserPreferences table in the query instead of a subquery.    Suggest removing this:      and moving the CoreMessaging_UserPreference to the main table joins, adding a distinct and a new CASE statement for the view      This produces the correct results in the studied (failing) test data, without duplicates, however it hasn't been regression tested to make sure it always delivers to the correct notification preferences."""

This can be done by having multiple Content Managers in a site when activating an Evoq Microservice such as Structured Content. The Content Managers are each sent a notification of the activation, and as such the user notifications preference will fail because of duplicate results in the subquery. I think this requires having multiple host users and multiple content managers, then activating a microservice. This will be in the following stack trace: I think this might be related to having duplicate messages inserted for activation of Microservices - I could be wrong on this however. The error comes from the stored procedure CoreMessaging_GetNextMessagesForInstantDispatch which then calls the view vw_MessagesForDispatch. That view has two subqueries in it to get the notification period: This code effectively joins together the CoreMessaging_Messages and CoreMessaging_MessageRecipients and the CoreMessaging_UserPreferences tables. +Workaround+ The workaround for this bug is to delete the messages and message recipients for the messages with duplicate records. title: "Add scheduler client feature to allow scheduled task to run on single/all servers"
description: """Most of the scheduler clients need to be run on a single server only. By default all server in a web farm pickup the scheduled tasks and run them (except in EVOQ where a server is specified).    The scheduler tasks need to be enhanced by allowing them to run on a single server by default and if needed they can be run on multiple server (for example, when flushing a server's local cached objects). This change should be hard-coded in classes that extends the {{SchedulerClient}} and not dynamic so it can't be set for each installation differently.    It appears that {{Purge Log Buffer}} in Platform needs to run on ALL the servers. Others should run on a specific server only.    We need to do two things:  # Add a virtual property *RunsOnSingeServerOnly*  on {{SchedulerClient}} abstract class. The default being true.  # Make a change in Scheduler engine to see if there are more than one server defined in {{WebServers}} table. If so, and we have tasks like {{Search: Site Crawler}} with no servers specified, it should auto-assign that task to itself.   ## While doing this, it must clear cache so other servers can be made aware that a given task has been assigned to another server, and that they should not attempt to run. """

title: "SI: Search Results Filtering Count"
description: """Message directly from site owner:    See attachment of the code tracing done in the DNN Codebase. One of our developers have traced down the potential root cause of the issue, which is the SearchSecurityTrimmer class. All in all, it appears that the Total search results is filtered per page, and not across all results.    That means if all Search Results are viewable on Page 1, then Page 2 have some results that got filtered, then at Page 2 will be the only time that it will decrement the Total Search Results displayed on screen. Essentially, the Total Search Results Count displayed on the Search Results page changes as we browse through every page of the search result.        Steps to reproduce:    1. As a Registered User, Try to do a search now that will have multi-paged results. (i.e. Total: 50 results)   2. Then go to other pages, say Page 2.   3. Pick one of the results in Page 2 and make it inaccessible (i.e. a document that is restricted to the user that is searching)   4. Logout as a Registered User.   5. Login as an Admin/Content Owner and make the item in #3 inaccessible.   6. Logout as Admin/Content Owner.   7. Log back in as a Registered User. Try to search again for the same keyword.   8. At Page 1, Total Results should still be 50. When you go to Page 2, the Total results will be decreased to 49. When you go to Page 3, the Total Results will be back to 50.    Where the problem lies is that the """"Total Results"""" count update takes effect at the point when the item is encountered at its supposed page.  """

title: "Can't delete Portal - Site Management is currently unavailable.  "
description: """This bug is an extension of this forum post;  [Can not delete Portal - Site Management is currently unavailable.  |http://www.dnnsoftware.com/forums/threadid/529785/scope/posts/threadpage/1]    When you try to delete a Portal via the Host -> Site Management area you get an error message.        I've experienced this on both fresh DNN 8.0.4 installations and DNN 7.4.2 upgraded to 8.0.4 installations.    # Create a folder path such as D:\websites\Client\DNN.  # Remove all permissions from the D:\ drive except for SYSTEM and Admin permissions.  # Give the D:\websites\Client\DNN the needed permissions for DNN to run IUSR & IIS AppPool\DNN with write/modify/read/etc.  # Install DNN into the DNN folder.  # Create an additional Portal or import another Portal through an exported template.  # Attempt to delete the extra Portal and you should get the error.    As discussed in the thread linked adding the Everyone Full Control to the D:\websites\Client\DNN folder does not resolve the issue.  You still get a permission denied error.    Using the ProcessMonitor tool I watched what the IIS AppPool\DNN user was doing and saw that it was making a read/write/modify request to the D:\websites\Client folder.  If you then give the Everyone (or IUSR & IIS AppPool\DNN) user Full Control of the D:\websites\Client folder you can now successfully delete the Portal.  """

title: "Module name in search results/settings could not be customized if module definition name contains invalid characters"
description: """The `DotNetNuke.Services.Search.Internals.InternalSearchControllerImpl` uses raw module definition name to generate resource key to get custom (localized) module name from `~/DesktopModules/Admin/SearchResults/App_LocalResources/SearchableModules.resx`. In case when module definition contains some invalid characters (primarily, dots) for resource key, getting custom module name will fail and module definition's friendly name will be used instead.    Example of  `SearchableModules.resx` content:        The issue could be resolved on per-module basis by updating module definition names - but this may not work for some third-party modules as their code could depend on specific definition names.    Ugly quickfix: replace invalid chars (dots, again) in definition name with underscore in `InternalSearchControllerImpl.cs`:    {code:csharp}  var text = Localization.Localization.GetSafeJSString(""""Module_"""" + def.DefinitionName.Replace (""""."""", """"_""""), LocalizedResxFile);  if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))  {     text = def.FriendlyName;  }  {code}    A generic solution will require using something like `StronglyTypedResourceBuilder.VerifyResourceName()`: https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ms145952(v=vs.110).aspx Another way - implement check for invalid characters in module definition name then module added/installed.      """

title: "JWT logout returns empty string"
description: """*+Steps to reproduce:+*  * Install and configure JWT-AUTH with the DNN API (http://www.dnnsoftware.com/docs/administrators/jwt/setup-jwt-for-auth.html)  * use the /login method with the credentials in the body of the request to get a Token (http://mydomain.com/DesktopModules/JwtAuth/API/mobile/login)   * use the /logout method to logout and invalidate the Token (http://mydomain.com/DesktopModules/JwtAuth/API/mobile/logout)  * Examine the response of the logout-request.    *+Expected behaviour:+*  The Response of the logout request should return valid json data, even if the response body is empty - which is the case for a successful logout response.    *+Wrong behaviour:+*  Instead it returns an empty string ("""""""") in the response body  This behaviour causes errors while parsing the response.    *+Also see: http://api.jquery.com/jQuery.ajax/ +*  _""""json"""": Evaluates the response as JSON and returns a JavaScript object. Cross-domain """"json"""" requests are converted to """"jsonp"""" unless the request includes jsonp: false in its request options. {color:red}The JSON data is parsed in a strict manner; any malformed JSON is rejected and a parse error is thrown.{color} As of jQuery 1.9, an empty response is also rejected; {color:red}the server should return a response of null or {} instead. {color}(See json.org for more information on proper JSON formatting.)_"""

Empty the Recycle Bin for this Portal    EXPECTED RESULT  The page is deleted and the page order in other portals are not affected    ACTUAL RESULT  Deleting the page affects the page order in other portals    It is important to notice that it will affect pages with a TabOrder greater than the deleted page TabOrder    CODE FIX:    /****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[DeleteTab]    Script Date: 04/22/2013 07:53:46 ******/  IF  EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[DeleteTab]') AND type in (N'P', N'PC'))  BEGIN   DROP PROCEDURE [dbo].[DeleteTab]  END  GO    /****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[DeleteTab]    Script Date: 15/02/2017 08:47:09 ******/  SET ANSI_NULLS ON  GO  SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON  GO    CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DeleteTab]      @TabId Int  -- ID of tab to delete; Not Null and > 0  AS  BEGIN      DECLARE @PortalID Int      DECLARE @TabOrder Int      DECLARE @ParentId Int      DECLARE @ContentItemId Int      SELECT @PortalID = PortalID, @TabOrder = TabOrder, @ParentId = ParentID, @ContentItemID = ContentItemID FROM dbo.[Tabs] WHERE TabID = @TabId        -- Delete Tab --      DELETE FROM dbo.[Tabs] WHERE  TabID = @TabId        -- Update TabOrder of remaining Tabs --      UPDATE dbo.[Tabs]          SET TabOrder = TabOrder - 2          WHERE IsNull(ParentID, -1) = IsNull(@ParentId , -1) AND TabOrder > @TabOrder AND (@PortalID IS NULL OR PortalID = @PortalID)        -- Delete Content Item --      DELETE FROM dbo.[ContentItems] WHERE ContentItemID = @ContentItemId  END  GO"""

title: "SI: File moving not transactional, doesn't rollback from error"
description: """Please see linked issue.    """"[...] we moved one our top level folders, it has numerous sub folders that probably go 4 or 5 levels deep. The end user wanted to change the name of the top level folder from """"Planning"""" to """"Planning & Building"""".     The end user used the move function and at some point she received an error stating that the folder couldn't be created because the length of the path was too long. I believe this is a windows limitation.     The underlying issue is really that the process is not transactional, meaning that if it fails it doesn't [roll] back. It started the process of moving files and folders and when it encountered the error it just halted. Leaving the system in a state where most of the files had been moved but not all.     Further my guess is that the system is updated to look at the new folders that were created from the move when the process completes successfully and because it did not complete successfully the system was not aware of the new folders hence to the end user it looked like the files were gone""""    This can be worked around by re-syncing the folders, but the client would like the errors to be handled more gracefully"""

The end user used the move function and at some point she received an error stating that the folder couldn't be created because the length of the path was too long. title: "Extension URL provider break when English default culture is disabled"
description: """Add another language under *Admin > Languages* (e.g. fr-FR) and make French the default site language. Then disable (uncheck) the en-US language.    The extension URL provider passes an empty cultureCode in the *TransformFriendlyUrlToQueryString* method. However, the *ChangeFriendlyUrl* method receives the correct cultureCode = fr-FR.    We cannot use the *System.Threading.Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture* or *System.Threading.Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture* either as it returns en-US, but we really needed fr-FR.    This bug is breaking the advanced URL extension since it's unable to lookup the correct URL path to recreate the query string values."""

Bucks County in Pennsylvania) the List Name appears as State.PA.County when it should be just County.  If the entries are corrected directly in the database the table is structured properly; however, the hierarchical list to the left still does not operate properly, only allowing list expansion at level 0.  We tried to recreate our own State list entry in the List module.  Because of the module’s logic error in identifying List Name this was not possible. title: "Multi-language website and page permission settings don't work correctly together"
description: """In a multi-language website, accessing a page in a language other than the default one and the page has permissions set to Registerd Users and the user is not logged in, instead of proposing to Login with the returnurl set to that page, the user is redirected to the entitled page in the default language.    The problem is caused by the following lines in DNN Platform > Library > UI > Skins > Skin.cs - function ProcessMasterModules() - Line 472:    //If request localized page which haven't complete translate yet, redirect to default language version.  var redirectUrl = Globals.AccessDeniedURL(Localization.GetString(""""TabAccess.Error""""));  Locale defaultLocale = LocaleController.Instance.GetDefaultLocale(PortalSettings.PortalId);  if (PortalSettings.ContentLocalizationEnabled &&  TabController.CurrentPage.CultureCode != defaultLocale.Code)  {   redirectUrl = new LanguageTokenReplace { Language = defaultLocale.Code }.ReplaceEnvironmentTokens(""""[URL]"""");  }  Response.Redirect(redirectUrl, true);    The comment line claims that if the page is not translated, user should be redirected to default language version. However the condition is always redirecting to the default language version since the current page culture code will be always different from the default locale if the user is navigating the site in a language either than the default one.  The condition should be:    if (PortalSettings.ContentLocalizationEnabled && !TabController.CurrentPage.IsTranslated)  {   {    // If page is the home page of that language and it is not translated, then a redirect to the default language version should occur    if (TabController.CurrentPage.TabID == PortalSettings.HomeTabId)    {     redirectUrl = new LanguageTokenReplace { Language = defaultLocale.Code }.ReplaceEnvironmentTokens(""""[URL]"""");    }    else    {     // If page is NOT the home page of that language and it is not translated, then a redirect to the parent page IN THAT LANGUAGE should occur     redirectUrl = new LanguageTokenReplace { Language = TabController.CurrentPage.CultureCode }.ReplaceEnvironmentTokens(""""[URL]"""");    }   }  }    This leads to another problem with pages for which the user has view permission (at the beginning of the very same function). In this case if one has view permission but the page is not translated, before continuing displaying the page the skin should check if that user has rights to modify the page (in other words that can translate the page as an Administrator or a Translator) and if not should be redirected to the parent page in the same language or to the default language version if the page is the home page. So the following lines should be added to line 422:    //If request localized page which haven't complete translate yet, redirect to default language version.  var redirectUrl = Globals.AccessDeniedURL(Localization.GetString(""""TabAccess.Error""""));  Locale defaultLocale = LocaleController.Instance.GetDefaultLocale(PortalSettings.PortalId);  if (PortalSettings.ContentLocalizationEnabled && !TabController.CurrentPage.IsTranslated)  {   //Check if user is in a role that can translate this page   if (!TabPermissionController.CanAdminPage() || !TabPermissionController.CanManagePage())   {    if (TabController.CurrentPage.TabID == PortalSettings.HomeTabId)    {     redirectUrl = new LanguageTokenReplace { Language = defaultLocale.Code }.ReplaceEnvironmentTokens(""""[URL]"""");    }    else    {     redirectUrl = new LanguageTokenReplace { Language = TabController.CurrentPage.CultureCode }.ReplaceEnvironmentTokens(""""[URL]"""");    }    Response.Redirect(redirectUrl, true);   }  }    """

                 break;              default:                  fuDialogWidth = 780;                  break;          }      };        $(window).resize(function () {          setFileUploadDialogWidth(); title: "SI: CKEditor cursor location on switch to source view"
description: """While editing content with the CKEditor, if the user highlights text then switches to source view, they lose their place in the content. In the basic editor switching to HTML view takes you to the location of text you have highlighted in design view. A client is accustomed to this functionality and is saying how hard it is to find their place in the HTML source.    Here are the steps to reproduce:    1. Click the toolbar button to go into the HTML source code (still in the basic editor).    6. Note that the text you highlighted in design view is now still highlighted in source code view.    7. Click the toolbar button to go back to design view.    8. Go into advanced edit (CKEditor) mode.    9. Repeat steps 4 and 5 in the advanced editor.    10. Note when you switch to the HTML source code view, your cursor is at the top of the content and the text you highlighted in design view is not highlighted in HTML source view. Of course after logon, the system redirects me to the /People/PersonDetail/mid/1294 page and I get an error because ID 123456?portalid=2 does not exist."""

title: "Autocompete country field fails to populate profie with country ID"
description: """If one enables the country field in the registration form, then when a user first views the form, the country field is pre-populated with a country, normally the correct one... possibly detected by browser locale or something.    If the user submits the form without modifying that country, then the profile table will be populated with the literal country name and not the country ID... and this is not correct.    Only if the user clicks into the country field, clears it and then begins typing and then selects a suggested country, then the profile table will get the country ID and not the name.    I have also found this to occur when the country field is not enabled in the form. The profile field in the database will be populated with the detected but invisible, literal country name.    There is a related issue with the Region field.     If one also enables the Region field on the registration form and makes it a required field, it is not possible to populate the field until after first auto-populating the country field with a valid country. Only then does the region field switch to a dropdown and become operable. By default however, the region is above the country and people typically try typing the region first, especially if the field is a text box that accepts input. Suggest making the Region field inactive until a valid country has been selected and move it below the country by default.     Note that connecting these fields like this also makes it impossible to only have a region and not a country field. If only the region is enabled, and this is not an unknown scenario for a site that only operates in a particular country, then it is not possible to submit the form as it will not accept any input.. because it requires that a country be selected first.    Use of conventional dropdowns and ensuring the country field is not pre-populated would resolve all of this... the way it was in the past didn't seem to cause any trouble."""

title: "TabModule Pane Doesn't Update on Skin Change"
description: """When a skin has a pane that is not the default required ContentPane, it can cause problems for module ordering when the skin on the page is changed.    To reproduce this, add a new module to a page, and put it in a custom pane, example TopHeroDark pane.    Then change the skin on the page to a skin which does not have the TopHeroDark pane.    The module will be located in the ContentPane on the page, but if you look in the database, it still thinks it is in the TopHeroDark pane in the TabModules table.    This can cause problems with module ordering and drag & drop, when you have multiple modules on the page that were in different panes, and they all get lumped into the ContentPane with duplicate ModuleOrder values."""

title: "SI: IP Address Tracking when using a Load Balancer"
description: """Creating this ticket on behalf of client, please see findings below:    We are using a load balancer and the client IP address is placed into the HTTP_X-FORWARDED-FOR server variable. The REMOTE_ADDR (or HttpRequest.UserHostAddress) is set to the IP address of the load balancer. This is a requirement of the load balancer and cannot be changed.  There are 2 issues with this:    1) The IPAddress column in the Analytics_PageViews table is being set to the address of the NLB (REMOTE_ADDR), not the client (HTTP_X-FORWARDED-FOR)   2) The LastIPAddress in the Users table is also being set in the same way (REMOTE_ADDR rather than HTTP_X-FORWARDED-FOR).    I would also like to share the following observations:    1) The GetIPAddress method in DNN Platform\DotNetNuke.Web.Mvc\Routing\HttpRequestExtensions.cs demonstrates the proper way to discover the client IP address when using a load balancer although it is looking for X-FORWARDED-FOR.  2) The GetVisitorIPAddress in DNN Platform\Library\Services\GeneratedImage\IPCount.cs is another attempt at doing this but is using different logic and is looking for the HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR server variable.     Moving into backlog and tagging as Medium priority. This is an inconsistency that needs to be addressed. It is possible, with new Analytics enhancements, this will be fixed anyway. PM will evaluate for an upcoming release. """

title: "Searching for recipients can fail when numerous users share names"
description: """When attempting to search for a user to send a message to in the Message Center, searching for a user by their display name fails when the names are structured in a """"LastName, FirstName"""" format, or if there are numerous users with a common name, such as """"Smith, FirstName""""    We have a production site with around 500-600 users where a problem was reported that a user with the name """"Smith, Mary"""" was not being shown in the selection list.    Upon further investigation, it seems the service procedure that is used to search - DotNetNuke.Web.InternalServices.MessagingServiceController.Search(string q), has some hardcoded values that assumes the person will only be searching by DisplayName (which in this case is fine), and also that a result set of 10 entries is permitted. There seems to be no way of customizing this page size property.    By executing the stored procedure _GetUsersBasicSearch_, by using the hardcoded page size of 10, I can confirm that searching by the user's partial display name of """"Smith"""" will exclude this result due to the number of other users with display names that include """"Smith""""    Also it is impossible to be more specific with the way the DisplayName is structured on this site, because trying to specify """"Smith, Mary"""" will strip the comma out of the search string and query the database with the string """"SmithMary"""". I've attached a screenshot that shows this.    Again, if I execute the stored procedure with """"Smith, Mary"""", the result *will* be properly shown. However, since DNN rips the comma out of the query text before sending it, querying by """"SmithMary"""" will return no results. This behavior is being seen by the end user.    When attempting to search in a different way (starting with the name Mary), this possibly could work, but again the search assumes that only 10 results are wanted. Mary can be a common name, and there is no way to properly select this user.    Steps to recreate:    1. Create 15 users that have the last name """"Smith"""".  2. Ensure the DisplayName property for each of these users follows a [LastName, FirstName] format.  3. Clear portal caches if necessary to ensure the latest listing of users is populated into cache.  4. Navigate to the Message Center and Compose New Message  5. In the 'To' field, begin typing """"Smith"""".  6. Some results will not be shown (should only be the first 10 listed alphabetically)  7. Attempt to be more specific by including a comma, and the user's first name.  8. No results will be shown."""

title: "Each Install of a Module Leaves Orphaned Records in ContentItems & Related Tables"
description: """Each time a module is installed, regardless of if the modules """"Friendly Name"""" is changed, new entries are added to the Content Items table. For a test, lookup in the """"ContentItems"""" table the friendly name of a module.  Re-install that modules to your portal.  You will notice the same text value will be added to the content items table with a new ID.    Expected results are to NOT have a duplication.  Either by re-using the old value, or by clearing out the old value after inserting the new one."""

title: "SMTP Server Settings per portal inoperable"
description: """We are unable to get the SMTP Server Settings per portal feature (which came in DNN 7.x.x) to work properly (Admin, Site Settings, Advanced Settings, SMTP Server Settings).  We have 10s of customers in one DNN instance, some of which need to utilize their own specific SMTP settings for registration notifications, etc.      All of the respective fields are in the UI and can be populated properly/saved to the PortalSettings table.  We have verified that the SMTP Server Settings area in Host Settings works as it always has, however those global settings will not work for our customer base.    We have performed this additional test with no success:    - Created a specific account in each customer's portal and made that user a member of the Administrators role.  This account also has the same email address that we are supplying to the SMTP Server Settings area in Admin, Site Settings, Advanced Settings, SMTP Server Settings.  - Set that account as the administrator in Admin, Site Settings, Advanced Settings, Security Settings.    Unfortunately the SMTP Server Settings section of Advanced Settings does not appear to be available to individual portal administrator level accounts vs. being logged into the respective portal as host level account (to try the Test SMTP Settings button while logged in as the actual portal's admin user).  However, a quick new user registration test with all of these settings in place still fails while of course not logged in as any existing user.    I suspect that both the test and live smtp calls are continuing to use the host users email address from the original host level feature's code base, which is causing an authentication/relay scenario that gets properly rejected by each customer's email/smtp server.    We ideally need a fix for this immediately if at all possible.  I believe this may be an issue that's lingered since the introduction of the new feature.  Thanks!  Todd    """

title: "User who has UpdatePassword set but has not logged in before the reset token expires cannnot do anything any more"
description: """When an admin selects """"User must change password"""", the user is marked as UpdatePassword and a reset token is generated (which is not sent to the user or anyone). But if the user waits too long the reset will not happen because the """"update password"""" logic is tied to the """"reset password"""" logic. The only way the user can still get access is to regenerate a token but this is not explained nor logical.    What should happen is that (like is done elsewhere for different purposes) the reset token is regenerated right before the redirect to the update password screen. Not at the """"update password"""" button click (although that code does no harm)."""

title: "Updating a role will remove the IsSystemRole flag"
description: """If a user goes into role management and updates a system role, then the system flag in the database is removed. This potentially allows an administrator to delete or alter critical system roles.    h2. Repro Steps  1. Login as Admin  2. Go to Admin > Security Roles  3. Edit a system role (e.g. Administrators)  4. Note that Role Group, Security Module, Status etc are all disabled and that there is no *delete* button.  5. Click the *update* button  6. Re-edit that same system role (e.g. Administrators)    h2. Expected   1. The role should remain a system role.  2. No disabled control in step 4 above should become enabled.  3. The *delete* button should not be available    h2. Actual  1. The *delete* button is visible  2. Multiple controls that were disabled in step 4 above are now editable.  3. The IsSystemRole flag in the database has been updated to false (0)."""

title: "Changes in ProfileController poses problems working with external membership"
description: """UpdateUserProfile in ProfileController has changed in DNN 7.4.2. The change poses problems with working with external membership stores.    The new code (in ProfileController.cs)    public static void UpdateUserProfile(UserInfo user)  {   if (!user.Profile.IsDirty)   {    return;   }     var portalId = GetEffectivePortalId(user.PortalID);   user.PortalID = portalId;     var oldUser = new UserInfo { UserID = user.UserID, PortalID = user.PortalID};   _profileProvider.GetUserProfile(ref oldUser);      _profileProvider.UpdateUserProfile(user);     //Remove the UserInfo from the Cache, as it has been modified   DataCache.ClearUserCache(user.PortalID, user.Username);     if (ProfileUpdated != null)   {    ProfileUpdated(null, new ProfileEventArgs { User = user, OldProfile = oldUser.Profile});   }  }          oldUser contains only UserID and PortalID. This is a problem working with external membership/profile when the username needs to be used as key to the profile store.    In our case we had to rewrite our profile provider to re-lookup the username from the DNN database, an unnessecary call.    ==================================================  I suggest the oldUser is redefined to:    var oldUser = new UserInfo { UserID = user.UserID, Username = user.Username, PortalID = user.PortalID}    ==================================================  It should allow for greater flexibility.    Best regards    Pedro  """
input_text:
Title: Changes in ProfileController poses problems working with external membership
Description: ""UpdateUserProfile in ProfileController has changed in DNN 7.4.2. The change poses problems with working with external membership stores. The new code (in ProfileController.cs) public static void UpdateUserProfile(UserInfo user) { if (!user.Profile.IsDirty) { return; } var portalId = GetEffectivePortalId(user.PortalID); user.PortalID = portalId; var oldUser = new UserInfo { UserID = user.UserID, PortalID = user.PortalID}; _profileProvider.GetUserProfile(ref oldUser); _profileProvider.UpdateUserProfile(user); //Remove the UserInfo from the Cache, as it has been modified DataCache.ClearUserCache(user.PortalID, user.Username); if (ProfileUpdated != null) { ProfileUpdated(null, new ProfileEventArgs { User = user, OldProfile = oldUser.Profile}); } } oldUser contains only UserID and PortalID. This is a problem working with external membership/profile when the username needs to be used as key to the profile store. In our case we had to rewrite our profile provider to re-lookup the username from the DNN database, an unnessecary call. ================================================== I suggest the oldUser is redefined to: var oldUser = new UserInfo { UserID = user.UserID, Username = user.Username, PortalID = user.PortalID} ================================================== It should allow for greater flexibility. Best regards Pedro ""

title: "Event Viewer : Allow for simplified Purge procedure"
description: """+Background+    The PurgeEventLog stored procedure can perform badly when the eventLog gets over a certain size.  This is often encountered when an exception is being created frequently by the application.  In these cases the purge event log is unable to complete.    In addition to the slow performance of the query, the structure of the PurgeEventLog query means that it selectively deletes event log types based on the number of rows to keep as per the EventLogConfig table.   This leads to confusing diagnosis in many cases as supporting statements are deleted, leaving an inaccurate timeline when looking back through time.    This change is to modify the PurgeEventLog stored procedure so that it can be changed to a rolling-date age based purge.  This should keep the log size relatively static over time, depending on the log age chosen and whether there has been an increase or decrease in log activity.    With options appearing for off-site log storage (Such as Application Insights and other solutions) the need to keep an extensive log history is redundant, and the Log table is frequently the source of slow database performance, database space failures and other issues.      Current PurgeEventLogCode    +Requirements+  * Add a new Host Setting which specifies the maximum age for EventLogs to be kept  ** This will be called 'EventLogKeepForDays'  ** For new installations and upgrades this value will be created and set to -1 (to keep existing behaviour)  * In the PurgeEventLog stored procedure, the logic will change to:    * Note that this logic will bypass the current logic which checks the number of events to keep for each event type in favour of just keeping a set number of days of logs - if the EventLogKeepForDays value is set, the logic will switch to a simple date based delete.      The purpose of this requirement is to allow people who have set up more comprehensive log preservation to keep the on-site logs small. """

title: "Use DateTime.UtcNow instead of DateTime.Now"
description: """Throughout the DNN code, there's a lot of incorrect uses of DateTime.Now to store values into the database. DateTime.Now is the representation of the configured timezone on the server (EST, CST, etc.). We should always be storing DateTime.UtcNow into the database so that values can be converted back to any local time, as needed. It makes DNN more portable when switching hosting providers in different geographical data centers because UTC datetime is always the same regardless of timezone or daylight saving. To be truly enterprise ready and secure, DNN needs a consistent way to store date and time.    There is also a performance benefit to switch, because DateTime.UtcNow is many times faster than DateTime.Now. The .NET implementation of DateTime.Now is actually taking DateTime.UtcNow and converting it to local time of the server so it's doing a lot of unnecessary arithmetic.    [https://blogs.msdn.microsoft.com/kirillosenkov/2012/01/10/datetime-utcnow-is-generally-preferable-to-datetime-now/]  [https://dzone.com/articles/darkness-behind-datetimenow]  """

description: """It is common for packages to include a [config component|http://www.dnnsoftware.com/wiki/manifest-config-component] in their manifest if they require any adjustments to the {{web.config}} file.  On initial install, this change will be made correctly.  However, this component will also run on upgrades (ensuring that the config is correctly in place), and the vast majority of the time, won't do anything, since it was done on install.  The problem is that the config component still updates the {{web.config}} file, even if no changes are being made, which causes the website to be restarted unnecessarily.    I've attached a modified version of the Xcillion theme package which adds support for the {{woff}} and {{woff2}} font file formats.  When installing this a second time, it should not require restarting the site, but currently DNN will restart the site anyway."""

description: """By default, running advanced URL format, the resulting URL looks like this:    http://site.com/pagename/param1    The TransformFriendlyUrlToQueryString method that needs to be implemented by providers will see the correct urlParms parameter containing 1 array entry:     urlParms {string[1]} string[]    [0] """"param1"""" string    As soon as you enable multiple languages on a site under Admin > Languages, it automatically creates site aliases with entries like *site.com/en-us* and *site.com/en-ca*    http://site.com/en-us/pagename/param1  http://site.com/en-ca/pagename/param1    Notice the urlParms parameter is incorrectly populated breaking the parser in the URL extension provider. The URL extension provider is unable to correctly guess and separate between what is actual query parameter and page:    urlParms {string[3]} string[]    [0] """"en-us"""" string    [1] """"pagename"""" string    [2] """"param1"""" string    To confirm the inconsistency, the article here [http://www.dnnsoftware.com/wiki/extension-url-providers] states the urlParms parameter should exclude the page path (and therefore language too).    *urlParms : a string array of the URL segments (/segment1/segment2) in the URL """"after"""" the site alias & page path have been matched and removed from the entire URL. In this example, it would be an array of 1 position with 'My-Item' in it.*    Please fix this ASAP as it breaks the advanced URL provider badly."""

title: "accessing link url of other portal causes 500 server error"
description: """according to owasp this is a security vulnerability it should return a 404 or something instead of internal 500 server error (which could lead to DDOS vulnerability and/or information disclosure) {quote} Finding # 2570682 First Time Detected 06 Feb 2016 06:00 GMT Group Information Disclosure Last Time Detected 20 Feb 2016 20:00 GMT CWE - Last Time Tested 20 Feb 2016 20:00 GMT OWASP A5 Security Misconfiguration Times Detected 2 WASC WASC-15 Application Misconfiguration CVSS Base 5 CVSS Temporal4 Details Threat A test payload generated a syntax error within the Web application. This often points to a problem with input validation routines or lack of filters on user-supplied content. Impact A malicious user may be able to create a denial of service, serious error, or exploit depending on the error encountered by the Web application. Solution The Web application should restrict user-supplied data to consist of a minimal set of characters necessary for the input field. title: "Deleting a tab should delete all redirect references to that tab."
description: """Currently if you create a page, and set that page to redirect to a page on your site, if you delete that page that it is redirecting to, the page will still try to redirect to the non-existing page. I think it would be better to update tabs that were redirecting to the page to remove the redirect.    This was also causing a problem with exporting a site when it had a tab that was redirecting to a tab that didn't exist. The export would fail with a critical exception.    The proposed fix will add a message to warn users that deleting the page will remove the redirect messages, remove redirect references when a page is deleted, and handle exporting for sites that already have invalid records in the database.    Steps to reproduce.    1. Login to a site as a superuser.   2. Browse to Admin > Pages.   3. Right click the root node and select Add Pages.  4. Add 2 new pages. IE """"Test Page 1"""" & """"Test Page 2""""  5. Set """"Test Page 1"""" to redirect to """"Test Page 2"""" and Update.  6. Delete """"Test Page 2"""".  7. Notice that """"Test Page 1"""" still has a Link setting for Page (A Page on Your Site), but the dropdown says """"Select a Page"""". If you query the database for this, it still contains the TabId for the old page.  8. Browse to Host > Site Management.  9. Select """"Export Site Template"""".  10. Select the current site, enter a name and description and check all the boxes.  11. Notice the critical exception."""

Description: ""Currently if you create a page, and set that page to redirect to a page on your site, if you delete that page that it is redirecting to, the page will still try to redirect to the non-existing page. I think it would be better to update tabs that were redirecting to the page to remove the redirect. This was also causing a problem with exporting a site when it had a tab that was redirecting to a tab that didn't exist. The export would fail with a critical exception. The proposed fix will add a message to warn users that deleting the page will remove the redirect messages, remove redirect references when a page is deleted, and handle exporting for sites that already have invalid records in the database. Steps to reproduce. 1. Login to a site as a superuser. 2. Browse to Admin > Pages. 3. Right click the root node and select Add Pages. 4. Add 2 new pages. IE """"Test Page 1"""" & """"Test Page 2"""" 5. Set """"Test Page 1"""" to redirect to """"Test Page 2"""" and Update. 6. Delete """"Test Page 2"""". 7. Notice that """"Test Page 1"""" still has a Link setting for Page (A Page on Your Site), but the dropdown says """"Select a Page"""". If you query the database for this, it still contains the TabId for the old page. 8. Browse to Host > Site Management. 9. Select """"Export Site Template"""". 10. Select the current site, enter a name and description and check all the boxes. 11. Notice the critical exception.""

title: "GetModulesByDefinition method should use caching for faster performance"
description: """The ModuleController.GetModulesByDefinition() method should perform a cache lookup to avoid querying the database like its counterpart GetModuleByDefinition() method is already doing. The GetModuleByDefinition is limited to returning the first arbitrary module only, which is less useful than the GetModulesByDefinition that returns the full information.    Any relatively complex module with more than one module definition that requires figuring out if other supporting modules are added to the site will call this method, often for as many module definitions it has leading to multiple database queries per page. For example, a shopping cart module has many cross-functional links on the shopping page that needs to figure out if the category, product list, product detail, cart modules are present will query the database repeatedly leading to poor performance.    Unfortunately, this method call cannot be cached by the calling application because it has no way to properly invalidate the cache (when page is deleted, module removed from page, etc.) that only the core library can know.    The cache implementation should be quite easy to implement simply by following/reusing the similar cache code in the GetModuleByDefinition method.    Thanks,"""

title: "Do not use dot in folder names"
description: """There are a number of users and Hosters, who use urlscan tool on their server.  By default, this tool blocks access to paths with dots (.) in its name.  DNN 8 introduces versioning for default.css, moving it to   * /Resources/Shared/stylesheets/dnndefault/7.0.0/ and  * /Resources/Shared/stylesheets/dnndefault/8.0.0/ folder.  As a result. the default.css file is not loaded and all site administration is messed up.  These folders should be renamed not to contain a dot, e,g. by removing the dots or replacing them with another character, e,g. a dash (-)."""
input_text:
Title: Do not use dot in folder names
Description: ""There are a number of users and Hosters, who use urlscan tool on their server. By default, this tool blocks access to paths with dots (.) in its name. As a result. the default.css file is not loaded and all site administration is messed up. These folders should be renamed not to contain a dot, e,g. by removing the dots or replacing them with another character, e,g. a dash (-).""

title: "Allow Override of prefixing Service to Username for OAuth providers."
description: """The fix for DNN-4133 was to add a prefix for the service to the beginning of the username. This broke our custom OAuth provider and I believe that we should have the ability to override whether we want to prefix the service to the Username in OAuth providers.  In addition to allowing that overriding, this also implements the option to automatically associate logins to existing users, based on email.    Testing of this API change will require a custom OAuth provider implementation which sets the new {{PrefixServiceToUserName}} and {{AutoMatchExistingUsers}} properties in that provider's implementation of {{OAuthClientBase}} to {{false}} and {{true}}, respectively.  That custom provider may be an existing provider (e.g. Facebook), tweaked to override those two properties.    When configured as mentioned above, the username of users who log in via that provider should be the user's email (as provided by the OAuth provider).  Additionally, if a user with that email address as their username already exists, that OAuth login would be associated with the existing account, rather than trying to create a new account."""

Unfortunately, there's currently no way for us to indicate to DNN when to include certain tokens, and when not to.  We are forced to always include all scripts/CSS regardless to the use case.      At a minimum, we should be able to indicate which web browser(s)/version(s) that a script needs to be included for.  For example IE shims.
