title: "dnnModal shows incorrect height in mobile view"
description: """The dnnModal is used to display content for Login, Register and including Web pages from external sites. In particular, hosted payment pages is used to collect credit card information in an IFRAME uses the dnnModal for popup. It appears the recent dnnModal JS checks for mobile and started ignoring the height specified in the API call causing the pop up to display very narrowly in height on mobile devices. It may be ignoring the width too, but I didn't test it. Below is an example call to the API that supposedly allows you to pass the width and height but is now being ignored in mobile view:    dnnModal.show(""""http://somewhere.com"""", false, """"300px"""", """"200px"""", false);    Notice, the first attachment (BeforeCoffee.png) shows the incorrect height making it very difficult for customers to enter their credit card information for payment leading to lost sales. The 2nd attachment (AfterCoffee.png) shows what it should look like if it was properly sized.    In my opinion, I think the width and height should be left to the caller and not hardcoded by the API. Since it's javascript, the caller has many means to perform its own size detection (even if mobile) and knows to call the correct size to display for the type of content it needs.    I was able to workaround it by hardcoding the following rules in the portal CSS:    .dnnFormPopup.dnnFormPopupMobileView  {      height: 80% !important;  }    iframe#iPopUp  {      height: 100% !important;  }    """

title: "Profanity filter definition issues"
description: """The following problems have been detected trying to define profanity filters.    By default, this filter is defined in a clean install:  Text=FindThisText, Value=ReplaceWithNothing    Note that Text can have duplicates, but Value can't.    In the case we would need to define filters so several prohibited words change to """"censored"""", we would need to define:  - Text=ProhibitedWord1, Value=censored  - Text=ProhibitedWord2, Value=censored  This is not possible, as value can't have duplicates    In the other hand, it is possible to create other filters like:  - Text=SomeProhibitedWord, Value=aaaa  - Text=SomeProhibitedWord, Value=bbbb  In this case, it is not well defined to which value, the appareances of 'SomeProhibitedWord' will be replaced to.    Summarizing, for profanity, the duplicate check would need to be done for Text, not for Value."""

title: "Memory Cacheing does NOT work woth multiple langauges"
description: """The Memory caching provider does not cache websites that run multiple languages.    I've created this problem with a fresh install of DNN7.4.2, using a single language en-US the caching provider works OK.    If you have a website with  fr-FR   en-US  en-GB (fallback to system default)    The caching stops working.    The function  DotNetNuke.Common.Utilities.DataCache.SetCache(cacheKey, objObject, absoluteExpiration);    Works and the data store with the cachekey can be retrieved directly after the setting of the cache, however on page refresh the GetCache() function returns null.    If en-GB and en-US are disactivated, then the caching again works correctly.    Re-activating en-GB or en-US will stop the caching from working again.    If File caching option is selected in Host Settings all caching works as expected.    A change in DNN 7.2.2 sets the default to memory (DNN-26708) , a quick fix is to revert back to the old file caching default should be done, until a good solution can be implemented."""

If you have a website with fr-FR en-US en-GB (fallback to system default) The caching stops working. The function DotNetNuke.Common.Utilities.DataCache.SetCache(cacheKey, objObject, absoluteExpiration); Works and the data store with the cachekey can be retrieved directly after the setting of the cache, however on page refresh the GetCache() function returns null. If en-GB and en-US are disactivated, then the caching again works correctly. Re-activating en-GB or en-US will stop the caching from working again. If File caching option is selected in Host Settings all caching works as expected. A change in DNN 7.2.2 sets the default to memory (DNN-26708) , a quick fix is to revert back to the old file caching default should be done, until a good solution can be implemented.""

title: "Pages > Link-URL: Quit adding http:// if URL starts with ""#"""
description: """When building """"One Page Design"""" sites with DNN (quite popular in times of tables and mobile devices), it's a common task to point your page-URLs (=menu items) to text anchors (ex. """"#section1"""", """"#section2"""",..) inside the current page.    The URL-picker component in the Page > Link-URL dialog keeps adding a """"http://"""" to the beginning of the """"URL"""". This behavior forces the user to pick an absolute path to make the link work in the generated menu (""""http://www.myurl.com/#section1""""). If you only enter a relative """"#section1"""" as """"URL"""", the component will render the link as """"http://#section1"""", which will lead to a broken link.    In scenarios where there are multiple site-aliases, this turns out to be a little annoying, since it forces the user to switch to the """"primary"""" domain (or the one defined in the menu), as soon as he clicks on one of the menu items (=text anchors in this scenario).    Solution: Make the URL-dialog of the Link-Component a little less strict: Let the user add text-anchors (""""#section1"""") without 'automatically' adding a 'http://' in front of the URL, at least, if the """"URL"""" starts with """"#"""".    What do you think?"""

title: "Web links that can break a page with Journal stream (/w solution)"
description:
"""Greetings all, today I would like to highlight n issue we came across not long ago relating to posting web links into Journal stream.    As we all know DNN has been great at scraping of web page contents anytime a link is posted. But there exist the possibility of that link breaking your page.    Long story short one of our clients included a link to rte.ie article which to my surprise included a 4000+ character description which would obviously overflow ItemData column in Journal table.    To fix this problem I've included a crude yet simple loop to truncate a description to fit 2000 character limit just before ItemData is set during save/update procedures.    Now it is important to note that ItemData is essentially JSON encoded string with the following properties:      * Url      * Title      * Description      * ImageUrl      * Cacheability    Five properties that supposed to fit into 2000 characters is a tricky task in it self as there is no set limit to how long a Url, Title, Description or ImageUrl can be. But in my case it was clear that Description was just out of proportions resulting in truncated ItemData value which was impossible to convert into back into object.    Example of good ItemData after description has been truncated to fit:  {""""ImageUrl"""":""""http://img.rasset.ie/00076520-500.jpg"""",""""Title"""":""""Winning Stories & Shortlist 2014 - Francis MacManus 
Short Story Competition - RTÉ Radio 1"""",""""Description"""":""""RTÉ Radio 1 is delighted to announce that the winner of this year’s Francis Mac Manus Short Story Competition 2015 is Eleanor O’Reilly for her story ‘Stoppin’ the Silence’. 

Dolores Walshe has been awarded  2nd prize for her story ‘Small Yellow Sun’ and Kathryn Burke’s story ‘Irish Gothic: Waiting For Samhain’  has won 3rd prize.

Winner of the Francis Mac Manus Short Story Competition 2015 

Eleanor O’Reilly teaches English and Classical Studies at The Community School in Gorey, Co. Wexford.  She began writing one morning, three years ago, over a bowl of porridge, while on maternity leave. Since then she has won a number of awards and commendations, including winning the Trevor/Bowen International Short Story Award 2013, the Writing4Autism 2014 and being shortlisted for the James Plunkett Literary Award 2013 and the Fish Short Story Award 2014.   She is currently studying for a Master’s in Creative Writing and is half way through her first novel, as part of the Master’s programme.

She lives in Arklow, Co. Wicklow with her husband and daughter and their two dogs.

The judges described ‘Stoppin’ the Silence’ as  a ‘stand-out’ story, which managed to be ‘very funny, very sad and very clever’.  They praised the author’s skill in using a child’s voice to deal with very tricky subject matter.

‘Stoppin’ the Silence’ by Eleanor O’Reilly will be broadcast on RTÉ Radio 1 at 11.10pm on Monday, October 5th.  It will be read by Genevieve Hulme-Beaman.

2nd Prize 

The winner of the 2nd prize is Dolores Walshe for her story ‘Small Yellow Sun’.

The judges described this story as ‘deeply affecting’, told in a voice that really drew the reader"""",""""Url"""":""""http://www.rte.ie/radio1/francis-macmanus-short-story/generic/2014/0709/629559-winning-stories-and-shortlist-2014/"""",""""Cacheability"""":10}    And if you wish to find out what the bad ItemData will be just copy and paste the Url part into your Journal and post a message. Be warned that this will break your page and you will need to manually fix ItemData column by completing JSON syntax.      *On to the fix*  There are two function (which can be found in Library/Services/Journal/JournalControllerImpl.cs) that can cause this problem namely:        public void SaveJournalItem(JournalItem journalItem, int tabId, int moduleId) { }      public void UpdateJournalItem(JournalItem journalItem, int tabId, int moduleId) { }    Each one has a line of code that sets what will be stored in ItemData column:        string journalData = journalItem.ItemData.ToJson();    And to work around the problem I just added the following loop to reduce the length of Description property until the whole thing fits 2000 character limit:        while (journalItem.ItemData.ToJson().Length > 2000)      {          journalItem.ItemData.Description = journalItem.ItemData.Description.Substring(0, journalItem.ItemData.Description.Length - 5);      }      string journalData = journalItem.ItemData.ToJson();    Each time while loops over ItemData property it removes 5 characters from description until the condition is no longer valid at which point it should be safe to set the JSON string.    Again just to reiterate on one important point. Because there is no hard length limit on ItemData properties in theory it can happen where say Url property may take up the whole 2000 character limit. But in practice no one uses Urls that long. However, there are other properties that may be quite lengthy so just be aware that Description is not the only problem property."""

title: "Journal Get More button not displaying when deleted records are present"
description: """This is a trivial issue that we have had to deal with for a long time now. Basically Journals Get More button in certain circumstances was not being displayed when we knew for a fact there were more records in the systems. At first we just though is something to do with time. As in id the system is abandoned for a while the posts go stale. But today we have traced this issue right down to its root which was hidden in stored procedures and it turned out that its not the records that were becoming stale but deleted records preventing correct number of good records being returned.     IF EXISTS(SELECT * from dbo.[Journal_TypeFilters] WHERE ModuleId = @ModuleId)   INSERT INTO @j     SELECT j.journalid, jt.datecreated from (     SELECT DISTINCT js.JournalId from dbo.[Journal] as j      INNER JOIN dbo.[Journal_Security] as js ON js.JournalId = j.JournalId      INNER JOIN dbo.[Journal_User_Permissions](@PortalId,@CurrentUserId ,1) as t        ON t.seckey = js.SecurityKey AND (js.SecurityKey = 'R' + CAST(@GroupId as nvarchar(100)) OR js.SecurityKey = 'E')       --WHERE j.PortalId = @PortalId       WHERE ((@IncludeAllItems = 0) AND (j.PortalId = @PortalId AND j.IsDeleted = @IsDeleted))          OR         ((@IncludeAllItems = 1) AND (j.PortalId = @PortalId))     ) as j INNER JOIN dbo.[Journal] jt ON jt.JournalId = j.JournalId AND jt.PortalId = @PortalId AND jt.GroupId = @GroupId     INNER JOIN dbo.[Journal_TypeFilters] as jf ON jf.JournalTypeId = jt.JournalTypeId AND jf.ModuleId = @ModuleId     ORDER BY jt.DateCreated DESC, jt.JournalId DESC;   ELSE   INSERT INTO @j     SELECT j.journalid, jt.datecreated from (     SELECT DISTINCT js.JournalId from dbo.[Journal] as j      INNER JOIN dbo.[Journal_Security] as js ON js.JournalId = j.JournalId      INNER JOIN dbo.[Journal_User_Permissions](@PortalId,@CurrentUserId ,1) as t        ON t.seckey = js.SecurityKey AND (js.SecurityKey = 'R' + CAST(@GroupId as nvarchar(100)) OR js.SecurityKey = 'E')       --WHERE j.PortalId = @PortalId       WHERE ((@IncludeAllItems = 0) AND (j.PortalId = @PortalId AND j.IsDeleted = @IsDeleted))          OR         ((@IncludeAllItems = 1) AND (j.PortalId = @PortalId))     ) as j INNER JOIN dbo.[Journal] jt ON jt.JournalId = j.JournalId AND jt.PortalId = @PortalId AND jt.GroupId = @GroupId     ORDER BY jt.DateCreated DESC, jt.JournalId DESC;      I've attached a screenshot of the same code just so I can point out where the issue was occurring.    Lines 8 and 22 show where I commented out original WHERE clause.  Lines 9-11 and 23-25 show what I replaced them with.    I had to do this in order to get around the issue created by deleted records in the final SELECT statement's WHERE clause. I am not sure why the procedures are setup the way they are as it would make more sense to check for IsDeleted at the very start and not have deleted records trickle down all the way to the final select only to run into a problem where deleted records get filtered resulting in fewer records being returned then can/should be returned.    Stored procedures that this affects:  [Journal_ListForGroup]  [Journal_ListForGroupSinceDate]  [Journal_ListForProfile]  [Journal_ListForSummary]    I am not entirely sure how long this has been around but looking as it hasn't been a fix in 7.4.2 no one has reported this as a problem."""

title: "Security practices recommendation in DNN source code - ValidateAntiForgeryToken"
description: """Hi Developers,    I’ve noticed in few controllers methods that this pattern is used:  [HttpGet]  [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]   needs to be removed    The anti-forgery token is needed only for POST (and PUT) requests and is useless for GET ones (just an extra unnecessary overhead that hurts the performance). So, remember to use it as follows only:  [HttpPost]  [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]   must be added  """

title: "Remove the revision part from built assemblies"
description: """In DNN products every new build has a new assembly version with the 'revision' part set to the build number.    I suggest removing the 'revision' part from the {{AssemblyVersion}}, but keep it in the {{AssemblyFileVersion}}. This makes testing with various DLL's much easier during the development time.    For example, I can drop {{DotNetNuke.dll}} file from a newer build into my local installation without having to replace all the DLL's that depend on that specific previous build of this file. Therefore, we avoid the YSOD errors of ASP.NET in such cases during testing a small change in the Platform main library without the need to create a complete build of the whole site.      The same can be applied to all built DLL files."""

description: """When using the WebApi since the request to the controller will also remove the child portal sub folder the code loads the wrong portal instance. When on a child portal of www.test.com/child the controller will be called on the url  ww.test.com/... hence why the wrong portal instance is then loaded in the DNN WebApi code.    This will only effect child portals but since the move is now away to MVC and SPA modules this really needs to work on child portals.   I always develop in a child portal and hence why I found this bug which stopped by SPA module from working."""

title: "DCC Viewer: Miss Edit Content menu item when first time visit module edit menu. "
description: """I was using local install of build 446 on IE11  It only happens on the first time in editing mode after module created. If close the """"Edit mode"""" and come back again, it works fine.     - Log in as host, created a new page  - On the new page, drop a DCC Viewer module there.   - Right after module created, there is a """"Quick-Setting"""" pop-up. Pick up """"Employee"""" content type.   - Click on the """"Pencil"""" editing menu icon.    Result:   Only """"Edit Template"""" menu item there, but couldn't find """"Edit Content"""".   http://screencast.com/t/hSEgPY60"""

When the LOGIN skin object is executed as last in the skin file (that is after LOGIN, USER and LOGO skin objects) in a multi-language portal, the PortalAlias of PortalSettings is left set with the PortalAlias of the last processed language, thus causing, for example, situations where PortalSetting.CultureCode is set to a language and PortaAlias is the one of a different one. Description: ""When using DotNetNuke.Services.FileSystem.FileManager.Instance.MoveFile(IFileInfo, IFolderInfo) to move a file to a different folder *on a different portal*: result: * file is moved in the file system * Files table: FolderId is correctly updated * Files table: PortalId is still the old PortalId expected result: * file is moved in the file system * Files table: FolderId is correctly updated * Files table: PortalId is the new PortalId suggested fix: alter the stored procedure UpdateFile so that the PortalId is updated along with the FolderId: ALTER PROCEDURE {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}UpdateFile] @FileId Int, @VersionGuid UniqueIdentifier, @FileName nVarChar(246), @Extension nVarChar(100), @Size Int, @Width Int, @Height Int, @ContentType nVarChar(200), @FolderID Int, @LastModifiedByUserID Int, @Hash VarChar(40), @LastModificationTime DateTime, @Title nVarChar(256), @EnablePublishPeriod Bit, @StartDate DateTime, @EndDate DateTime, @ContentItemID Int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @PortalID int; SELECT @PortalID = PortalID FROM {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}Folders] WHERE FolderID = @FolderID; UPDATE {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}Files] SET FileName = @FileName, VersionGuid = @VersionGuid, Extension = @Extension, Size = @Size, Width = @Width, Height = @Height, ContentType = @ContentType, FolderID = @FolderID, PortalID = @PortalID; LastModifiedByUserID = @LastModifiedByUserID, LastModifiedOnDate = GetDate(), SHA1Hash = @Hash, LastModificationTime = @LastModificationTime, Title = @Title, EnablePublishPeriod = @EnablePublishPeriod, StartDate = @StartDate, EndDate = @EndDate, ContentItemID = @ContentItemID WHERE FileId = @FileId SET NOCOUNT OFF; END""

title: "DCC API - Dynamic Content Item is tied to Module Id"
description: """In the current architecture the Dynamic Content Item instance is tied to a specific module. The Content Item table stores the ModuleId and the TabId:  !DynamicContentItemTiedToModule.png!    Basically the content item is who says: """"I belong to the module"""" when we should invert the relationship and the module should say: """"I in charge to render the content item"""".  We want the content item decoupled of the viewer so we potencially can share and integrate this content outside the dnn system or the viewer module.    The Viewer makes use of this information to know which Content Item is associated with him:      *Solution proposal*:  We should store the Content Item with no TabId or ModuleId associated and store in the Module Setting instead the Content Item Id of the Dynamic Content.  Currently the Module already use Module Setting to know which content type is used and which Edit and View template is set:  !DynamicViewerModuleSettings.png!    Note: we could eventually replace the Content Type Setting with Content Item Id.  * DCC_ContentItemId      *Important Notes*    * *Note for Dev*: we need to review the scenario where the Module is deleted. Probably for this first version we want also be able to remove the Content Item from the system as well. Need to confirmed with PM.    * *Note for QA*: this task is more API level and does not imply changes in funcionality. Just how the relationship between the content item and the module is defined."""

title: "Cannot edit Dynamic Content item when value has comma"
description: """When saving a content item in the DCC Viewer module, if there is a string data field with a comma in the value, there is an error thrown.  This does not affect Rich Text or Markdown, because they are handled differently.  It would also, theoretically, affect Integer or Float fields if a comma was in the value (e.g. as a decimal or thousands separator).    The culprit is the {{GetValueOrDefault}} call in {{ViewerController.ProcessFields}}, which uses {{ToLookup}}, which splits values on commas (in {{ParseValues}}).    For example, but the DCC Viewer module on the page, select _Employee_ as the content type, and save.  Reload the page, then select _Edit Content_ from the action menu.  Enter content with a comma into one of the text fields (e.g. set the Title to _Vice President, Marketing and Sales_), and click the Save button.  You should see a couple of errors, one that looks like this:    """

title: "oAuth Support - We shouldn't allow oAuth to be enabled if oAuth Library not enabled"
description: """In the new oAuth Server implementation if you turn on oAuth in Host > Host Settings > Other Settings we throw a labelled warning in the UI:  *Warning: The OAuth library must be installed for OAuth server support to work*  And then we allow enabling oAuth Authorization even though the Library has not yet been installed.    It would actually be better UI/UX if we *did not allow oAuth Authorization to be enabled* and threw a pop up that said something like:  *The oAuth Library is not installed. Please click here to install it then enable oAuth Authorization*    Install or upgrade to Platform 8 (i used build 373)  Log in as HOST  Go Host > Host Settings > Other Settings  Scroll to the bottom of the page  Tick the box for """"*Enable OAuth Authorization*""""  Click """"Update""""    Actual Result:  You see a text warning label:    *Warning: The OAuth library must be installed of OAuth server support to work*    And the check box is enabled even though all the pieces are not installed in the application    Expected Result:  If you tick the box for """"*Enable OAuth Authorization*"""" a check is done to verify the OAuth Library is installed.    If it is then no messaging and when the blue """"Update"""" button is clicked changes are saved and persist.    If it is not then when the check fails a pop up renders with text like:  *The OAuth Library is not installed. Please go here (linked text to Host > Extensions > Available Extensions) and install the Library now.*    """

title: "JS Libraries requested during PreRender are not included in page"
description: """When a control (module, skin, etc.) requests a JavaScript library, that request is not honored if it is made during the {{PreRender}} event. title: "admin/host module adding from the manifest breaks with page names that dont match the tabpath"
description: """There is a bug in the dnn-7485 code    I create the page based on the page name e.g. """"Recycle Bin"""",  but try to delete it based on the tabpath ie. """"//Admin/RecyleBin"""" - this means  that if a module has a space in it's page name this fails to delete the page  (""""//Admin/Recycle Bin"""" doesn't exist as a tabpath. This only affects a few of  the admin modules, others such as console, dashboard, languages, lists etc. all  work as they're single words without spaces.       This needs to be fixed by storing the tabid as it is immutable. (note we have to extend Joe's new structure for admin/host pages @ https://dnntracker.atlassian.net/browse/DNN-7565)         Note: we need to add some sql to set  the tabId so that the next CTP/beta fixes this for any CTP6 users.    """
input_text:
Title: admin/host module adding from the manifest breaks with page names that dont match the tabpath
Description: ""There is a bug in the dnn-7485 code I create the page based on the page name e.g. """"Recycle Bin"""", but try to delete it based on the tabpath ie. """"//Admin/RecyleBin"""" - this means that if a module has a space in it's page name this fails to delete the page (""""//Admin/Recycle Bin"""" doesn't exist as a tabpath. This only affects a few of the admin modules, others such as console, dashboard, languages, lists etc. all work as they're single words without spaces. This needs to be fixed by storing the tabid as it is immutable. (note we have to extend Joe's new structure for admin/host pages @ https://dnntracker.atlassian.net/browse/DNN-7565) Note: we need to add some sql to set the tabId so that the next CTP/beta fixes this for any CTP6 users. ""

title: "PortalController.DeletePortalSetting clears cache but does not remove PortalSettingsDictionary from current HttpContext if any, which can lead to inconsistencies"
description: """As the summaries says, not only the cache must be cleared but the dictionary of portalsettings must be removed from current http context if any.    One test case where it fails, is when you clear or update a setting and save again the same setting within the same httprequest. The UpdatePortalSetting method uses the httpcontext dictionary through GetPortalSettingsDictionary to check if the value changed, it is not aware that the setting has been cleared or changed, and as a result, the second save will be cancelled.    The fix should be to remove the dictionary from the httpcontext if any, in all places where only the cache is currently cleared (Update, Delete etc.)    On a related note but of less importance, the PortalSettings.Timezone property setter, which is called when building the portalsettings on each requests, ends up calling unnecessary UpdatePortalSetting on each request, but that does not result on a database call, which would have been detected, but instead is intercepted by the same mechanism involving the httpcontext dictionary through GetPortalSettingsDictionary. It is still probably a bad idea that the setter that is regularly invoked on non transient instances is attached to that update call."""

title: "File Manager > StandardFolderProvider GetUrl uses LinkClick for file with parentesis in the name"
description: """In the StandardFolderProvider.GetUrl method there is a check that makes use of LinkClick for file with invalid URL characters in the name:     This is done to use LinkClick when IIS cannot serve the file. Likely some old version of IIS was not able to serve url with parentesis. I have tested with IIS 8 and is able to serve fine images with parentesis in the name."""

title: "Allow releases without an initial incremental file to support incremental upgrades"
description: """When a DNN website has an application domain recycle a check is made to see if an incremental file exists to see if an incremental upgrade may occur (i.e. where the DNN version has not changed but an xx.xx.xx.xx.sqldataprovider exists)    At present this check has a few short-circuits to ensure it doesn't affect performance after app domain recycle. For instance if the dotnetnuke.dll assembly version is less than 7.4.2 then an incremental check is not done as incremental updates did not exist in versions prior to that release.    A second check occurs to see if more than 1 incremental exists - this is based on the assumption that a release that will support incremental updates will have at least one xx.xx.xx.xx.sqldataprovider initially so that the """"increment"""" column in the """"version"""" table is populated. If more than 1 file of that naming structure exists we then run a stored procedure to see if the last applied increment is < than the number of incremental files (and if not then run the code to apply the incremental sql, config and cleanup changes). By doing this second check we can avoid doing the stored procedure call for the case where only 1 incremental file exists.    However the 7.4.2 beta release did not contain a xx.xx.xx.xx.sqldataprovider file so this second check returns false (as only 1 incremental file exists and it assumes that's been applied by the beta). We need to remove this second check to support 7.4.2 beta being upgraded and to support any future releases that do not contain an incremental file when releasing an upgradeable beta/ctp."""

title: "SI: Template import 'Replace' overwrites ALL content and pages"
description: """When importing a template with several pages of content, using the 'Replace' option is overwriting ALL pages / content. The expected behaviour would be that it only replaces duplicate pages / content.    As described in the User Manual: """"Replace: Deletes the existing copy of the duplicate content and replaces it with the template copy""""    Steps to replicate:  1) Create a new child portal  2) On the Child portal, delete all pages, except for the Home Page.   3) Also, create a 'New Page' for testing purposes (The only pages on the child portal should be Home & New Page)  4) From the default Parent Portal create a template (which will contain Home & Our )  5) From the child portal navigate to Admin > Site Wizard  6) Import that template using the Replace option    Actual Result  The child portal pages have ALL been overwritten. The pages now displayed are Home, About Us, Our Products & Contact Us.    Expected Result  Home page should have been overwritten (as it is a duplicate). The existing 'New Page' should not have been overwritten. The other template page 'Our Products' should have been added to the child portal as a new page.    * Tested the above steps in Evoq 8.2 and the same results occurred, whereby template pages / content replaced ALL pages / content on the target portal  """

title: "PortalAliasRouteManager function GetRouteName returns wrong Name when ApplicationPath is not empty"
description: """This is related to the way Route names are built from aliases counting segments.    When Routes are initially registered, in ServicesRoutingManager.MapHttpRoute, method PortalAliasRouteManager.GetRoutePrefixCounts is called, and that method uses PortalAliasRouteManager.StripApplicationPath(aliases) before calling PortalAliasRouteManager.CalcAliasPrefixCount() when counting the prefix segments.    Conversely, method PortalAliasRouteManager.GetRouteName(string moduleFolderName, string routeName, PortalAliasInfo portalAlias), makes a direct calls to CalcAliasPrefixCount, which returns an greater integer when ApplicationPath is not empty.    This results in a crash when calling UrlHelperExtensions.DnnLink(this UrlHelper urlHelper, string moduleFolderName, string routeName, object routeValues), which is quite significant.    It shouldn't be too hard to make those 2 alternate code paths consistent. """
input_text:
Title: PortalAliasRouteManager function GetRouteName returns wrong Name when ApplicationPath is not empty
Description: ""This is related to the way Route names are built from aliases counting segments. When Routes are initially registered, in ServicesRoutingManager.MapHttpRoute, method PortalAliasRouteManager.GetRoutePrefixCounts is called, and that method uses PortalAliasRouteManager.StripApplicationPath(aliases) before calling PortalAliasRouteManager.CalcAliasPrefixCount() when counting the prefix segments. Conversely, method PortalAliasRouteManager.GetRouteName(string moduleFolderName, string routeName, PortalAliasInfo portalAlias), makes a direct calls to CalcAliasPrefixCount, which returns an greater integer when ApplicationPath is not empty. This results in a crash when calling UrlHelperExtensions.DnnLink(this UrlHelper urlHelper, string moduleFolderName, string routeName, object routeValues), which is quite significant. It shouldn't be too hard to make those 2 alternate code paths consistent. ""

title: "Fix DNN-4133 introduces a major bug for all code that call AspNetMembershipProvider.CreateUser and happens to have a parameter named 'state' in the request"
description: """In version 7.2.1 issue DNN-4133 is fixed in an inappropiate manner.    If the AspNetMembershipProvider CreateUser method happens to find a parameter named 'state' in the Request.Params object, it bluntly takes over the user.UserName passed to the CreateUser method and replaces it (!) with whatever it finds in the 'state' parameter, prefixed to the user.Email.    The code is intended to fix a specific (LiveID) OAuth issue, but does not check whether it is excecuted within OAuth context.  Even within OAuth context, it is not correct to make any assumptions about the contents of the 'state' parameter and its suitability for use in the UserName,    A quote from The state parameter according to the Google Oauth 2.0 docs:  _[state] Indicates any state which may be useful to your application upon receipt of the response. The Google Authorization Server roundtrips this parameter, so your application receives the same value it sent. Possible uses include redirecting the user to the correct resource in your site, nonces, and cross-site-request-forgery mitigations._    Please remove this fix. Consider fixing the specific OAuth issue outside of the generic AspNetMembershipProvider.CreateUser method - if your OAuth implementation needs a different UserName, i.m.h.o. it should pass in a different UserName to the CreateUser call."""

Steps to reproduce:  * Download and install a fresh copy of DNN Platform 7.4.1  * Alter web.config to use   {quote}<add name=""""AspNetSqlMembershipProvider"""" type=""""System.Web.Security.SqlMembershipProvider"""" connectionStringName=""""SiteSqlServer"""" minRequiredPasswordLength=""""8"""" minRequiredNonalphanumericCharacters=""""1"""" maxInvalidPasswordAttempts=""""3"""" passwordAttemptWindow=""""10"""" enablePasswordReset=""""true"""" requiresQuestionAndAnswer=""""true"""" requiresUniqueEmail=""""true"""" passwordFormat=""""Hashed"""" applicationName=""""DotNetNuke"""" description=""""Stores and retrieves membership data from the local Microsoft SQL Server database"""" />{quote}  * Create a new user, noting password question answer  * Initiate password reset for new user: Login > Reset Password  * Provide username/email address  * Click """"Send Reset Link""""  * You are prompted to provide password question's answer.  * Provide any value for the answer, specifically a value other than provided during account registration, and you will still be sent the password reset link.    In /admin/Security/SendPassword.ascx.cs there is no verification of the password question answer provided.  """

As far as I can see, when a register user is entering on a page, internally the portalsettings.UserMode is """"Edit"""" and therefore the logic to show the proper tabModules is different for that userMode and the page is not showing the expected modules. This has been refactored to ensure the capabilities are only loaded if needed"""

Before this check loop the clientcapabilities are read from 51degrees even though they may not later be checked against (e.g. if the current page does not have a redirect rule). This has been refactored to ensure the capabilities are only loaded if needed""

title: "upgrade 51 degrees to 3.2.3.2"
description: """From Pull Request: https://github.com/dnnsoftware/Dnn.Platform/pull/621    •We have performed load testing and published the results: https://51degrees.com/blog/ArtMID/1641/ArticleID/368/Memory-and-Performance-Impact-of-51Degrees   •We have added multiple unit tests: https://github.com/51Degrees/.NET-Device-Detection/tree/master/UnitTests   •We have been running the updated version of the DLL on our own website (also powered by DNN) for quite some time now.    The design focus of the release is to integrate DNN efficiently with 51Degrees. Improvements include reducing memory consumption when the data file used directly from the disk, and to make use of 51Degrees performance improvements.    List of changes:  •When device detection is disabled the Client Capabilities Provider no longer forces it to start.  •All possible properties and values are no longer stored in a SortedList. Only required properties and values are loaded when needed and cached.  •Embedded data has been removed from the assembly and now must be provided from the App_Data folder.  •.NET 3.5 is no longer supported in order to use memory mapped files and simplify overriding default browser capabilities.  •In stream mode entity data properties that can allocate large arrays only initialise these arrays when needed.  •Caches used with stream operation are now fixed memory size and serviced via the thread pool.  •Automatic update processes uses temporary files rather than main memory to verify integrity of updated files prior to using them.  •Temporary files are now created in the App_Data/51Degrees folder of the web application rather than a UNC path or the master data file folder.  •Values associated with Profiles are now retrieved using a more efficient algorithm.  •DataSet.Properties collection now has a string accesser to make retrieving properties by name simpler.  •Memory mode no longer initialises the entire dataset. Startup time is now significantly improved.  •Memory mode uses less memory than prior versions.  •Supports 51Degrees V3.2 data format using approximately 25% smaller file sizes.  """

title: "Upgrade to 51Degrees V3.2 DLLs and revised DNN ClientCapabilitiesProvider"
description: """Today we have released the stable version of the DLL: 3.2.3.2. In addition to the previous message:    * We have performed load testing and published the results ([https://51degrees.com/blog/ArtMID/1641/ArticleID/368/Memory-and-Performance-Impact-of-51Degrees]).  * We have published multiple unit tests covering memory and performance ([https://github.com/51Degrees/.NET-Device-Detection/tree/master/UnitTests]).  * We have been running the updated version of the DLL on our own website (also powered by DNN) for quite some time now.    The design focus of the release is to integrate DNN efficiently with 51Degrees. Improvements include reducing memory consumption when the data file is used directly from the disk, and to rewrite parts of the ClientCapabilityProvider to make better use of 51Degrees performance improvements.    List of changes:    * When device detection is disabled the Client Capabilities Provider no longer forces it to start.  * All possible properties and values are no longer stored in a SortedList. Only required properties and values are loaded when needed and cached.  * Embedded data has been removed from the assembly and now must be provided from the App_Data folder.  * .NET 3.5 is no longer supported in order to use memory mapped files and simplify overriding default browser capabilities.  * In stream mode entity data properties that can allocate large arrays only initialise these arrays when needed.  * Caches used with stream operation are now fixed memory size and serviced via the thread pool.  * Automatic update processes uses temporary files rather than main memory to verify integrity of updated files prior to using them.  * Temporary files are now created in the App_Data/51Degrees folder of the web application rather than a UNC path or the master data file folder.  * Values associated with Profiles are now retrieved using a more efficient algorithm.  * DataSet.Properties collection now has a string accesser to make retrieving properties by name simpler.  * Memory mode no longer initialises the entire dataset. Startup time is now significantly improved.  * Memory mode uses less memory than prior versions.  * Supports 51Degrees V3.2 data format using approximately 25% smaller file sizes."""

title: "Search Crawler: Clicking Re-index button doesn't work as expected"
description: """The search has two places to re-index the whole site contend (under HOST and under Admin). Clicking these doesn't trigger re-index sometimes.    This could be due to caching invalidation and/or the place where these re-index settings are saved (HOST vs. Portal vs. Scheduler settings).    Note: The {{ScheduleItemSettings}} table should have its site crawler entry {{Search_LastSuccessfulIndexedOn}} reset when re-index is requested to fix this issue. But, it is not as simple as that because the crawler might be active when this value gets changed. Therefore the reset is not possible, and hence the code should check for re-index flags (for both host and portal settings) at the beginning of crawling and adjust its crawling strategy accordingly."""

title: "Extension URL provider break when English default culture is disabled"
description: """Add another language under *Admin > Languages* (e.g. fr-FR) and make French the default site language. Then disable (uncheck) the en-US language.    The extension URL provider passes an empty cultureCode in the *TransformFriendlyUrlToQueryString* method. However, the *ChangeFriendlyUrl* method receives the correct cultureCode = fr-FR.    We cannot use the *System.Threading.Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture*  or *System.Threading.Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture* either as it returns en-US, but we really needed fr-FR.    This bug is breaking the advanced URL extension since it's unable to lookup the correct URL path to recreate the query string values. """

title: "Fluent Configuration for the DAL2"
description: """The DAL 2 has proven to be a major advancement for developing DNN components.  However it releies heavily on """"Data Annotation"""" attributes to configure the Caching and Mapping.    While simple to use this approach means that the models are not really POCOs (Plain old CLR objects) as they are """"poluted"""" with data implementation details.    Many data frameworks (Entity Framewor and NHibernate for example) have solved this problem by using a Fluent configuration API.    This enhancement to the DAL 2 will add a fluent configuration API that allows developers to keep their Data implementation details and their Models separate.    Essentially this enhancement has two parts.    * Provide a Fluent Mapper implementation of the IMapper interface used by PetaPoco to provide the column and table mapping information (that can replace the deault PetaPocoMapper that uses data annotations (this will be based on the following blog by luuk summers - http://sameproblemmorecode.blogspot.nl/2013/07/petapoco-as-its-meant-to-be-with.html)  * Provide a Fluent Configuration implementation to configure the RepositoryBase class for the Caching and Scope settings  """

title: "Sql Function BrowserFromUserAgent sometimes fails to parse agents"
description: """We've had our detailed site log crashing in a public website for some time.  After we investigated the exception, it appears that the sql """"BrowserFromUserAgent"""" function, which the corresponding site log report procedure (#2) calls, can fail when trying to parse the version number.    The following code portion fails with an attempt to cast nvarchars to int, and the procedure is restored when commenting and replacing it with a hard coded initialization of  @version:      {code:tsql}  SET @ident1  = SubString(@Browser, @Pos + 1, 100)     SET @Browser = Left(@Browser, @Pos - 1)     SET @Pos     = CharIndex('|', @ident1)     IF  @Pos > 0 BEGIN      SET @Ident2 = SubString(@Ident1, @Pos + 1, 100)      SET @Ident1 = Left(@Ident1, @Pos - 1)     END      -- get major version number from UserAgent string:     SET @Pos = CharIndex(@ident1, @UserAgent) + Len(@ident1 + '|') - 1 -- correct to catch trailing space     IF @Pos = 0 SET @Pos = CharIndex(@ident2, @UserAgent) + Len(@ident2 + '|') - 1 -- again     IF @Pos > 0 BEGIN      WHILE SubString(@UserAgent, @Pos + @End, 1) >= '0' AND SubString(@UserAgent, @Pos + @End, 1) <= 9       SET @End = @End + 1      IF @End > 0 SET @Version = SubString(@UserAgent, @Pos, @End)     END  """

title: "URLRewriter - Ensure static files don't go through the pipeline"
description: """+ Background +  Static files going through the pipeline causes extra calls into DNN. There are web.config settings available to instruct IIS to not call DNN for certain file types such as images (png, jpg, etc.), css, js, and others. Addition of preCondition=""""managedHandler"""" in the httpmodule configuration for AUM in web.config is not an option as AUM still needs to support extension-less urls.    We need to ensure that in all cases no static files are requested through the Dnn pipeline resulting in executing the Http modules in the web.config.  This may already be the case, but testing is required to document and verify that this is the case.    +Requirements+  * All static file requests (including those for the css/js minification/combination) must be handled natively by IIS and not go through the pipeline of httpmodules.  * Test and document findings"""

title: "Add New Module should allow adding individual module definitions"
description: """You installed a package with a module component consisting of multiple module definitions. When the user clicks on *Add New Module* from the control bar, the primary desktop module appears on the list instead of the module definitions. There are several usability problems with this implementation:    1. The user is forced to add the desktop module to the page, therefore multiple modules are automatically placed on the page in the same content pane area. In most cases where multiple module definitions are involved, the user prefers to see certain modules go to different content pane. So now, the user is required to do an extra step to move the modules after having just added them.    2. Often times, a user may accidentally have deleted one of the modules. The user is unable to re-add that single module definition back because the *Add New Module* always adds all the module definitions. This creates frustration and confusion for the user.    3. In contrast, if the user clicks on *Add Existing Module*, the user is able to cherry pick a single module (essentially a single module definition) whereas the *Add New Module* drops every module definition at once. This is inconsistent and confusing for the user.    Thanks,"""

After investigating, we found that there was a null reference exception happening within {{PortalAliasController.AddPortalAlias}}, where its {{_dataProvider}} field was blank. I'm preparing a pull request which uses {{DataProvider.Instance()}} directly, removing that field (it was only used once in that {{AddPortalAlias}} method; everywhere else is already using {{DataProvider.Instance()}})."""

title: "The token Tab:FullUrl delivers inconsistent trailing / - causes problems in token templates"
description: """The token [Tab:FullUrl] is mainly needed to generate links. A common scenario is to use it to say things like  * href=""""[Tab:FullUrl]/Details/...    Unfortunately this doesn't work reliably. In some cases FullUrl delivers a path without a trailing slash - so adding """"/Details/.."""" is correct, sometimes it does contain another slash so the template would have to use """"Details/...""""    So the risk is either having too many slashes portal//Details/... or too few portalDetails/...    It appears that this inconsistent behavior happens mainly on the root-page of the portal. From what I see, the home of a subportal called sub will be """"http://domain/sub/"""" with a trailing slash, but will be """"http://domain/sub/page"""" without a trailing slash if it's a subpage.     Suggestion: ensure that FullUrl never adds a slash. The link will then always work (with and without custom additions) and if someone needs to add something, it will be consistent and work on all pages"""

title: "Input: I recommend a completely different way to handle Client Dependency in the new View engines"
description: """Moving this dialog from mail to JIRA    Dear Joe, Charles and <USER> I would like to follow up on your new schema for token – where certain tokens had  # JSON in them  # More advanced logic in the background  I personally believe this is not a good move – based on the 3 years experience with how we do it in 2sxc. One of the core issues in all these features in the lifecycle of such a technology is that know-how transfer (documentation, demos, people copying other people code…) is usually more “expensive” throughout the life of a technology than the initial development. Now I cannot speak for all the token-features you are trying to implement, but at least for the client-dependency I strongly suggest a different way. The paradigms we usually follow are  # 1. If in any way possible, use the same syntax across technologies (view engines in this case)  # 2. If in any way possible, use a syntax already existing in HTML etc.  # 3. Try to keep all implementations as similar (identical) as possible  # So my recommendation is to place certain features which the platform provides – including JS compression – not into each view-stack, but around it. Here’s how we do it in 2sxc  # Each engine (doesn’t matter if token, razor or etc.) has no specific implementation for client dependency. It just generates html like <script src=”..”> etc.  # So the HTML that comes out is simple, and already works – it’s just not optimized, but otherwise it works. So basically the way a normal web designer would implement it already works – without any additional training.  # Then the tag can be decorated with an attribute to inform the system around it that it wishes optimizations. In our case it enableoptimizations=”true” or enableoptimizations=”107” to specify priority. If the hosting system doesn’t do anything – it will still work – just not optimized.   # The returned text/html sequence is checked by the system (in our case 2sxc) to see if there is any such special tag, and takes care of this  This makes a clear setup – and across all template implementations it will work. It will also work if on a future day someone decides to implement an XSLT view or a handlebars-view. Those which create such engines won’t have to develop a thousand features just to deliver a view-engine. This is IMHO a clear SoC. There are also other benefits like  * If my script tag would need a token inside it – like src=”generatescript.aspx?language=[Content:Language]” this would work, whereas in the token syntax like [Script: { x=’…’, y = ‘generatescript.aspx?language=[Content:Language]’ }] this will cause various issues down the road.   * You must document way less – and one documentation works across all view engines  * Anybody developing a new view engine – say handlebars – can benefit as well  With this mail I hope to contribute input/experience and not start a disagreement. So I hope this will start an internal discussion and I would love to hear from you – even if you disagree :).     Cheers from Switzerland,   Daniel   """

title: "Don't open Tokens to compare with Razor and make it dangerous"
description: """This is a thing that must urgently be discussed - Joe & I already started per mail.     I strongly believe we should not open Tokens to deliver a rich API. Basically right now tokens are safe. This means nobody can do any harm with them - no matter what you do.     The new approach to make tokens more powerful kind of tries to place tokens adjacent to other templating tools (like Razor) - just much weaker, and from now on it could not be regarded as safe any more :(    So should Tokens become as good as Razor? No! That's what Razor is for.   Should it become as technical as programming? No, because programmers won't use it.   Should it be a hybrid, enabling some things and being a bit insecure / risky? I really don't like the idea at all.     So IMHO we're going without any strategy and just adding features to something - but I believe there should be a strategy, and it should be to keep tokens for simple use cases, available to non techies, look simple and most of all it should *be safe*.     The way we’re going is IMHO like saying: Now tokens *are so powerful*, that they are *too complicated for web designers* and also a *security risk now so you need host-permissions* to use (because we cannot guarantee which APIs are really open) and they are *still too trivial for real developers*. So it’s _adding some of the dangers of Razor without most of the benefits_, _removing a previous core-target audience_ (users with less privileges) without adding a new one (developers still won’t go for it).     So my strong urge is: make sure you have a clear vision for each technology, and don't try to make tokens appealing to programmers who won't use it anyways. """

title: "Protocol relative URL in CSS not correctly handled by Client Resource Manager"
description: """When you have a construct with a protocol relative URL in your CSS, like this on a CDN:    #NavButtons .telephone-image, #NavButtons .mail-image  {    background: url(""""//cdn.invantive.com/cdn/Portals/_default/Skins/invantive-2012/images/heading-sprite.png"""");    width: 19px;    height: 19px;    display: inline-block;    vertical-align: middle;  }    After processing by CRM it becomes:    #NavButtons .telephone-image,#NavButtons .mail-image{background:url(""""/cdn/Portals/_default/Skins/invantive-2012/images/heading-sprite.png"""");width:19px;height:19px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;}    Note that the background image URL is incorrect. The double '/' indicating that it is a protocol relative URL is gone and replaced by the path in which the default skin is located.    Protocol relative URLs are very handy to avoid security warnings when running a site on both HTTP and HTTPS. Please note that the actual site only runs on HTTP, the SSL is offloaded to a dedicated device.    Suggested change:  Support protocol relative URLs when processing files by CRM."""

title: "User search does not take into account vanityUrl"
description: """The search skinobject includes a feature to display the users picture in the preview of the search. The problem is that this only works if you user does not have a vanityURL configured.    To test:  - on a standard installation, add a couple users.  - some with a vanityURL and some without  - on the search skinobject try searching for a couple users  Expected result:  - all users are found and their photo is displayed next to name on the preview of the search  Final result  - only users that don't have a vanity url will show the picture      The problem comes from file SearchServiceController.cs, in method GetGroupedBasicViews the code checks for the string """"UserId"""" in the url of the item result in order to add the picture to the item.  For users that have a vanityURL the url will not include the UserId so the  image will not be available on the result set."""

title: "URL's with ""ctl/SendPassword?returnurl="" are getting indexed by Searchengines which gets penalized because of duplicate content"
description: """One of our customers noticed something up in search engines which is that every page with the URL """"ctl/SendPassword?returnurl"""" is getting indexed by Google for example (see http://tinyurl.com/n552agh).    The Page shows the """"Reset Password"""" module but uses the page you are currently on and will implement meta robots with the value """"index,follow""""    Example:  http://cosmohairstyling.com/looks/women has a meta tag:    {code:html}  <meta id=""""MetaRobots"""" name=""""ROBOTS"""" content=""""INDEX, FOLLOW"""">  {code}    The URL http://cosmohairstyling.com/looks/women/ctl/SendPassword?returnurl=http%3A%2F%2Fcosmohairstyling.com%2Flooks%2Fwomen has the same meta tag because the page is being used to  implement the """"reset password module"""".    I tried to set a cannonical URL but this gets overridden when de """"Reset password module"""" is being placed    There are three possible solutions for this:    *Solution 1:*  The cannonical keeps in place so Searchanegines will not see this as duplicate content.    *Solution 2*  The """"reset password module"""" is part of the """"account login module"""" so the user will be redirected to that page if loginpage is set in """"site settings"""".     *Solution 3*  every URL with """"ctl/SendPassword?returnurl"""" gets a noindex, nofollow meta tag"""

However you are able to continue on with the site installation"""

title: "Add precondition=""manageHandler"" to Services module"
description: """During some performance testing it was noticed that some of the HttpModules do not have a precondition=""""managedHandlers"""".    Without this precondition the module executes on every request (including static files like images, javascript and style sheets).    While most of the modules have a very low footprint it is unnecessary processing and under heavy load it can have a dramatic affect on the average response time for static files.    To fix this we need to add the precondition for the Service Framework HttpModule in release.config and development.config and add a 7.4.1.config to update sites on Upgrade."""

title: "Changing alias on localized portals changes default theme"
description: """Actually Content Localization combined with multiple aliases has multiple bugs, but I'm mainly focusing on the show stopper for now.    Steps to reproduce:  1. Create a portal in DNN Platform 7.4.0  2. Add an alias (so you have minimum 2)  3. Go to Languages and press """"Enable Localized Content"""".    -Here, the system will add aliases based on the FIRST alias of the portal with appending /xx-xx to whatever language you've chosen, AND it will redirect you to use the primary language of that new added alias. That is really messed up if the first alias is www.correctdomain.com"""" but you're working on """"demo.mydomain.com"""" or something like that, since you'll be thrown to a different website, and cannot open the site again until the aliases has been changed from a different site using host -> site management. That's just annoying.    4. Add a theme in site settings - any third party theme or try anything but the default HOST theme / Darkknight theme.  5. add any page and let it use """"default theme"""" for the portal  6. add an alias, or change one of the aliases.  7. Go view the page you added  Expected result: Alias is added / changed, no problemo!  Actual result: Default theme is changed to Darkknight for ALL portals with localized content enabled. That's a MAJOR problem with multi-portal installations, since adding an alias to one portal will potentially mess up everything on all other portals. Further, this seems to be written directly to the server cache, since clearing cache will revert this new default to the actual saved theme.    I would guess that adding a cache clear on every alias change could probably clear up this problem, but I'd much rather have it NOT change the default theme at all."""

title: "Master Page Notification prevents access to content"
description: """First post, here goes. I'm not a programmer, got nothing to contribute here except perspective from an average content editor on the dnn platfrom.    Problem:  access to editing content in a 'child' (not master) module can be prevented if the page the master module was inserted on was redirected or deleted.  For instance, an html module created on one page, then added to another page as a reference (not copy). If the original page is deleted or is redirected the new DNN v8 """"feature"""" prevents editing the child module.  In version 7 all referenced modules could  be edited.      Steps to reproduce:  1) a html pro module was originally created on one page,  2) then this html pro module copied as a reference to another page  3) and subsequently the original page was set to ‘redirect’ to some other page or,  deleted.  The “master page” link, see picture 'master module notification' below, then would not send the content editor to a useful location.  The content within the child html module would not be available for editing.       I tried logging out and closing my browser and logging back in and the problem persists.    This seems like a bug, or serious flaw in the 'master page' notification feature.    Sometimes this is not a big problem because I can copy the text and insert it into a new html pro module.  However, if I have lots of custom html, then it is problematic to not have access to editing. It can be time consuming to reproduce the content.      Recommendations:   a) If a page is deleted with a 'master/original/parent module' then the referenced module should become an original/parent/copy, not a locked child module.    b) If the original module was referenced on more than one page, then it would be nice to allow/offer instructions on how to ‘split’ the module so that it is not longer a reference, but a copy.  For instance add a new feature: in settings for the html module, under module settings, 'added to pages' it should allow a child/copy module to be split - then it could be edited.  c) Overall I think it is a nice feature to let editors know that the module they are working with is referenced on other pages.  I don’t see very much utility in this feature other than letting people know that they are working with a reference - I enjoyed the ability to edit referenced html modules from any page in dnn v7.  Change module notification (in image attached) to:  """"This module is referenced on x other pages.  View other pages the module is on: page name 1, page name 2, etc.""""   d)  Allow content editors to edit referenced/child modules as was possible in previous  versions of dnn.  e) To expand upon the feature set of letting content editors know what they are editing, I would add the following notifications to pages visible to all users:  - Have message at the top of a module when it is only visible upon login by registered users.  """"Content only visible to registered users.""""  - Have message at the top of a module when it is hidden from ‘all users,’  """"Content hidden from all users.""""      """

title: "modulesettings redirect does not work in an ssl-offload scenario"
description: """When testing dnn-6359, a new issue was found. If a user is using ssl-offloading, pages will load as expect as will pop-ups. The majority of popups will work as expected i.e. postbacks save data and then reload the parent page - but in one case, modulesettings, the popup fails to close.     Inspecting the sequence of redirects via the console window in Firebug shows that a """"mixed-mode"""" warning is shown. After disabling partial rendering for the module settings control we can see that this is being caused by an attempt to redirect to a HTTP page which causes a problem as the popup was loaded via HTTPS.    Ultimately the problem seems to be asp.net's Response.Redirect picking up the wrong protocol as the returnUrl path is relative. Wwe cannot change returnUrl to pick up the protocol as modulesettings specifically strips protocols via the UrlUtils.ValidReturnUrl method.    We should investigate why a popup opened via HTTPS results in a redirect via HTTP. title: "Ability to link accounts to cope with double registrations"
description: """On a site I am administering I am noticing that one recurrent tasks is to solve the problem of my users creating new accounts because they forgot their password or because they can't use Facebook auth at their place of work for instance. Even though I'm using """"email address as username"""" people seem to posses enough email addresses these days to keep on registering.    I believe that actually deprecating the new account is too drastic and probably just a temporary measure (they'll recreate the account again). Also it poses problems with data integraty across the application. The best way forward is to have the account """"redirect"""" to the main account silently. This operation can only be done by an admin. The idea is that all data that was created will still remain linked to the newly created account but from the moment of linking onwards the user will actually be logged on as the main account. The onlly drawback is that the user will not be able to change the contents of some items he/she created in the period the new account was active before it was linked. But IMO this is a small price to pay for the solution I'm proposing."""

Even if you change a completely unrelated setting like """"Retain Schedule History"""" or in fact change nothing at all, clicking the Update button causes the task to fire. In any case, there is a Run Now button right next to the update button which should be responsible for this behavior."""

title: "SiteMap priority override does not work as expected"
description: """The SiteMap priority override doesn't work as expected because the implementation is inconsistent. Mentioned line numbers are based on the downloadable source code of version 7.4.0.    1. on the Admin -> Search Engine SiteMap page, no useful validation for the Override priority is provided, an error message is only shown if the value cannot be parsed, meaning any parseable number (e.g. 10000) can be entered. (SitemapSettings.asxc.cs, line 334 ff)  2. Comments in SiteMapProvider.cs and SiteMapBuilder.cs indicate that the Override priority is saved as integer (pr * 100), but this isn't done in the setter for Priority in SitemapProvider.cs (line 79)  3. The getter for the Override Priority also doesn't honor this rule (there is no pr / 100) (SitemapProvider.cs, line 72)  4. The SitemapBuilder.cs does this correctly (according to the comments)    This leads to wrong behaviour: I enter 0,6 as override priority, which is a correct, parseable value and gets saved to the DB. when the SitemapBuilder reads this value, it is divided by 100, making it 0,006, which is plain wrong (and filtered out if you use the """"Exclude URLs with a priority lower than:"""" feature)"""

title: "System Skin reverts back to portal Skin after cache clears"
description: """This is an odd situation.  I've had this happen on a upgrade version from DNN6 to DNN7 and thought it was just the upgrade causing the issue.  But now I have the same problem on a fresh install of DNN7.4 running 2 langauges fr-FR and en-GB (fallback to en-US which is disabled)    When a new install is created and a new skin uploaded using the Admin>extensions, it created the skin in the portal-system folder.    This skin can then be applied to the portal using the site setting and everything works OK.    However after a period of time the skin of the site reverts back to the DNN default skin.  I assume this is due to a recycle of the app pool clearing cache.    reapplying the skin puts it back again, but only until the next clear of cache!    If you copy the system skin to the portal folder (where it use to be saved before the creation of the system folder)  the skin is reapplied to the site.  However this then causes a duplicate skin problem and in site settings you get this error....       at System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary`2.Insert(TKey key, TValue value, Boolean add)     at System.Linq.Enumerable.ToDictionary[TSource,TKey,TElement](IEnumerable`1 source, Func`2 keySelector, Func`2 elementSelector, IEqualityComparer`1 comparer)      So it seems that what is happening is that once a skin is uploaded by Admin>extensions it's created in the portal system folder, applying this skin to the site works, but is not set correctly in the DB and when we have an app pool recycle the DB settings point to the old place for the skins (in the normal portal root) which doesn't exist and hence it falls back to the DNN default.       """

title: "TrueFalseEditControl was recently broken and the last fix does not quite restore the expected behaviour"
description: """From the control's recent change history:    https://github.com/dnnsoftware/Dnn.Platform/commits/development/DNN%20Platform/Library/UI/WebControls/PropertyEditor/Edit%20Controls/TrueFalseEditControl.cs    This is about the LoadPostData method, which deals with the value posted for the corresponding checkbox within the property editor, updates the value if needed and should return true if and only if the value has changed.    The first issue I see is how could it be possible for someone with no previous github history to commit a change that obviously breaks the control without any more safeguards? It might be just a simple review negligence from an external pull, which is fine, but if there are further authorization problems, then this should definitely be prevented in the future.    Then the last fix does not seem to restore the expected behavior, in that it will always return true regardless of the original value (which was properly accounted for in the previous versions). It does not have a huge impact as is, yet we do make extensive use of the Property Editor, and it will have the consequence to trigger a new databind in our codebase (because we have conditionally visible editcontrols), so this will affect us quite a bit.    Now I understand that as for my previous issues, maintaining the propertyeditor is not the priority anymore, but as this is a quick fix again, that would be nice if the expected behavior can be restored.    The fix should be: instead of immediately setting the Value property and returning true, define a temporarily boolean variable and restore the conditional behavior """"If (BooleanValue == x)"""" that was existing before the bug was introduced."""

title: "Assembly installer should create/update binding redirects for strong-named assemblies"
description: """When assemblies are strong-named, references to those assemblies require an exact version match, unless there is a binding redirect.  In an environment like DNN where many assemblies from many different vendors may be included, it is not uncommon to run into a scenario where installing an extension can cause another to stop working, even though they should still be able to work.  For example, DNN ships {{Newtonsoft.Json.dll}}, a strong-named assembly.  Any extension which references a different version of that assembly will have an error, even though the assembly is backwards-compatible (though, in that case, Newtonsoft has stopped changing the internal version number to avoid this conflict for most scenarios).    See http://www.dnnsoftware.com/voice/automatically-add-binding-redirect-when-installing-strong-named-assembly"""

title: "Implement VaryByCustom for portals, users and locale"
description: """Let's assume we have a DNN skin, which various repeating parts are implemented as skinobjects, and this skin also uses some DNN skinobjects (well, it's pretty common case). If some skinobject (or any other ASP.NET control used in a skin) does not require postbacks, it's content could be cached and generally vary by:    # current portal.  # current page.  # current user.  # current culture (language).    To improve performance, we should use OutputCache directive, but only per-page cache variations are available at this time by using VaryByParam=""""tabid"""". It will work on sites with content localization enabled, as there are different tabid's for each page version - though not on sites with just different UI languages.    Some content could be pretty static and vary just per portal (e.g. global menu, copyright, social group links), some vary per user (e.g. profile links) - but all of this vary by language part also. Currently, this content could not be cached by these rules, as there are no corresponding overrides for GetVaryByCustomString() in DotNetNukeHttpApplication class.    It would be great to have VaryByCustom implemented to vary controls cache by portal, user and (or) language - I think, it could significally improve performance of many DNN skins."""

title: "Host Setting ""Site Log History"" (under Host > Host Settings > Other settings) has no impact"
description: """The host Setting """"Site Log History"""" (under Host > Host Settings > Other settings) has no impact. There is also a """"Site Log History (Days)"""" (under Admin > Site Settings > Advanced Settings > Host Settings) setting which is used to decide whether or not the site log is enabled (in Default.aspx.cs) and when purging the site log (in the PurgeSiteLog scheduler client).  The only situation where the setting under """"Host > Host Settings"""" is used is when a new portal is created (the host value is copied into the portal/site configuration).    IMHO this is very confusing as the UI suggested that the host setting is used to configure the size of the site log or at to configure a default setting taht could be overridden by a portal/site setting. In addition, next to the """"Site Log History"""" setting on the host level in the UI is the """"Site Log Buffer"""" setting which in turn does infect the site log configuration (as there is no appropriate setting on the portal/site level).    I recommend to either remove the host setting or to change the UI in a way that it reflects that this value is just a template value (for creating new portals) but does not configure the site log in any way."""

title: "DNN Client variable does not update on callbacks"
description: """dnn client variable, which is defined on the client side in dnn.js javascript file, relies on the dnn.vars variable, which is built in a lazy loading fashion in the dnn.getVars function, which in turns parses the __dnnVariable hidden field.   The later is properly updated over partial rendering callbacks, yet the lazy loading behavior prevents the local variable to be updated.    One workaround that used to work, was the addition of a callback to nullify the existing local parsed dnn.vars:    Sys.WebForms.PageRequestManager.getInstance().add_endRequest(function (sender, args){  dnn.vars=null;  });    For some reason, this does not seem to work well anymore, but a similar fix should be workable to get the client variable to support callbacks"""

title: "Issue with Tabs.IconFile and Tabs.IconFileLarge fields being too short"
description: """I instructed a DNN admin to structure their files in (sub)folders and to use explanatory file names for SEO.  As this client has a lot of pages with lot of images they have a lot of subfolders on the server in their portal.  They are using a page largeIcon on almost every page (used in the skin).  After a while I got a complaint that they could set the page LargeIcon in the page settings but it did not show up any more on the page.  In the database I noticed that a part of the iconlargefile was missing (name cut off).  The combines path and filename was longer than 100 characters.    I now found out that both the IconFile and IconFileLarge fields are nvarchar(100) in the database.  It seems DNN does not check if the injected value is longer than 100 characters and the value is cut off when injected in the database.    For files and folders the current definitions in the DB are:  Files.FileName = nvarchar(100)  Files.Folder = nvarchar(200)  Folders.FolderPath = nvarchar(300)    So there is a potential issue here too.    Files.Folder.Length != Folders.FolderPath.Length    This means you can safely upload a file with a name of 99 characters in a folder with a name of 199 characters, but you cannot use that as a page (large)icon.    The Iconfile field in the TabModules table is also nvarchar(100)    I suggest to make these changes to the database:    Tabs.IconFile = nvarchar(100) > nvarchar(500)  Tabs.IconLargeFile = nvarchar(100) > nvarchar(500)  TabModules.Iconfile = nvarchar(100) > nvarchar(500)    Files.FileName = nvarchar(100)  Files.Folder = nvarchar(200) > nvarchar(400)  Folders.FolderPath = nvarchar(300)  > nvarchar(400)    The stored procedures would have to be changed too. (AddFile, AddFolder etc.)"""

title: "Localized filtering for user accounts is not working in the User Accounts module."
description: """A default filter is available in the User Accounts admin module for searching for user accounts with keywords: All, Online, Unauthorized and Deleted. If there’s punctuation in any of the keywords after localization (translation) into another language, searching (filtering) user accounts using these keywords doesn’t work. An empty list is always returned. In accordance to my experience, this problem is caused by the URL rewriter, which changes the strings with the coding and decoding process in a way that the processing of the filter in code doesn’t work as it should.  The problem can be solved:  1. Changing the code of the URL rewriter  or  2. Changing the default value AUM_KeepInQueryStringRegex to:  /nomo/\d+|/runningDefault/[^/]|/popup/(?:true|false)|/(?:page|category|sort|tags|filter)/[^/]  where the „|filter“ is added.  The change in point 2 makes sure that the URL rewriter won’t try to include the querystring """"filter=xxxxx“ to URL."""

description: """When calling {{DataProvider.Instance().ExecuteReader}} (or any other {{Execute*}} method), you should be able to pass {{SqlParameter}} objects to include the parameter name with the value. I'm fairly certain that this worked before PetaPoco was introduced, but it now ignores the parameter names."""
