title: "SI: Country Property returning # not country name after upgrade to DNN 7.4"
description: """Below is as per customer, he has put it best.    I was experiencing this after upgrading from an older version(7) to 8.  Before the upgrade I used the method UserInfo.Profile.GetPropertyValue consistently to get Profile properties.  So for example for a property of type text/string:  GetPropertyValue(""""FirstName"""") gave the name e.g. Matthias  same could be achieved by Profile.FirstName  For the country field of type list the same held:  GetPropertyValue(""""Country"""") gave the name of the country e.g. Switzerland  same could be achieved by Profile.Country  again the same for a custom property e.g Nationality of type list with listtype country:  GetPropertyValue(""""Nationality"""") gave the name of the country e.g. Switzerland as well  Now after the update with Evoq 8, I see the following:  GetPropertyValue(""""FirstName"""") gives the name e.g. Matthias  Profile.FirstName : Matthias  GetPropertyValue(""""Country""""): 210  Profile.Country : Switzerland  GetPropertyValue(""""Nationality""""):210    As I see it, the result of this method GetPropertyValue has changed for properties with type List. With country there one can go for Profile.Country , but with a custom property one is not able to.  Given an entry out of table Lists: EntryID:40, Listname:Country, Value:CH, Name:Switzerland.  For a property of type list e.g. the Country:  Before Upgrade: In thedatabase in table UserProfile in Field PropertyValue saved value: Switzerland  Now: In thedatabase in table UserProfile in Field PropertyValue saved value: 210  So, data saved in database changed. EntryIDs from LIST table are saved instead of the value in the text field.  So data changed, while the method didn't as it is just returning the value in UserPRofile table.  This means before upgrade one could consistently use this method getting back always the expected value.  Now, one gets sometimes the expected value eg. FIrstName, so for datatypes text(string), datetime, and such its as before, but with List types one does not get the expected value Switzerland, but 210. So, one has to get Switzerland by executing an SQL like: select text from lists where EntryID=210  So I was wondering if this is really the expected result. If yes, how one is suposed to get now the wanted value from a property with type list. Is there a method to get a text/value of a list item by EntryID or is one supposed to add its own stored procedure and get it manually after recieving the EntryId from the GetPropertyValue method.  I was asking that, because quite a lot of code in my modules depends on this method and I don't want to change it all, if it's a sort of """"bug"""" where after an upgrade, I would have to switch all back again."""

title: "Improve performance of Folder Manager"
description: """Current implementation for {{FolderManager}} has a big performance impact when there are tens of thousands of records in the Folders table. This enhancement is of a big impact to enterprise customers.    The problem appears when caching all of these thousands of records then clearing the cache on every change to the folders structure thereafter all record had to be reloaded from the database upon first access of the folders object. In the busy site this operation could happen multiple times every minute where many managers/users upload files, profile pictures, etc. Also using LINQ selections/filtering on these huge arrays are computationally heavy.     I suggest using a tree representation for the folders structure in memory where only first-level sub-folders of a folder are loaded and thesub-subfolders are loaded lazily/on-demand whenever needed. This helps reducing the need to load all these thousands of files and help in reducing cache thrashing by invalidating only the node's affected sub-folder node without affecting any other parts of the tree structure."""

title: "SI: WebAPI - Windows Authentication"
description: """h5. Brief description  The Web API methods decorated by attribute: DnnAuthorize or RequireHost are not working when in IIS Authentication is set to Windows Authentication.     h5. Steps to reproduce  * Create new DNNv734 instance.  * In IIS enable Windows Authentication, for all website  * Install Glanton [AD-Pro Authentication|http://store.dnnsoftware.com/home/product-details/active-directory-authentication-v2] module.  * Enable auto-login in AD-Pro Authentication module    h5. Actual result  Requests to WebAPI methods decorated by attribute DnnAuthorize or RequireHost fails.  Fiddler shows HTTP 302 code loop (see attached file).    h5. Expected result  Request's shouldn't fail.    h5. Note  This behavior doesn't occur when Windows Authentication is set for only one file, like in AD Auth provider, in AD Auth this issue doesn't occur.  In Glanton extension every request must be authenticated by the NTLM or Kerberos protocol. To authenticate request this method DotNetNuke.HttpModules.Membership.AuthenticateRequest must be executed, which by default ignores all the requests from Windows Authentication. (in source code line 160).    I'm implementing a fix, I will add it to the git repo."""

title: "Add Canonical Base Page Property"
description: """We need to add a new property to Default.aspx and the base page class so that the Canonical URL is written to the page meta information. This property needs to be public, like Title, so that it can be overwritten by module developers.       +Requirements+    * New property create for the BasePage class called 'CanonicalLinkUrl'  * If the value is not set, the canonical link will not be included in the header.  Ie, if the value is null or empty string, then no canonical link is output  * If the value is set, the link should be emitted in the <head> section of the page, using the format of <link rel=""""canonical"""" href=""""VALUE OF SET PROPERTY"""" />  * 'Last setter wins' - the property can be overridden in the base page by any number of modules/code.  The last code to set the value is the one that is emitted.  * If the value of the 'Site Alias' option is 'Canonical', then the code that sets the canonical link by generating a header tag must be replaced by code that sets the 'CanonicalLinkUrl' property of the base page.    * Any other location in the DNN Codebase which creates a canonical link must be replaced with a set of the CanonicalLinkUrl property.  A comprehensive text search of the code should find any pattern matching *rel=""""canonical""""* or *rel='canonical'*.  Once this change goes into the codebase, all DNN platform code must use the property. title: "Increase maxUrlLength in Web.config"
description: """DNN uses friendly URL by default converting query string pairs into file path segments. The default ASP.NET maximum URL path length is 260 characters (measured against the Path property only) and is too small to handle URL with long parameters. For example, a product search page that has many search fields in the URL that normally works fine with query string will fail after processing through the friendly URL rewrite if you try to navigate to it. It will generate an ugly HTTP 400 Bad Request error (the yellow page kind of error that doesn't reach DNN).    [https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/system.web.configuration.httpruntimesection.maxurllength%28v=vs.110%29.aspx]    All modern browsers already support from 2048 characters (IE) up to 80,000 characters in Safari.    See reference: [http://www.boutell.com/newfaq/misc/urllength.html]    There is little reason why max URL path value should be so small for modern browsers. Increasing the value will only make friendly URL more robust.    I suggest we set the maxUrlLength to 2048 since that is the maximum URL length supported by IE (all other browsers support way larger than this value). Furthermore, we should also set the relaxedUrlToFileSystemMapping=""""true"""" so that it doesn't enforce the same path length limit as the Windows file system. Afterall, DNN file paths have very little to do with actual file path on the physical disk."""

title: "ModuleSettings sometimes empty after copying a module to another language"
description: """Sometimes when a module is localized (means, being copied to another language in the Page Localization tab), the copy does not get the ModuleSettings of the source module. This results in a module instance that is no real copy of the original. Many modules save important settings to ModuleSettings.    The error is happening spontaneous: sometimes the settings are copied correctly, sometimes not. So it may be hard to reproduce - these are the steps I used to reproduce the issue in a clean DNN 7.3.4 installation:    # Activate some languages in Admin > Languages  # Enable """"Allow Content Localization"""" in Host Settings  # Enable Content Localization in Admin > Lanugages  # Create a new page with an HTML module  # Go to the module's settings and check """"Replace Tokens"""" (this setting will be saved to the ModuleSettings table)  # Go to the page localization settings and copy the module to all other languages  # Check if the localized modules have """"Replace Tokens"""" enabled. In my tests, about 1/3 of the modules had the setting disabled (the module settings were not copied).    I debugged quickly in Visual Studio and found a way to circumvent the problem, although I did not find the root cause:    {code:title=ModuleController.cs|borderStyle=solid}  public void CopyModule(ModuleInfo sourceModule, TabInfo destinationTab, string toPaneName, bool includeSettings)  {      ...      ClearCache(sourceModule.TabID);      ClearCache(destinationTab.TabID);      ClearModuleSettingsCache(sourceModule.ModuleID);      ...  }  {code}    See this commit: https://github.com/raphael-m/Dnn.Platform/commit/8e3a88fa7a3fbc030ae1ad235c02c5cb36bbb31c    I did not create a pull request because I think this is not the best solution. Maybe someone can have a look at this?"""

title: "SI: Load all javascript at bottom of page"
description: """The problem caused by scripts is that they block parallel downloads. The HTTP/1.1 specification suggests that browsers download no more than two components in parallel per hostname. If you serve your images from multiple hostnames, you can get more than two downloads to occur in parallel. While a script is downloading, however, the browser won't start any other downloads, even on different hostnames. In some situations it's not easy to move scripts to the bottom. If, for example, the script uses document.write to insert part of the page's content, it can't be moved lower in the page. There might also be scoping issues. In many cases, there are ways to workaround these situations.    An alternative suggestion that often comes up is to use deferred scripts. The DEFER attribute indicates that the script does not contain document.write, and is a clue to browsers that they can continue rendering. Unfortunately, Firefox doesn't support the DEFER attribute. In Internet Explorer, the script may be deferred, but not as much as desired. If a script can be deferred, it can also be moved to the bottom of the page. That will make your web pages load faster."""

The error is: There is a problem with the configuration of your SMTP Server. Mail was not sent."""" 5. The error log says: 2015-01-22 00:50:25,456 [Anemone][Thread:22][ERROR] DotNetNuke.Services.Exceptions.Exceptions - System.Net.Mail.SmtpException: The SMTP server requires a secure connection or the client was not authenticated. title: "SI: New Profile Property is not supposed to be displayed as required"
description: """Steps to reproduce:    1) Navigate to Admin > Site Settings > User Account Settings tab: Profile Settings section.  2) Add New Profile Property  3) Property Name: Newsletter, Data Type: checkbox, Property Category: Newsletter  NOTE: Leave the following checkboxes BLANK: Required, Read-Only & Visible.  4) Click Next  5) The Property Name and Catagory name on the next page should by displayed as """"Newsletter"""".  NOTE: Notice how the """"Required"""" field is checkmarked when it should not be. De-select the """"Required"""" field now and click Update at the bottom of the page.  6) Now that you are back on the Account Settings page, scroll up to the top of the page and click on the Public bullet option for User Registration.  7) Add some Custom fields for the Registration Type, i.e. Username, Password, Password   Conform, Email, FirstName, LastName, and most importantly for this test, add """"Newsletter"""".  8) Click Update at the bottom of the page  9) Logout  10) Click on Register > fill in the appropriate fields to create a new User. DO NOT put a checkbox in the """"Newsletter"""" checkbox.  11) Click Update  12) Click on the New User Profile > My Account > Manage Profile tab.   NOTE: Notice that the Newsletter option is visible, read-only and has a checkmark in the checkbox. All these options should not be available.  13) Logout  14) Login as Host (SuperUser)  15) Navigate back to Admin > Site Settings > User Account Settings tab: Profile Settings section.  16) Scroll down the page and notice the Required field is not checkmarked for """"Newsletter"""".  17) Click on the edit pencil icon for """"Newsletter""""  18) Notice how the Read Only and visible are checkmarked even though they shouldn't be. This is not correct behavior.  19) Now de-select the Read Only and visible checkboxes so there are NO checkmarks. They must be empty now.  20) Click Next > click Update  21) Again, click on the edit pencil icon for """"Newsletter"""".  NOTE: All the check boxes are auto filled for the Required, Read Only and Visible fields. This is a bug issue as normal behavior would not auto fill these fields.    ** Tested in version 7.3.3 and the behavior is as expected. The fields do not auto fill, and the Host (SuperUser) is able to control these settings without concern that these fields will automatically change as it is doing in version 7.3.4.    REFER TO VIDEO DEMONSTRATION  [734 - Bug Issue - New Profile Property is not supposed to be displayed as registered.mp4]"""

title: "Administrative features should be refactored into extensions"
description: """Currently DNN ships with many administrative features which are tightly coupled to the core platform.  Even if a user does not wish to use a feature for their site, they still have to have the functionality loaded.  This tight coupling also complicates maintenance.    DNN Platform should be refactored to provide cleaner separation between the core Platform and extra administrative functionality.  Once separated, we can create distributions which incorporate only the desired DNN functionality.  This functionality is basically broken down into 2 broad categories:    1. Refactor Admin Features  2. Refactor Host Features """

description: """h2. Card  The current captcha control used in DNN is delivered as a standard user interface component.  Whenever the core framework or a module wishes to enable captcha support, the captcha control is added to the UI and displayed as appropriate. title: "CAPTCHA"
description: """Over the past 18 months, there has been a significant increase in registration SPAM attacks against DNN sites.  These attacks have quickly defeated the existing CAPTCHA control and resulted in hundreds and thousands of invalid users getting registered against a DNN site. These attacks create an administrative burden for site administrators and currently there is no effective mechanism in the framework to minimize these attacks.    Unfortunately improving the CAPTCHA we ship with has not resolved the spam bot registrations. We need take a step back and rethink our defense against this. In order to better combat the threat we need a system which allows each site flexibility to implement a system which meets their particular requirements.  No single approach is appropriate for every site using DNN.     With an appropriate framework in place, the community will be free to implement a wide variety of approaches to solving the issue which might include locally developed solutions or the integration of 3rd party services like reCAPTCHA or NuCAPTCHA. """

title: "@import problem when composite CSS files are used"
description: """Lets say I have an @import rule for a Google font in my theme's CSS:        I don't specify the protocol (http: or https:) for the URL because I don't know where the theme will be used. Pretty much standard practice when you want the website's current protocol to dictate the protocol the user agent will use to call an external resource.    When I enable composite files in Host settings all the CSS files get compiled into one resource. Now, the problem with @import at-rules is that they must be specified at the beginning, before any other CSS rules. Because of that, the compiler that merges all the CSS files into one resources will try to resolve all the @import's by requesting the resource and including it's content in the place where the @import rule was specified.    The problem is that the URL in my example doesn't have a protocol specified, so the compiler doesn't know what to do with it. The compiler then prints out an error and a perfectly good @import rule gets ignored.        The simple solution would be to familiarize the compiler with protocol-less URL-s and try to load the content by assuming a protocol, http or https.    However, I think there's a bigger problem here. External resources are, almost allways, not in your control. Definitely not if you are loading a font that is hosted by Google or other third parties. Nothing garantees that the content you loaded now from the import resource will be the same in a day, week, month...    Not to mention that @import rules can have CSS media queries listed witch dictate the conditions for which the resource will be loaded. They also get ignored if you simply get the content of the requested resource and put it directly in your CSS.    I think that the compiler sould parse import rules that load external resources and put them at the beginning of the combined CSS, as they are."""

title: "Scheduler history cleanup can cause scheduler to fail"
description: """When vast numbers of records reside in the schedule history, the task to clean it up will fail to complete leaving the situation as is. This can happen when the cleanup task has been turned off for a while and gets turned back on, or if an individual task has no limit on history items kept and that setting is changed. In both cases we can get vasts amounts of records to delete."""

title: "Update Test Projects to mark them as NUnit test suites"
description: """{panel:title=From MS Documentation}  To support third-party test frameworks, like NUnit and XUnit, Visual Studio 2012 loaded Test Explorer on solution open, regardless of whether it contained test projects. This added seconds of delay to startup and solution open scenarios for all users, majority of whom don't use tests.    In Visual Studio 2013, we changed it so that Test Explorer package is loaded only when the solution contains one or more test projects. Test projects are identified in two different ways. Projects created from one of the built-in unit test project templates are identified using project type GUIDs. Other types of projects, such as Class Library project with XUnit or NUnit tests, are identified by Test Explorer during first test discovery and “tagged” with the <Service/> item.  {panel}    The following test projects should have an identifying Service entry if one is not present:  * DotNetNuke.Tests.Data  * DotNetNuke.Tests.Urls  * DotNetNuke.Tests.Web  * DotNetNuke.Tests.FiftyOneClientCapabilityProvider    {code:title=Service Entry in CSProj}    <ItemGroup>      <Service Include=""""{82A7F48D-3B50-4B1E-B82E-3ADA8210C358}"""" />    </ItemGroup>  {code}    See [MS Connect Issue|https://connect.microsoft.com/VisualStudio/feedback/details/800245/vs2013rc-adds-to-vs2012-c-project-section-itemgroup]"""

title: "GetCultureInfo should be used instead of CreateSpecificCulture"
description: """I have run into a very curious problem regarding cultures in the framework. It concerns the use of the following method:    CultureInfo.CreateSpecificCulture(Code)    There is another similar method however:    CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo(Code)    Both return a CultureInfo object. But there are subtle differences. I had tests fail because on my machine the CultureInfo returned from the first method for “en-US” used the date format “d/M/yyyy”. I know … you’re thinking: this is totally impossible. But I changed the method to GetCultureInfo and then the date format was “M/d/yyyy” again. Like it should be. Hmmm. In more research I stumbled on this post:    http://stackoverflow.com/questions/986754/when-to-use-cultureinfo-getcultureinfostring-or-cultureinfo-createspecificcult    From the answers:    But there is a somewhat surprising feature of the specific culture created:  If the culture identifier of the specific culture returned by this method matches the culture identifier of the current Windows culture, this method creates a CultureInfo object that uses the Windows culture overrides. The overrides include user settings for the properties of the DateTimeFormatInfo object returned by the DateTimeFormat property and the NumberFormatInfo object returned by the NumberFormat property.  What this means is that if the specific culture returned by CreateSpecificCulture matches the culture selected by the user in Region and Language control panel in Windows then any user customizations to that culture is included in the CultureInfo returned. E.g. the user may change the long date pattern or the decimal separator used in numbers. Another way to think about this is that when CreateSpecificCulture returns a culture that matches the name of CurrentCulture it will actually return this culture including any user customizations.  As far as I can tell GetCultureInfo does not have this property and will always return a unmodified CultureInfo.    Suddenly I realized what had happened: I have tuned my own PC to use a “normal” date pattern while still tuned to en-US. So it was overriding what was returned. Like … WTF. OK, so now that I know why I am looking at what else could be impacted and it turns out GetSpecificCulture is used throughout the framework. Is there any reason we should keep this method? From the above it should be clear that this is not the right method to use. We should be using GetCultureInfo.    """

title: "A deleted file in a folder provider will not remove the record in the files table in DNN"
description: """Case: a 3rd party folder provider (class inherits FolderProvider).    If a file is removed from the folder provider the synchronization code checks this in FolderManager.RemoveOrphanedFiles (line 2063). It then hands off to FileManager.Instance.DeleteFile. title: "Create subfolders in root when parent folder is external folder provider"
description: """As an administrator, I want to use an external folder provider for the root folders of my site, but I also want to include a subfolder of a different folder provider type, so I can have all of my user data stored on a mix of external storage.    h2.  Conversation  In Version 7.3, a new feature was added which allows for the external storage of a new site to be created using a folder provider for external storage.  This allows setup of new sites to be started with all 'user' data stored separately from the application files.  This allows for leverage of geo-redundant storage in cloud providers, use of CDNs and simpler and faster backups for the application files themselves.    However, due to the design of folder providers, once an external folder provider is used, no subfolders of another folder provider type can be used.  This prevents someone leveraging external folder providers for the site root further leveraging another folder provider in their site (ie, using a dropbox folder provider for a certain folder, or using a database or secure folder provider).    This change is to relax that restriction to allow folders created in the root of the site to have subfolders of a different folder provider type.    Example:  root : Azure Storage  - images : Azure Storage  - Users : Azure Storage  - Documents : Dropbox  - Videos : AWS Provider  - Secure Documents : Secure Folders    In this example, only subfolders of the same type as the parent folder would be allowed to be created.    h2.  Confirmation  * Change restriction on subfolders so that subfolders of different provider types are allowed to be created at the root level of the site  * 'child' subfolders of root-level subfolders can only be created of the same type as the parent.  * Both external and standard folder providers would be supported for creation of subfolders    """

title: "HTML Module converting dragged data:image base64 into URI"
description: """The drag and drop functionality within the HTML Module doesn't work for images coming from FireFox or Chrome (where the browser sends a base64 image for embedding). The drag-and-drop functionality of the Telerik RadEditor takes the browser's Base64 input and encases it in an img tag where the source is the data. E.g., src=""""data:image/jpeg;base64,[base64data]"""". When using drag/drop to a RadEditor within the HTML Module and then saving the HTML content, that src definition is changed to a URI request by prepending the relative path for the DNN portal. E.g., src=""""/mysite/portals/0/data:image/jpeg;base64,[base64data]"""". This converts what started out as a perfectly valid embedded image tag into a request and thereby causes the browser to request this """"image"""" from the server. The server then returns a 414 error (URI too long). Example without prepended relative path: http://jsfiddle.net/GGGH/27Tbb/2/ Example with prepended relative path (won't display): http://jsfiddle.net/GGGH/NL85G/2/ It seems the problem is in the EditHtml.ascx.cs, FormatContent() method which calls the HtmlTextController's ManageRelativePaths() method. It's that method that runs for all """"src"""" tags (and """"background"""") in the Html content string. It post-processes the Html string that comes out of the RadEditor to add in that relative path. This is not appropriate when editing an embedded Base64 image that was dragged to the editor. In order to fix this, and still allow for the standard functionality, a fix In 7.3 at Modules/HTML/Components/HtmlTextController, line 474, is potentially appropriate. I added the following code (incrementing P as appropriate and positioned after the URI length was determined -- I'm sure there's a better way but this works fine). Note: EditHtml.ascx.cs and HtmlTextController both hard code the two tags that they intend to post-process, so hard coding for data:image is possibly not a bad idea. // line 483, HtmlTextController.cs, DNN code included for positioning while (P != -1) { sbBuff.Append(strHTML.Substring(S, P - S + tLen)); // added code bool skipThisToken = false; if (strHTML.Substring(P + tLen, 10) == """"data:image"""") // check for base64 image skipThisToken = true; // end added code - back to standard DNN //keep characters left of URL S = P + tLen; //save startpos of URL R = strHTML.IndexOf(""""\"""""""", S); //end of URL if (R >= 0) { strURL = strHTML.Substring(S, R - S).ToLower(); } else { strURL = strHTML.Substring(S).ToLower(); } // added code to continue while loop after the integers were updated if (skipThisToken) { P = strHTML.IndexOf(strToken + """"=\"""""""", S + strURL.Length + 2, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase); continue; } // end added code -- the method continues from here (not reproduced) """

title: "Page Management Slow for Site with Many Pages (Async TreeView)"
description: """For sites with many pages (e.g., > 1000), the Admin/Pages module is extremely slow to load and modify.  This is caused primarily by two issues, the first of which is documented in DNN-6017.  The second is the fact that the TreeView loads the entire site completely before rendering.  For larger sites, this should be modified to only show the current level and to asynchronously pull the sub-nodes when the node is expanded.  For our site, this brought significant improvements:  instead of 15 seconds to load (after implementation of DNN-6017) to 6 seconds.    The code is actually already quite ready for the change.  This is what I did:    In BindTree() [line 998 and 1015] I deleted the """"AddChildNodes(node)"""" calls and replaced it with the following:    if (tab.HasChildren)       node.ExpandMode = TreeNodeExpandMode.ServerSideCallBack;    Then, in AddChildNodes() [line 827] I also replaced the AddChildNodes(node) call with similar code:    if (objTab.HasChildren)       node.ExpandMode = TreeNodeExpandMode.ServerSideCallBack;    And finally, the CtlPagesNodeExpand() method was modified appropriately:    protected void CtlPagesNodeExpand(object sender, RadTreeNodeEventArgs e)  {       AddChildNodes(e.Node);       e.Node.Expanded = true;  }    Since CtlPagesNodeExpand is already wired up, nothing else needs to be done in order for the Tree to now be async.  No changes to the ascx were required.  It seems almost as if this was originally intended to be async but never got fully implemented as such.  With these small changes, the TreeView will retain all of its functionality yet load in 1/2 the time (at least, we have only ~1000 pages at this point)."""

title: "Page Management Slow for Site with Many Pages (Tabs Property)"
description: """For sites with many pages (e.g., > 1000), the Admin/Pages module is extremely slow to load and modify.  This is caused primarily by two issues, the first of which is the handling of the Tabs property (the 2nd issue is in another improvement report).    Here is how it's defined in Tabs.ascx.cs:    protected List<TabInfo> Tabs  {       get       {            return TabController.GetPortalTabs(rblMode.SelectedValue == """"H"""" ? Null.NullInteger : PortalId, Null.NullInteger, false, true, false, true);        }  }    As you can see, it gets called every time that the Tabs property is accessed.  Further in the code (I won't copy in each instance) you can notice that it's accessed many times each page load, including for every node in the TreeView.  In our instance, that means well over 1000 times the TabController.GetPortalTabs() is being called.  This meant a page load of over 60 seconds each time the page was accessed and upon saving any changes.      I fixed this simply by changing the getter to only call GetPortalTabs() once and then to store that in a session variable.  In the OnInit() I would clear it (I added a setter also) if the page was not in a postback.  Therefore, it calls GetPortalTabs() only one time.  This can be solved in several ways:  a private property, caching, my method, etc.  But, the improvements are significant when it's only called once.  This one change brought page load times from 60 seconds down to 15.    """

description: """Bots are attacking DNN Sites and a solution is in need.  I have a few ideas I would like to put out there, and using more than one probably is going to help since the bot creator will have to work out functions for them all.    1.  Create the ability to easily implement and use google captcha.  (not a google fan so rather see one of the following or a combination of them)  2.  Allow the portal admin to add a field with a question they created along with the correct answer.    Examples:    QUESTION: What year did America claims its independence?    Answer: 1776    QUESTION: What is the character at the end of a question? ANSWER: ?    3.  Using existing CAPTCHA possibly with more noise (Lines through it distorted characters of different sizes)    4.  USING CAPTCHA ask a question about what is in its contents that can be changed such as:    CAPTCHA:  21ACD  QUESTION: What is the first and last character?  ANSWER: 2D   if a bot sticks in more than the number of characters or the first two characters it will be wrong.      So being able to select the characters you want a user to use, and the ability for an admin to change which characters can be asked for, or even randomize the questions to ask for different characters.  Such as what are the last 3 characters, then ask what are the first 2 the second time or if someone hits the refresh, however leave more than just 2 or 3 characters to fill out so a bot can enter all 5 and get it wrong each time not knowing there is a question."""

title: "Friendly URL in Arabic issue after upgrading from DNN 7.2.0 to 7.3.3"
description: """Here is the scenario:  We have a site that is in English and Arabic and is in DNN 7.2.0 version.  We upgrade to version 7.3.3. After the upgrade, the Arabic pages that have two words, for example مــن نحــن  , in the friendly URL they lose the dash ( - ) which is between the two words and the dash is replaces by space. Thus when you try to load the page this happens www.domain.com/ar-ae/مــن%20نحــن  which causes a 404 error.   The rest of the arabic pages that are one word, are fine.  Since the page doesn't load you can't access page settings to change the url, also you can't access page settings via Admin>Page Management (you get error there as well)  The only way to fix this is through the SQL Server manually. If you do so and then clear the cache everything loads properly."""

title: "AdvancedFriendlyUrlProvider changes /ctl/Category/mid/416 to /ctl/416?Category=mid "
description: """There is a bug in the AdvancedFriendlyUrlProvider.RemoveExcludedPartsOfPath method that changes /ctl/Category/mid/416 to /ctl/416?Category=mid.    The cause is the DoNotIncludeInPathRegex that should move special key/value pairs from the path to the query string. The current implementation matches the key/value pair """"Category/mid"""" and moves it to the query string. In fact Category/mid is a wrong key/value pair, since """"Category"""" is the value for the key """"ctl"""" and """"mid"""" is the key for the value """"416"""".    On result of this bug is that you cannot create edit urls if the control key is """"Category"""" using the method ModuleContext.EditUrl(string controlKey);     I will provide a pull request to fix that problem."""

title: "EVOQCONTENT - Workflow > Implementation Requirements"
description: """Existing Platform has two workflow systems – one for the Text/Html module and one for the File Management.  It is important that these two different approaches are merged into a single workflow.       The workflow should use the generic ‘State Management’ concept developed for the Text/Html module, so that it can be expanded out to handle entities of any type, defined by third party developers.    The internal workflows will be tied to Content Items, and each of the workflow-controlled pieces will be a Content Item.    Requirements  * Unified Workflow system for all workflow-controlled entities  * All workflow-controlled entities in Evoq should be be content items  * Workflow to adapt to content items, but is not restricted to content items    h4.Workflow API  One of the key goals of the next release is the unified Workflow.   The single set of tables will be located at the DNN Platform level.   The design of workflow will allow any entity to be tracked through the Workflow states.    Locating the workflow at the DNN Platform level will encourage adoption by 3rd party developers which will strengthen the value of the Workflow system. While the Workflow UI will not be included with DNN platform, the default Workflows will be included.  It will be possible     Requirements  The public API for the Workflow process will be exposed at the DNN Platform level.   This public API will involve the following functions (at a high level)  * Start a workflow Process on an entity  * Move the entity through the process by approval  * Move the entity back through the process by rejection  * Publish the entity    In addition to the API, the following actions will occur during the API calls  * Send workflow notifications to related security groups via the DNN private messages    Out of scope of the Public API is:  * Exposing the File Management workflow UI in DNN Platform  * Exposing the Workflow Management UI in DNN Platform  * Providing the page-level history, versioning and publish/reject control    Essentially, the Workflow API is about exposing a state-tracking subsystem to allow vendors to build modules targeting a standardized platform.  """

title: "Portal Alias always being 301 redirected when one or more languages are enabled"
description: """When one or more languages are enabled in the DNN site, Portal Alias are always redirected to the the primary alias.    Our website should have four languages: en-us, de-ch, fr-ch and it-ch. Therefore, this is a blocker for us.    Steps to reproduce the bug:  1) Download the brand new DNN7.3.2 from codeplex and install it  2) Create some pages for testing purpose (About us and Contact us)  3) Go to Admin -> Site Settings -> Advanced Settings and add new site alias (eg. dnn723alias.local). See the attachment - PortalAlias(BeforeEnablingLanguages).PNG  4) Go to Admin -> Languages and add one or more languages (de-ch, fr-ch and it-ch). See the attachment - Languages.PNG  5) Restart the webserver  6) Open a browser and clean the cache  7) Visit secondary alias url (http://dnn732alias.local) - See the attachment - SecondaryAliasBeforeRedirect.PNG  8) It will 301 redirect to the primary alias (http://dnn732.local) instead of secondary alias (http://dnn732alias.local) - See the attachments - SecondaryAliasRedirect_Fiddler.PNG and SecondaryAliasRedirect.PNG    This issue has been already mentioned here: http://www.dnnhero.com/Forum/forumid/5/postid/1290/scope/posts    Resolve Attempts:  1) Go to SiteSettings and Add alias for each languages as highlighted in the attachment - PortalAlias(AfterEnablingLanguages).PNG  2) Restart the webserver and clean cache of the browser   3) Visit the alias site (http://dnn732alias.local)  4) Still the site will be 301 redirected to the primary alias  5) Change the SiteMapping mode from Canonical to None, still it redirects to default portal alias    As Duane mentioned in DNNHero's forum. No matter the site mapping mode and settings. It always redirecting to the primary alias when one or more languages are enabled.      """

title: "Improve Performance of GetFoldersByPermission Procedure"
description: """The stored procedure {{GetFoldersByPermissions}} contains un-needed joins to the {{Users}} and {{UserRoles}} tables.  In smaller installations, with low numbers of folders and/or users this isn't an issue.  However, if you work with larger sites this query slows down exponentially.    Example situation was a site with 50 folders & 53,000 users.  Due to this query the following functions were UNAVAILABLE to the user due to query timeouts.  (Site Settings, """"Create Page"""" from within the toolbar, Text Editor Image Manager, Text Editor Document Manager, and at times File Manager.)      In reviewing the query, these two joins can be removed without impact.  Attached are metrics from a small install with < 200 users and 10 folders to show the illustration.  (Couldn't get access to get this data from a larger site.)    Pull request is coming for this."""

Note: if we type the url like ?test (without the = symbol) the system redirect to /home/test with no 404 response"""

description: """Generally speaking: In each User's Activity Feed page, the owner (the author) can only see their own post. Result:   Mark's post's owner (the author) actually is """"Jack"""", since Mark was on Jack's Activity Feed page which is directed by notification. """

description: """The customer requests that they are able to have the same page URL for various versions of the same page when content localization is enabled.    For example, a page is localized into en-US and fr-FR. title: "CLONE - File-Crawler scheduled task eats a lot of CPU"
description: """This case is related to CLOUD-775. In that case I was trying to figured out why the File Crawler scheduled task is eating so much CPU (when that task is executed the CPU is at 100% all the time, during half an hour). I have to say that this customer has around 76,000 files and around 74,000 folders.    I’ve managed to reproduce the issue in my laptop and I think that there’s a bug in the {{DotNetNuke.Services.FileSystem.FolderManager}} class. I’m going to try to explain what I’ve found:  I’ve started with a profiling session in Visual Studio, in which we can see an interesting result:  !01.png!    “The {{GetFolders()}} method is a CPU intensive task”. Now, the question is, why? Let’s take a look at how the {{GetFiles()}} method calls the {{GetFolders()}} method. This is the stack trace:  !02.png!    The first {{GetFiles()}} function is just a wrapper which calls the following overloaded version of the same method:  !03.png!    As we can see, that method has a foreach statement to get all the subfolders of that folder, in order to retrieve all the files in a recursive way.  This is the {{GetFolder()}} method:  !04.png!    The bug here is that, {{GetFolders()}} calls an overloaded version of the same method, in which you only have to pass the {{PortalId}} as a parameter and then, in memory, it will apply that linq expression """"Where"""", to filter only the subfolders. In our case (ArtfulColor), {{GetFolders(portalId)}} will return a list of 74505 folders and then, the """"Where"""" expression is applied (it will need to iterate through all the 74505 to only return the folders that are subfolders of {{parentFolder}}). +*1 iteration through 74505*+.  Let’s see {{GetFolder(PortalId)}}:  !05.png!    This method gets the list of folders from the database (or from the cache) and then it iterates through all of them to create the list that will be returned. This is then, +*another iteration through 74505 elements*+.    So, for each folder the crawler needs to explore, it has to iterate (in this particular case) through 74505 + 74505 = 149,010 elements. That’s why I think it’s taking so much time. I guess the solution is just to replace the call to {{GetFoldersByPortal}} for something like {{GetFoldersByPath}}.    Another thing that I’ve found in this site (I’m not an expert on this matter, so I don’t know if this is normal or not): If you execute this two queries in the customer’s database, there are a lot of folders with ParentId = NULL and two folders with an empty FolderPath. Is it normal?  !06.png!"""

As we can see, that method has a foreach statement to get all the subfolders of that folder, in order to retrieve all the files in a recursive way. This is the {{GetFolder()}} method: !04.png! The bug here is that, {{GetFolders()}} calls an overloaded version of the same method, in which you only have to pass the {{PortalId}} as a parameter and then, in memory, it will apply that linq expression """"Where"""", to filter only the subfolders. In our case (ArtfulColor), {{GetFolders(portalId)}} will return a list of 74505 folders and then, the """"Where"""" expression is applied (it will need to iterate through all the 74505 to only return the folders that are subfolders of {{parentFolder}}). +*1 iteration through 74505*+. Let’s see {{GetFolder(PortalId)}}: !05.png! This method gets the list of folders from the database (or from the cache) and then it iterates through all of them to create the list that will be returned. This is then, +*another iteration through 74505 elements*+. So, for each folder the crawler needs to explore, it has to iterate (in this particular case) through 74505 + 74505 = 149,010 elements. That’s why I think it’s taking so much time. I guess the solution is just to replace the call to {{GetFoldersByPortal}} for something like {{GetFoldersByPath}}. Another thing that I’ve found in this site (I’m not an expert on this matter, so I don’t know if this is normal or not): If you execute this two queries in the customer’s database, there are a lot of folders with ParentId = NULL and two folders with an empty FolderPath. Is it normal? !06.png!""

This pull request adds the Client API project to the DNN solution (it is currently [a separate project on CodePlex|http://dnnclientapi.codeplex.com/], which had its last release Oct 2011).  Ideally, we could remove this dependency in the future, or, at least, translate it to C#, but getting this fix in the platform for now should be a help.    https://github.com/dnnsoftware/Dnn.Platform/pull/155"""

title: "dnn.modalpopup.js script doesn't initialize iframe with iPopUp name"
description: """The dnnModal popup has an iFrame that is useful to display content from external site. E.g. an ecommerce module needs to use the inline popup to display the hosted payment page, 3D Secure page, etc for payment processing. Using javascript, it calls a form to post to the target frame. However, the modal popup iFrame is initialized without a name. It is only initialized with an id as shown below.    $modal = $(""""<iframe id=\""""iPopUp\"""" src=\""""about:blank\"""" scrolling=\""""auto\"""" frameborder=\""""0\""""></iframe>"""");    The lack of name in the iFrame presents a problem because a form can only post to a target by name (not by id). Therefore, one must use Javascript to dynamically add the name to the iFrame prior to posting. This is cumbersome and unreliable as it will only work on Chrome and FF but not in IE. The IE browser doesn't allow setting a name after the iFrame has been created. What happens in IE is the form post will end up opening a new real window instead of the inline popup since it cannot find the frame by name.    the fix is trivial. All we need to do is add the name attribute to the iFrame in the dnn.modalpopup.js file during creation to resolve this issue like so:    $modal = $(""""<iframe name=\""""iPopUp\"""" id=\""""iPopUp\"""" src=\""""about:blank\"""" scrolling=\""""auto\"""" frameborder=\""""0\""""></iframe>"""");    Thank you."""

description: """Steps to Reproduce:    1. Create a site  2. Create a child site  3. Create a non-admin, non-host user in the child site.  4. View your profile    You will be logged out, fiddler will show a 302 as below, 404 not logged out if you are host.    http://screencast.com/t/aOTHgZrK6    As you can see in the screenshot it is trying to load /DesktopModules/images/arrow-right-white.png  which does not exist.    When we looked into it further we found the cause in the CSS of the console module.    .console.profile .console-none h3 {      padding: 10px 8px 10px 40px;      margin: 0;      border-bottom: solid 1px #fff;      background: url('../../images/arrow-right-white.png') 18px center no-repeat;      color: #eee;      font-size: 13px;      line-height: 1;      font-weight: bold;  }    the ../../ was not going down far enough because of the /lms/ child portal name.    Ideally the images for the module should be moved into the module itself to prevent this."""

title: "SI: TabOrder of a Localized site does not match the order of the default language site."
description: """This bug is seen in the sites that have content localization enabled and are using multiple languages. The Bug was replicated by me on EVOQ 7.3.2 Pro.    Desc: Basically the bug is that, a newly created page does not maintain the same order on the second language side of the site, that it has on the default language side of the site.     If in the English side of the site the new page is added between About Us and Contact Us page, that same page on the second language side is added to the end of the menu. Even if the page is added in the second language side and is told to be between About Us and Contact Us, it will added to the end of the menu, but will maintain the position on the default English side of the site.     Steps to Replicate:  ------------------------  **NOTE: You must have localization enable and second language installed, and pages marked as translated and published, and must be able to change between the two languages.**    1) Log in as super user or as an Admin on the DNN site  2) Go to the second language side by clicking on the flag of the second language. Make sure you are still logged in  3) Create a new page by hovering over the """"Pages"""" button in the control panel and then """"Add New Page""""  4) in the popup, scroll down and choose a location of the page to be after Home  5) click on """"Add Page""""    Expected Result:  ---------------------  New Page should be created and should display after the Home page in the menu.    Actual Result:  ------------------  New Page is created and appended at the end of the menu, rather than after the """"Home"""" page. I installed a custom skin on the host level to the portal.  4. I went to the site settings on admin level of the portal and tried to apply the custom skin.    Expected result: Changes accepted and skin applied.    Actual result: Site Settings page is loaded with unchanged values and the custom skin is not applied.    The changed values are correctly written into the """"PortalSettings"""" table in the SQL database. I examined the code and found out that on page Site Settings in the event """"OnLoad"""" is called the """"BindPortal"""" -> """"BindSkins"""" -> """"GetPortalSetting"""". The """"GetPortalSetting"""" function always returns the host default value. The reason is that the function """"GetPortalSettingsDictionary(int portalID)"""" calls function """"GetPortalSettingsDictionary(portalID, string.Empty);"""" (file """"PortalController.cs"""", line 2875)    Note that the second parameter, which is supposed to be the culture code is hardcoded to an empty string. I suppose this is the reason why the setting does not get loaded. The setting is not found because the value of the culture code is wrong. As a result, the default values defined on the host level are always returned."""

title: "Exception created when requesting deleted user profile pages"
description: """+Bug Description+    One of the aftermaths of the registration bot problems is that lots of spam user profile accounts get created.  These then exist as pages in the site, which in turn get indexed by bots.   Once you delete the user profiles for the bogus users, the user profile pages still get accessed by bots, and each time a user profile page for a non-existent user is requested, it generates an exception in the log.  This happens for each request and can quickly fill up the event log and crash the site if there are a lot of profiles and a lot of requests.    The issue is that the handling of a deleted user appears to be a 302 redirect with a 'end response' in it, which then creates a thread abort exception.    There are two issues here:  1) Most search engines won't process a 302 as the item being permanently removed.  This means bots will keep coming back and indexing the page.  2) Every time the url is requested, the event log gets an entry, which means it can be overwhelmed.    The exception is shown below:  !2014-08-22_12-21-24-cropped.png!    +Resolution+  This needs to be fixed by:  * Remove the 302 redirect when a deleted user is encountered  * Change to return a 404 by showing the configured DNN 404 page for the portal.  This should be achieved by raising a 404 exception which should 'bubble' up and be caught by the standard 404 handling"""

These then exist as pages in the site, which in turn get indexed by bots. Once you delete the user profiles for the bogus users, the user profile pages still get accessed by bots, and each time a user profile page for a non-existent user is requested, it generates an exception in the log. This happens for each request and can quickly fill up the event log and crash the site if there are a lot of profiles and a lot of requests. The issue is that the handling of a deleted user appears to be a 302 redirect with a 'end response' in it, which then creates a thread abort exception. There are two issues here: 1) Most search engines won't process a 302 as the item being permanently removed. This means bots will keep coming back and indexing the page. 2) Every time the url is requested, the event log gets an entry, which means it can be overwhelmed. The exception is shown below: !2014-08-22_12-21-24-cropped.png! +Resolution+ This needs to be fixed by: * Remove the 302 redirect when a deleted user is encountered * Change to return a 404 by showing the configured DNN 404 page for the portal. This should be achieved by raising a 404 exception which should 'bubble' up and be caught by the standard 404 handling""

Description: ""Permissions issue. Prior to Version 7.3x, there were no permissions issues concerning core modules and the ability to upload files. title: "SI: PreferredTimezone profile property not working"
description: """ I have set the registration to use the preferredtimezone property and that seems to be saving the timzone. The issue is that on Registration, PreferredTimeZone is NOT saving the value but the Text from dropdown. For example, if you choose (UTC-08:00) Baja California, it will save it as """"(UTC-08:00) Baja California"""" instead of it's value which is """"Pacific Standard Time (Mexico)"""".    On the profile page, it seems to be working fine. It only does not work on the initial custom Registration."""

title: "Run schedule at a fixed hour"
description: """Current options for the scheduler allow to specify a start date and time and a period of repeat.  So you can setup a task to start at 1AM and repeat every day and this, in theory should have a fixed execution at that time.  The problem is that when the task does not execute (server down, web inactive) or when someone manually executes the task, the next plan of execution is calculated from the last time of execution.    So if run the task at 5PM next execution will be 5PM + 1day.      The scheduler should support a configuration option to force the execution at a given hour and take this into consideration when assigning next execution time."""

So if run the task at 5PM next execution will be 5PM + 1day. The scheduler should support a configuration option to force the execution at a given hour and take this into consideration when assigning next execution time.""

title: "CDN urls are using the cdv value to negate benefit of using a CDN"
description: """When CDN is enabled, many of the URLs include the Site Version number in the query string.  This forces the browser to request a fresh copy of the code from the server thus circumventing any cached files and negating a large speed advantage of using a CDN.    Files coming from //ajax.aspnetcdn.com/ appear okay but //ajax.googleapis.com and //code.jquery.com include ?cdv=N.    All CDN files should be assumed long-term, stable content and not subject to Site Version increments.    To minimize DNS looks ups, please consider using just //ajax.aspnetcdn.com as it houses most files needed for a default install.    """

title: "RoleController.DeleteRole(RoleInfo role) does not clear user cache"
description: """RoleController.DeleteRole(RoleInfo role) does not clear user cache which results in the fact that after deleting a role (in the admin UI) the property UserInfo.Roles is not updated and still contains the deleted role. title: "Allow nofollow to login / register to avoid bots following (more traffic, even when you say noindex / robots.txt)"
description: """The default login.ascx and user.ascx in admin/skins do not have rel=""""nofollow"""" on the hyperlinks. For bots such as Google, it would be better to have rel=""""nofollow"""" as default on these.    The login control often appears on every page and has a different link per page. When Google is lucky, it guesses that these pages are all the same and just tries to index it once. But if you have a site with 1.000 pages and Google doesn't guess what returnurl means, it means 1.000 hits extra on your server.    See also http://www.mattcutts.com/blog/how-many-links-per-page/    Suggested change: add rel=""""nofollow"""" as default to the code base."""

title: "Expose User Folder Path In User Management"
description: """When administrating a DNN site with a large number of users, you sometimes need to locate the folder where a user's files are stored. The folder structure for the user folder is based on the User's ID but uses an algorithm so that the system can never exceed the Windows limits for the maximum number of subfolders allowed. In order to make it possible for the administrator to find a specific user's folder, the folder path needs to be exposed in the user management area.We will add this to the Account Information area."""

title: "SI: User Profile  - data inconsistency"
description: """UserProfile properties LastName and FirstName are retrieved from Users table, but when profile is saved data is stored in UserProfile table and in Users table.    This causing confusion as Search filters LastName and FirstName are used to retrieve data based on values in UserProfile table.    To reproduce:  1. Create 2 portals A and B  2. Register same user account on both portals  3. Log into portal A and update first name (nameA) and last name (lastnameA) profile properties  4. Log into portal B and update first name (nameB) and last name (lastnameB) profile properties  5. On portal A search using lastname filter (lastnameA)  6. On portal B search using lastname filter (lastnameB)    Actual result:  User profile show LastName value from Users table, but if you check UserProfile table value is different.    Expected result:  LastName and FirstName properties shouldn't be retrieved from user account, it should come from userprofile table.  """

title: "Improve Performance of Default.aspx"
description: """Default.aspx when processing the page unnecessarily thrashes through string concatenation building out various tasks.  Including inserting controls to the DOM tree when not needed.  Updating this to first of all only go through the effort if necessary and additionally when doing the concatenation do so with a more efficient manner to reduce the number of strings that are created and then immediately collected.  The following improvements are included as part of this contribution.    * Only adding literal control for comments in the header if a value is supplied.  (Prevents objects from being inserted to the collection)  * Cleaned up creation of page titles.  (Popups result in 2-3 less strings being created per page load.  Pages with titles result in 2-(page level) strings being prevented).  Reduces overall memory usage and items that need to be garbage collected. (Key change in in line 306 of Default.aspx in my pull request)  * Moved declaration of message string for the """"running defaults"""" check to inside the actual conditions it is needed.  Preventing string initialization    Example scenario with a site that has pages all with titles.  With 10,000 page views per day, no copyright credits and an average page depth of 2 and 75 percent of all page loads done by authenticated users.    * 10,000 literal controls not rendered  * 30,000 strings not allocated/garbage collected from the title change  * 7,500 strings not allocated/garbage collected from the running defaults change"""

title: "Content Localization fails if a Page has the same name in two Languages"
description: """A Website having a Page with a Name like “2sic” in German and English doesn’t work in the secondary Language. title: "LoadQueueFromTimer misses to pass the IISAppName"
description: """LoadQueueFromTimer (line 682 in dnn.platform/library/services/scheduling/scheduler.cs file) misses to pass the IISAppName, when requesting a single server from GetServers().Single(s => s.ServerName == executingServer) while unique index on the table includes both columns.  As a consequence, there might be multiple server rows returned and .Single fails.  see discussion at http://www.dnnsoftware.com/forums/forumid/108/threadid/502348/scope/posts.  I suggest using a stored procedure GetSingleServer with parameters ServerName and IISAppName to avoid this mistake and allow optimization in the database."""
input_text:
Title: LoadQueueFromTimer misses to pass the IISAppName
Description: ""LoadQueueFromTimer (line 682 in dnn.platform/library/services/scheduling/scheduler.cs file) misses to pass the IISAppName, when requesting a single server from GetServers().Single(s => s.ServerName == executingServer) while unique index on the table includes both columns. As a consequence, there might be multiple server rows returned and .Single fails. see discussion at http://www.dnnsoftware.com/forums/forumid/108/threadid/502348/scope/posts. I suggest using a stored procedure GetSingleServer with parameters ServerName and IISAppName to avoid this mistake and allow optimization in the database.""

title: "Extension method ""ToDataTable"" for binding PetaPoco result set IEnumerable<dynamic> to webcontrols"
description: """PetaPoco is mostly used together with strong typed Info-classes. Thats nice and working well but sometimes we need a more flexible way to get retrieve data. Think of a simple module where the user enters an arbitrary select statement to any table of the database (yes, I wont do that! Its just for explanation!). With PetaPoco this could be done with ExecuteQuery<dynamic> and the result is of type IEnumerable<dynamic>. This is nice and working """"out of the box"""". But you can not databind this IEnumerable<dynamic> to a datagrid : even if the data is retrieved correctly, nothing is shown in the grid. So I implemented an extension method for IEnumerable<dynamic> named """"ToDataTable"""" (see Git Pull Request). """

title: "Avoid EffectiveDate/ExpiryDate checking on the UserRoles table by adding a periodic check and setting a boolean"
description: """The UserRoles table uses EffectiveDate and ExpiryDate to record whether a user should be in the role or not. This is fine for an application with a reasonable amount of users. But when running a lot of users, there is a bottleneck in drawing out membership from this. In my application I need to check sometimes 100s of thousands of records against role membership. Recently a client came forth who has 28000 users on his site and had serious performance issues. Ideally I'd like the UserRoles table to have a boolean value specifying whether the UserRole is active or not and a scheduled maintenance task to set the bit."""

title: "System shared assemblies are being deleted when 3rd party modules are uninstalled"
description: """Bug 1:  When a 3rd. party extension is installed, a shared DLL is overwritten even being flagged as the same (or even previous) version of the one being shipped with DNN.  It could be Newtonsoft.Json.dll, any of the Lucene.Net...dll, etc.  If the 3rd. party module's manifest says for example:              <assembly>                <path>bin</path>                <name>Lucene.Net.dll</name>                <version>03.00.03</version>              </assembly>  why the DLL in /bin is anyway overwritten? It should not, because it is already there.  Even worse, if a previous version is included, the one in /bin will be overwritten anyway.     Bug 2:  When the 3rd. party extension is uninstalled, the shared DLL is deleted from /bin.  Let's say a module includes Newtonsoft.Json.dll. When uninstalled, it is deleted from /bin. This brings the site down.    Bottom line:  The DLLs shipped with DNN should be flagged as such, and should not be overwritten unless the version included in the 3rd party extension is newer then the the one already installed. It looks like this is not being verified at all.   When the 3rd. party extension is uninstalled, the shared DLL must be kept.   Now it is being kept when other 3rd extension is using it, but the core itself is being ignored.   """

title: "Rename of SharpZipLib.dll, breaks backward compatiblity"
description: """In version 7.2.2 the """"SharpZipLib.dll"""" file matched all other version names.  But in v7.3 the file name of the dll has changed to     ICSharpCode.SharpZipLib.dll    This means, although the code has changed in DNN, any module referencing the old dll has a backward compatibility issue.      The solution is simple, just set a ref to the new dll, but that means module need to have 2 versions for DNN7.2 and below and now DNN7.3 or to distribute the old dll with your module.    I think it would be best if the name of the dll stayed as """"SharpZipLib.dll"""", unless there is some special reason for the change?      Also a good enhancement would be to have a function in the FileSystemUtils called """"Unzip"""", this would stop the need to reference the SharpZipLib.dll from modules..            public static void UnZip(string zipFileMapPath, string outputFolder)          {              var zipStream = new FileStream(zipFileMapPath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);              var zStream = new ZipInputStream(zipStream);              UnzipResources(zStream, outputFolder);              zipStream.Close();              zStream.Close();          }    """

title: "Improve cacheability for unauthenticated (public) pages to allow caching on client and proxies for better worldwide performance."
description: """See http://www.dnnsoftware.com/forums/forumid/205/threadid/500562/scope/posts/threadpage/2.    We are running DNN on a W2K8 server and time to fetch the HTML is typically 500 ms for an unauthenticated user. We have placed a caching proxy in front of DNN (Apache with mod_cache). At that time, we've found that DNN always sends the HTTP/1.1 response header Cache-Control as no-cache. This makes it hard to cache the page at the ultimate user's PC or any in-between proxy like Apache here.  You can of course overrule mod_cache to still cache it when not requested to. If you do so, the response time decreases to a few milliseconds when the same page is loaded for the second time and DNN is not hit at all.    However, it is better to send a meaningful Cache-Control response header. To allow configuration, some changes are needed:    Default.aspx.cs:  Around line 265:  Add else branch like this:                else              {                          // Unauthenticated users.                          // MAKE CONFIGURABLE IN HOST SETTINGS.                          Response.Cache.SetCacheability(HttpCacheability.ServerAndPrivate);                          //                          // Allow proxies to cache for one day.                          //                          // MAKE CONFIGURABLE IN HOST SETTINGS.                          Response.Cache.SetProxyMaxAge(new TimeSpan(24, 0, 0));                          //                          // Enforce not caching at client.                          //                          // MAKE CONFIGURABLE IN HOST SETTINGS.                          Response.Cache.SetMaxAge(new TimeSpan(0, 0, 30));              }    Also, you might want to add options for maximum age in cache and maximum age on client for authenticated users for full symmetry. Although I don't know a case yet where you would want all authenticated output to be cached anywhere or in the private store of the user's PC.    *Testing Notes:*  - This adds a new host settings """"Unauthenticated Cacheability"""", located under the Advanced Tab and the Performance section (make sure to look for it and to test saving this and other settings as part of regression)  -- This setting check is done as part of the Default.aspx page (every page view in DNN)  - This link explains how to view http headers in the Chrome browser: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/4423061/view-http-headers-in-google-chrome (this is necessary for testing when the setting is enabled)  -- When enabled, the value (for unauthenticated users) should match what was set in the dropdown for the setting.  """

title: "DAM: AddFile throws error if file exists on disk but not in Files table"
description: """If the file system is not synchronized the file provider will error out because of the following. The method to call up is this one (in FileManager.cs):    public virtual IFileInfo AddFile(IFolderInfo folder, string fileName, Stream fileContent, bool overwrite, bool checkPermissions, string contentType, int createdByUserID)    on line 354 we find:              bool fileExists = folderProvider.FileExists(folder, fileName);    This actually checks if the file exists in it's place (i.e. on disk using the default provider).    on line 363:              var oldFile = fileExists ? GetFile(folder, fileName, true) : null;    The value of oldFile is expected if the file is found. This is not the case if the file actually exists but it's not in the Files table. So oldFile is null in that case!    on line 434:                      if (fileExists && FileLockingController.Instance.IsFileOutOfPublishPeriod(oldFile, folder.PortalID, createdByUserID))    We're calling to see if the file is outside the publish period. But we're passing in oldFile which is null.    And finally in the FileLockingController.cs we find          private bool IsFileOutOfPublishPeriod(IFileInfo file)          {              //Publish Period locks              return (file.EnablePublishPeriod && (file.StartDate > DateTime.Today || (file.EndDate < DateTime.Today && file.EndDate != Null.NullDate)));          }    Which throws the error because there is no null check on oldFile."""

GetFile(folder, fileName, true) : null; The value of oldFile is expected if the file is found. This is not the case if the file actually exists but it's not in the Files table. title: "Upgrade logic/installer should verify write permissions before starting"
description: """Disk permissions remain one of the most common stumbling blocks for people during upgrade of DNN. And indeed for modules as well. The consequences of not getting this right are catastrophic as SQL will run but the application will not upgrade correctly leaving the user with a totally broken installation. I suggest to check disk permissions *before* anything is attempted.    Recently I fell victim to it myself. Migrating a site to a new server and creating the site in IIS I overlooked that IIS 7+ uses App Pool Identity instead of Network Service. It's really easily overlooked."""

title: "DDRMenu 02.00.03 is very slow with more than about 1'500 DNN Pages"
description: """See [http://dnnddrmenu.codeplex.com/workitem/13141]    In DNN 7.1.2 on a Portal with about 4’000 DNN Pages/Tabs a single DDRMenu in the Skin needs about 1.5 seconds to render on a fast computer. Without the DDRMenu the same DNN page needs only about 0.04 seconds to render.    There’s no difference if only the 9 Root-Tabs are shown.    Example usage:  {{<dnn:DDRMENU MenuStyle=""""nav2/main"""" NodeSelector=""""RootOnly"""" runat=""""server"""" />}}  The time is used in the PreRender Event and causes high CPU Usage on the IIS, not on the SQL Server. There’s no difference whether txt or razor/cshtml Templates are used. Even with a completely empty razor file it’s the same behavior.    That indicates the time is wasted by building the DataModel with too many data. This can probably be optimized by using inversion of control or lazy loading to only load the requested child-tabs with specified depth.  ----  We decided to use Snapsis Menu 3.4.6 to work around this performance issue.  The identical main- and submenu (two instances) need less than 0.07 to render. Maybe you can benefit from their knowhow.  ----  Today we had a huge performance Issue in DNN 7.2.2 on just one Portal with about 1'400 Pages. With DDR Menu a Page took up to 6.8 Seconds to Load (!) and without the Menu about 0.5 Seconds.    The Performance Impact is different whether logged in or not."""

title: "Unique Index of PackageDependencies needs to be fixed"
description: """Table PackageDependencies stores dependencies between an existing package (identified by PackageID) and a JS library, identified by PackageName (lets call it TargetPackageName) and Version (I call it here TargetVersion).   The current unique index contains all three columns, allowing same package relying on same TargetPackageName and multiple TargetVersions, which should not be possible (not multiple records as """"OR"""" supported"""").    DROP INDEX [IX_{objectQualifier}PackageDependencies_Dependant] ON {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}PackageDependencies]  GO  DROP INDEX [IX_{objectQualifier}PackageDependencies_Package] ON {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}PackageDependencies]  GO  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX [IX_{objectQualifier}PackageDependencies_Dependant] ON {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}PackageDependencies]  (PackageID, PackageName) INCLUDE (Version)  GO  DELETE FROM {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}PackageDependencies]  WHERE PackageDependencyID NOT IN (SELECT Max(PackageDependenyID) FROM {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}PackageDependencies] GROUP BY PackageID, PackageName)  GO  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX [IX_{objectQualifier}PackageDependencies_Package] ON {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}PackageDependencies]  (PackageName, PackageID) INCLUDE (Version)  GO  """

title: "Max File Size cannot increase beyond 28 Mb"
description: """1) Navigate to Host > Host Settings > Other Settings tab: Max Upload Size and increase it to max 30 Mb or any number higher than 28 Mb. A warning message appears indicating the max upload size is only 28 Mb.    2) Navigate to Host > HTML Editor Manager > click on Everyone > Document Manager Settings: Max File Size by default is 1024000 bytes.  Q - Shouldn't this by default be the same as the Minimum default Upload Size in Host Settings > Other Settings tab? (i.e. 12582912 bytes)    3) Navigate to Host > HTML Editor Manager > click on Everyone > Image Manager Settings: Max File Size by default is 1024000 bytes.  Q - Shouldn't this by default be the same as the Minimum default Upload Size in Host Settings > Other Settings tab? (i.e. 12582912 bytes)    4) Now increase the Max File Sizes within the Image Manager & Document Manager Settings to 31457280 bytes (30 Mb), This should not be an acceptable value as it should not exceed the 28 Mb, based on the earlier warning message in  Host > Host Settings > Other Settings tab: Max Upload Size (28 Mb max).    5) In the web.config change the maxRequestLength and requestLenghtDiskThreshold to any number between 12 Mb to 28 Mb, this number will automatically be reflected in the Host > Host Settings > Other Settings tab: Max Upload Size correctly. However, if you increase the number in the maxRequestLength and requestLenghtDiskThreshold beyond 28 Mb (i.e. 30 Mb) the webconfig will save the change but the Host > Host Settings > Other Settings tab: Max Upload Size remains at 28 Mb.    6) Even if the web.config is set with a higher upload value than 28 Mb, the Image Manager & Document Manager Settings are set higher than 28 Mb, documents / files larger than 28 Mb will not upload and an warning message appears that it has exceeded the max size.    There appears to be a disconnect between the settings in Host > Host Settings > Other Settings tab: Max Upload Size and an input of a value in the web.config maxRequestLength and requestLenghtDiskThreshold or the Max File Sizes within the Image Manager & Document Manager Settings. Equally as important as these feature disconnects indicate a broken functionality, the Max size should not be limited to 28 Mb as customers frequently upload documents / images larger than 28 Mb.    http://www.dnnsoftware.com/wiki/page/working-with-large-files    """

title: "Increase default maxRequestLength for large packages"
description: """The default DNN web.config puts the maxRequestLength at 12288 (12MB) and executionTimeout at 900 seconds. Over time, modules have become more powerful and we're getting closer to hitting that limit.    For example, the Revindex Storefront module is 9.8MB. Many customers, especially enterprise customers who have DNN EVOQ PRO, have been asking to include the ability to print reports and confirmation pages in PDF. However, any decent PDF library (dll) is about 8MB to 10MB and that pushes the package size over the current default limit. So we end up holding back implementing the feature because it has an overall negative impact to other users (especially new users who are unfamiliar or unable to change the web.config limits).    Can you please consider doubling the max request length limit and the respective execution time needed to upload the package? At least make it bigger than 18MB.    Thank you."""

title: "Web Upload in Host Does Not Upload"
description: """http://www.dnnsoftware.com/forums/forumid/108/threadid/500606/scope/posts    In >Admin >File Manager (DAM) I can drag files from my local machine or use web upload to place files into a test admin folder. Both of these methods function as expected.    In >Host >File Manager (DAM) I can drag files from my local machine or use web upload to place file into a test host folder. Drag/drop functions as expected. Web Upload appears to upload but it does not. If I try web upload a second time it asks if I want to replace. I select replace and it appears to upload but it does not. Also, the file is not referenced in the database.    In this case: >Host >File Manager (DAM) does not upload the file when using 'Web Upload'.  I checked the folder through FTP and the file does not exist on the server... also the database has no reference.  The DAM does work for drag/drop.    I now have this on two installs. 1) A fresh install on localhost dev machine and 2) An upgrade from DNN 6 on a production server.  Both installs have the same issue.    There is no entry in the Event View regarding this action.  However, I did find the problem. Not sure yet how to solve it as it appears to be a core code issue.       When I originally did the test I used the same folder name in both >Admin >FileManager and >Host  >FileManager. I then used the same two files for both the >Admin >FileManager and >Host  >FileManager.       So... this morning I tried using the same folder names under both Admin and Host, but I used different files for Admin/TestFolder and Host/TestFolder.       Behold! When using the web upload in host it uploads the file to the Portal0/TestFolder and not the Host/TestFolder.  The reason I did not see the reference in the database with the first test was because the file name used for the web upload was the same file… thus it existed in the database for portal0/testfolder and not host/testfolder.       >Host >FileManager >WebUpload does in fact upload the file ---but--- it uploads it to the Portal0/TestFolder and not the Host/TestFolder.  I did not try with two different folder names for Admin and Host… doesn’t really matter at this time since this is obviously appears to be a core code bug. title: "SI: Localized Page Export to Alternate Language Module Permissions"
description: """When exporting a page then importing it within the same locale, module permissions that have been customized are maintained. Importing a page to an alternate locale - same site instance - removes all but the basic admin and inherited view permissions from a module.    Steps to reproduce:   1. Create a site with two languages and Enable Localized Content.  2. Modify an exiting page or create a new page with modules that have permissions modified for other roles. Roles can be custom or standard.  3. Export the page then import it to the alternate language.    Expected results - The page is imported with all module permissions set the same as when the page was exported.    Actual Results - The module permissions revert to the basic Admin and View privileges (that are inherited from the page)."""
