title: "Prepare DNN for the cloud: switch to UTC"
description: """When moving DNN to the cloud with webservers and database servers in multiple locations, timestamp cannot be generated any longer just from local server time, but needs to use universal time coordinated (UTC). This requires shifting all time columns by time zone difference, e.g.  UPDATE USERS   SET CreatedAtDate = DateAdd(CreatedAtDate, DateDiff(GetDateUTC()-GetDate()), LastModifiedAtDate =   DateAdd(LastModifiedAtDate , DateDiff(GetDateUTC()-GetDate())  And replace default constraints to use GetDateUTC() instead of GetDate().  In DNN code behind, when displaying time values, it needs to be converted from UTC to local (user) time.  This does affect nearly all tables and a lot of code, but is necessary to handle distributed websites. This should also be used to make sure, all code is retrieving dates using the proper method to retrieve it from the database server instead of the web serser."""

title: "Multiple Languages causes spontaneous frequent cache refreshes and breaks WebCachingProvider"
description: """This issue is reproducible in DNN 722 Professional and Community editions.      1. Install a vanilla DNN site  2. Goto Admin->Event Viewer  3. At the bottom of the module click """"Edit Log Settings""""  4. Enable logging for the """"Cache Refresh"""" item.  5. While viewing the log click Tools->Clear Cache to show the event logs when the cache is cleared.  6. If you wait a couple of minutes you should see the log is quiet (i.e. no spontaneous cache refresh events occur).  7. Go to Admin->Languages.  8. Click """"Add New Language"""".  9. Add the language """"English (Australia)"""".  10. Go back to the event log. The cache refresh events are now triggering spontaneously and very frequently.    This causes the WebCachingProvider to lockup as the site can't handle the number of requests - the site also seems to basically function without a cache which is potentially a significant performance issue in production."""

title: "Separate login of lastIP address from Users table to a dedicated table"
description: """h3. Current Situation  Whenever a user logs in to any site, his IP address is stored in Column {{LastIPAddress}} of {{Users}} table via {{UpdateUser}} procedure and {{Users.lastModifiedDate}} gets updated.   While this is technically correct, it is hard to track, when the user or admin last changed any of his user data and it requires to merge or overwrite records within users table in staging scenarios. Conceptually, this is mixing master data and transactional data within the same object/table.  Performance is affected as users table gets updated constantly.   And although successful logins might be logged in Eventlog as well, this table doesn't offer the same option for assigning it to a single user or search, when a specific user logged in last/before.    h3. Idea  A better solution would be separating the login information to a dedicated table, which could also hold more than just the single last IP address and additional data like UserAgent and/or portal alias/port being used.    h3. Solution  I enclosed a SQL script implementing the data layer for a solution, which supports both, IP_V4 and IP_V6 addresses and userAgent as well as a configurable number of logins to be kept per user and portal.   * Table {{UserLogins}} holds a record for each user login with all necessary information. IP addresses are stored as varbinary, for easy sorting and optimal use of database space. The table might be easily extended to log port and or portal alias being used etc.  * A new host setting specifies, how many logins should be kept per user and website (-1: unlimited, 0: disable logging, >= 1: number of records to keep)  * Procedure {{AddUserLogin}} is designed to be used to record a login, while   * procedure {{GetUserLogins}} is used to list all logins for a single user (single portal to admin, all portals to superusers) or all users (per portal for admins, all portals for superusers).   * If only last login should be populated for all users, you may use {{GetUsersLastLogin}}.   * Procedure {{GetUsersLoginByIP}} might be used to detect/analyse logins from a specific IP range.  * Function Last_UserIPAddress is provided to substitute column LastIPAddress in Users table.  * Function {{FormatIPAddress}} may be used to display an address as string, while   * functions {{Read_IV_V4}} and {{Read_IV_V6}} may convert from string to varbinary. In general, those conversions should be performed in API level, not in the database.    h3. title: "Stored Procedure GetUserProfile needs PortalID param"
description: """Stored Procedure GetUserProfile is used to return the user Profile for a user. It gets passed the UserId, but no PortalID, and therefore would return all properties of the user. In a shared Hosting Installation with many portals, this might return a huge number of properties for a user, who is member of multiple sites, instead just returning the Profile for current Website.    Improved Version:  CREATE PROCEDURE {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}GetUserProfile]    @UserID Int -- Not Null          @PortalID Int -- Null: Host Profiles  AS  BEGIN   SELECT ProfileID,       UserID,       PropertyDefinitionID,       CASE WHEN (PropertyValue Is Null) THEN PropertyText ELSE PropertyValue END AS 'PropertyValue',       Visibility,       ExtendedVisibility,       LastUpdatedDate    FROM  {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}UserProfile]    WHERE UserId = @UserID           AND     PropertyDefinitionID IN (SELECT PropertyDefinitionID FROM {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}ProfilePropertyDefinitions] WHERE IsNull(PortalID, -1) = IsNull(@PortalID, -1))  END  GO  """

This is how the node is formed:  {color:blue}   <component type=""""Assembly"""">            <assemblies>              <basePath>bin</basePath>              <assembly>                <name>CustomModule.dll</name>              </assembly>            </assemblies>          </component>  {color}    This is the Warning EVS will generate    {quote}  Message: basePath is not a valid node in component with type 'Assembly'.  Rule: PackageVerification.Rules.Manifest.Components.AssemblyNode  {quote}    The following is how it should be formed as indicated in the DNN wiki for manifest resources:    {color:blue}   <component type=""""Assembly"""">            <assemblies>                          <assembly>               <Path>bin</Path>                <name>CustomModule.dll</name>              </assembly>            </assemblies>          </component>  {color}    Here is the link to the DNN wiki    http://www.dnnsoftware.com/wiki/page/manifest-file-component  """

title: "SI: Portal Import should consider actual module instances in the tab structure instead of relying on the ""All Tabs"""
description: """Display on All Pages feature allows to mark module as Display on All pages, but at the same time same module can be deleted from some page.  Great example is an Admin pages.  Template Export does the right job and if module was deleted it won’t be present in the template.   However template import doesn't consider that and unable to process that correctly…if module is marked as """"Display on All pages"""", but deleted from some of those pages newly created portal will have it on all pages.    Steps to reproduce (based on customer's report):  If you put a module on a page and say display on all pages, but then you  remove it from a few of the pages, export the template. I would assume  the pages you removed it from WOULD NOT have the module on it when you  build from that template(which is how it works in 6.2.3), but now in  7.2.2 it puts it on ALL pages no matter whether it's on the page in the  template or not.  I would consider this still broken. We are having to go back and  currently ADD(7.2.0) the module on the needed pages currently. If we  were to roll 7.2.2 to production, it would require us to go in and  REMOVE the module from all the pages it's not supposed to be on.  """

title: "Module Control ControlType Should Support Custom Permissions"
description: """Module Controls have a ControlType property which has Allowable values of Anonymous, View, Edit, Admin, Host. ControlType tells the page compositing engine the type of permission that a user needs in order to load the control into a page. ControlType is currently managed as an enumeration and is stored as an Integer value in the ModuleControls database table.    In order to support custom Permission Types within modules, we should introduce a new ControlPermission field in the ModuleControls table that is a String. We will populate the value of this field based on the ControlType - using the name of the enumerated item rather than an integer. We will remove Control Type from the user interface and allow a host user to enter a textbox for Control Permission in the Extensions UI ( the default value should be View ). We will modify the core platform to utilize the ControlPermission rather than the ControlType ( ie. it will be deprecated ). We will introduce a new node in the manifest for <ControlPermission> which will be processed during installation and should also be included in the Module Packager. For older modules that continue to ship using the <ControlType> we will utilize the value and populate the ControlPermission. Module Creator will need to be modified to support more than View/Edit types.    Anonymous, Admin, and Host do not refer to permission types - they refer to roles, and will continue to be handled the same way that they always have been. View, Edit, and any other values ( ie. custom permissions ) will be interpreted as a Permission Type for the module and will utilize the platform permission system to determine if the control can be loaded. If the value specified does not map to a permission type for the module, the control should not be loaded.    """

title: "Support for additional Permissions"
description: """All permissions ultimately flow through PortalSecurity.IsInRoles(string). This method is currently capable of dealing with permissions strings that contain RoleNames and UserIDs ( both grant and deny ). There are some additional types of """"permissions"""" that should be supported as well:    Friend - is the current user a friend of a specific user  Follower - is the current user a follower of a specific user  Owner - is the current user a match     We can support these additional permission types by treating them as internal RoleNames. For example we can have permissions strings such as:    """";FRIEND:9;"""" - is the current user a friend of UserID = 9  """";FOLLOWER:9;"""" - is the current user a follower of UserID = 9  """";OWNER:9;"""" - is the current user's ID = 9    Internally, when the IsInRoles() method processes the RoleNames, it can check if a RoleName has any of the above prefixes and if so it can do the additional processing of loading the friends or followers for the specified UserID and checking if the current user is a match.    It would also be useful to have some simple helper methods in PortalSecurity for:    IsFriend(UserID)  IsFollower(UserID)  IsOwner(UserID)    each of which would contruct the permissions string according to what was described above and call IsInRoles()"""

title: "update the Prevent Lowercase URL Regular Expression to include admin/host pages"
description: """We’ve had a number of issues raised where using lowercase url’s with AUM caused functions to break (e.g. editing a module, deleting a module, ordering/filtering user on admin->users [or indeed anything using that grid control]). Typically these are because of case-sensitive matches on things such as DataKey’s and to date we’ve been fixing them by fixing the case of these so that the request/response values match (or changing the check to be case-insensitive). However it’s a somewhat whack-a-mole approach, particularly as none of use lowercase url’s as our default so we don’t notice them but have to respond to jira items.    To prevent this we need to add relevant default values to  the Prevent Lowercase URL Regular Expression property e.g.    /ctl/|/locale/|/Admin/|/Host/    Bruce had previously noted that AUM should be switched off for all admin/host pages, so this is another option."""

title: "Schedule REQUEST_MODE can cause multiple instances of the scheduler provider to be loaded on application startup"
description: """On systems where the scheduler mode is set to REQUEST_MODE  - there is a possibility that the code that is triggered on the httprequest handler - to attempt to start the scheduler - can be executed more that once.    http://www.dnnsoftware.com/forums/forumid/216/threadid/497534/scope/posts  discusses the issue at some length - including debug logs that demonstrate it happening.    But in essence - the call to RunSchedule() is made every time a request is made for a page on a dnn site.   When the application pool is starting up - it is currently possible for the SchedulingProvider.ReadyForPoll test to return true more than once.  If there are multiple new page requests hitting the server during the application pool startup.    This is a common occurrence on low demand dnn sites that dont utilize any sort of keep alive tool - when those sites are visited by a crawler.  For example.    Site is offline   - crawler targets the site - potentially firing off a number page requests at all but the same time.  - Asp.net sees first request and starts the process of bringing the dnn application into the application pool.  - while this is happening other requests start arriving.  During this phase the DotNetNuke Http Application handler starts catching Application_BeginRequest events.  - One of the actions this triggers is the call to RunSchedule.    Inside RunSchedule - the systems tests to see if SchedulingProvider.ReadyForPoll is true -  which basically it is taking to mean the scheduler is not currently running.    If this is the case is then starts the process of creating a new SchedulingProvider.Instance() thread - which ultimately brings the scheduler online.    BUT the problem is - there is potentially a considerable lag between when SchedulingProvider.ReadyForPoll is tested and found to be true - and when the system has got the scheduler thread running and SchedulingProvider.ReadyForPoll is eventually put into a start that allows it to return a value of  false.    IF there are multiple httprequest arriving at the server during this phase - see the forum thread for example from debug log test - in the time between when the first request tests ReadyForPoll - other requests can also have tested ReadyForPoll - and all get to see the result of the test as TRUE.    At which stage - they each of those page requests all try to start triggering the process of starting up a schedulerprovider background worker thread.    On my test system - i was easily able to trigger 3 or 4 separate instances of the schedulerprovider on a regular basis - simply by manually starting 4 browser pages at the same time --  on a system being hit by a search crawler - that often fire off 5-10 or more requests at once - it would not be unlikely for that to be the case ....   AND ironically may be the cause of a number of different system event log errors and forced application pool restarts that clients have reported in the past that seem to always relate to sites being hit be web crawlers.    To fix the issue - I am suggesting that a lock() statement on a static local object should be added - this will prevent more than one instance of the schedulerprivider ever being created    If the file - DNN Platform\Library\Common\Initialize.cs    -------------------------------------------------------  private static readonly object _schedulerStarting = new object();  public static void RunSchedule(HttpRequest request)  {  if (!IsUpgradeOrInstallRequest(request))  {  try  {  lock (_schedulerStarting)  {  if (SchedulingProvider.SchedulerMode == SchedulerMode.REQUEST_METHOD && SchedulingProvider.ReadyForPoll)  {  Logger.Trace(""""Running Schedule """" + (SchedulingProvider.SchedulerMode));  var scheduler = SchedulingProvider.Instance();  var requestScheduleThread = new Thread(scheduler.ExecuteTasks) { IsBackground = true };  requestScheduleThread.Start();  SchedulingProvider.ScheduleLastPolled = DateTime.Now;  }  }  }  catch (Exception exc)  {  Exceptions.LogException(exc);  }  }  }"""

title: "Give Journal Module Option to be Group Specific"
description: """The Journal module currently gets its mode from a URL parameter. For social groups, it looks for the """"GroupID"""" in the URL. This fits nicely with the DNN planned use of the module working with the social groups module. But, it does very poorly for """"formal"""" groups on sites that have existing, fixed, pages.    As an example, say a site has an existing role populated with users and a special page for those people. There is no good method to have those roles use the journal module on an existing, fixed, page. This comes up all the time: members of a church or organization and administrative groups (staff, etc.) are some examples.     If you have an existing """"Staff"""" page and want the journal module on there, you would have to make sure that every single time somebody linked to the staff page, they did so with the group ID. Similarly, somebody could change the GroupID and show journal entries for a different group on a page designed for a given group. This means, in practice, that you can't have the """"journal"""" module show on your existing """"staff"""" page.    The """"Members Directory"""" module already is designed to allow this behavior; it's frustrating that the journal module is not.     Improvement:    Make a setting in the journal module for """"Mode"""" with options of """"Automatic (Default)"""", or """"Group"""". Then, if group is specified, allow choosing an existing social role. When done, the module would ignore any groupid or userid url parameters and instead just always act for that group. The permissions and everything else for visibility should work exactly as if the groupid came from the url parameter.    This would greatly improve the usability and versatility of the journal module.    Incidentally, looking through the code in the journalmodulebase, it looks like this is already partially implemented or is in-progress.   """

title: "CDN for jQuery library is broken"
description: """When _Use javascript libraries CDN?_ is checked in Host Settings (_CDN Settings_ under _Advanced Settings_ tab), there is a JavaScript error on the page: """"SyntaxError: missing ) after argument list""""    This is caused by the following markup:        The issue causing the error is that (1) the {{document.write}} statement is using single quotes inside of the single-quoted string, and (2) the script doesn't complete the statement (it is missing {{');}} before the }).  -These aren't issues with the other CDN checks, so whatever special case that the jQuery script has should probably use the same thing the other scripts are using.-  The other CDN checks I was looking at were from Telerik CDN scripts, which aren't going through the same system.  So this does, in fact, affect all other scripts, too.    However, even if these issues were fixed, there's also an issue that the check to see if it's defined happens _before_ the script is included.  So, if the script _worked_, it would include the local jQuery and the CDN jQuery every time."""

title: "Enable composite files (CRM) can generate request with too long query string "
description: """Enable composite files (CRM) can generate request with too long query string.  When DnnCompositeFileProcessor is set to use urlType = Base64QueryStrings and Enable Composite Files is enabled in client resource management (host settings), the system generate composite javascript/css files and them urls looks like the follow:        Decoding the base64 *s* parameter we can see that this represent the list of javascript/css files separated by *;* (see below)      If the page contains a long list of javascript or css files, that also are defined in a complex folder structure the query string can quickly grow reaching the maxQueryStringRequest (by default is 2048). In this case we will run into 404.15 response from the server      This can easily fixed changing the configuration of the web.config to allow requests with a longer query string value.    *Improvement request*  Nowadays web sites is going to have more javascript code and files. Should be interesting investigate why the DnnCompositeFileProcessor is generating so long query string values, and if there is a way to prevent it, keeping it independent of the number of javascript/css files.   In this case we can prevent users to change the default MaxQueryString value in the web.config."""

title: "create whitelist filter to be used when validating content"
description: """At present we have routines to encode or filter data -the filtering routines use a blacklist filter (i.e. remove found terms), but we should add a whitelist filter to only allow valid content.    There are a few options available, and all of them have an element of risk.  1. Anti-XSS – this is a library from Microsoft which contains methods to both encode and sanitize. The relevant method we would want to utilize is SafeHtml, however only the encoding methods can be run in medium trust, all sanitizing methods (including SafeHtml) would still require full trust. In addition the reviews are appalling with lots of complaints about perfectly safe html being stripped (http://wpl.codeplex.com/releases/view/80289#ReviewsAnchor)  2. Writing our own regular expression to parse – this can be tricky and can miss content/strip innocent content, particularly if html is not xhmtl valid.  3. Using an existing library e.g. http://roberto.open-lab.com/2010/03/04/a-html-sanitizer-for-c/ - however whilst this uses whitelisting for main tags, it uses blacklisting for styles (and hasn’t been updated in 4 years)  4. Using the html agility pack to generate an accurate DOM and then parsing that (likely with the library listed in 3 with a few amendments) - http://stackoverflow.com/questions/3107514/html-agility-pack-strip-tags-not-in-whitelist . We already use the htmlagilitypack in evoq in the searchspider and html modules so we have to take care that we do not cause issues if we use this library/    Note: I suggest that this would be a better solution if we abstracted the existing core InputFilter methods out to an """"input filter provider"""" - we could then provide an alternative implementation (e.g. antixss for sites running under full trust or using .net 4.5)"""

title: "CoreMessaging_MessageAttachment: enforced integrity needed"
description: """Table CoreMessaging_MessageAttachments stored attached files for each message. Currently the table just has a PK on MessageAttachmentID, no further indexes and no FKs. When a file is attached, a record is created, when the file gets removed, the record is deleted. To implement this behavior properly, FileId column has to be implemented """"Not Null"""" and there needs to be FKs on CoreMessaging_Messages.MessageId and Files.FileID (on Update No Action, on Delete No Action).  For performance, add a unique clustered Index  CoreMessaging_MessageAttachments_Message (MessageID, FileId), which also prevents the same file to be attached twice to the same message.  DeleteFile and DeleteFiles need to either prevent deletion or delete attachment as well."""

title: "Hide Password Reset Form on Successful Entry"

This is confusing and can make users think they need to re-enter their information if they don't notice or read the success notification. Also, it leaves the """"Cancel"""" button at the bottom which causes additional confusion for some users.     A simple improvement would be to hide the form and default informational message when the email is sent. The change here is very simple: just do pnlRecover.Visible = False; whenever the success message would be shown.  """

title: "Action Icons not showing in DNN 7 / DNN 7 Action Icons depend on control panel"
description: """After an upgrade from DNN 5 to 7.2.1 I noticed that only one action icon showed up only on the first module on a page (in edit mode).  All the other modules have no action icons.    I tested an old skin (minimal extropy) and that one did work as expected.  But when I stripped down the used skin to only a content pane, the icons still did not show up.    I luckily  remembered that someone posted he fixed this by adding the search skin object to the skin. After I did that the Icons appeared as expected.    Finally I noticed that the other thing that helps is switching to the DNN6 or DNN 7 control panel.    Both the search skin object and the new control panels load jQuery UI.    And as the upgraded installation still had the Iconbar control panel from DNN 5, jQuery UI does not get loaded.    My conclusion is that the code for the action icons depends on another component to load jQuery UI. IMO that's not good. The action icons code code should also try to load all needed libaries.    Especially because you cannot be sure people use the default control panels or the search skin object.    Adding the jQuery(ui) skin object to the skin would solve the problem but  is not the right solution as the skin is not using jQuery UI at all. It's only needed for editing and thus should not be loaded in View mode.    Reproduce:    1. Set the Iconbar as control panel for the installation  2. Create a page  3. Add 2 html modules to the page  4. Create a skin with only a content pane and set is as page skin    The Icons do show up correctly."""

title: "[Twitter Provider] Invalid non-unique username is created in DNN"

Install/deploy and configure the Twitter-provider correctly. To be entirely sure, make sure the application added/configured in Twitter itself has every possible permissions available (read/write/read DM's).  3. Try to log in into the clean portal using a Twitter-account.  4. Ignore the error-message that is displayed after loggin in using Twitter for the first time (I have created a separate issue for that: DNN-4737).  5. title: "Allow admins choice of vanity url path"
description: """7.1 introduced the concept of vanity URLs, where a user could choose a vanity name to use for their user profile URL.    The URL was then shown as a single-level path from the site root, ie example.com/vanity-name    In 7.1.1 or 7.1.2 this was changed to introduce the path of the user profile page, so that the username came to a 2nd level path - example.com/users/vanity-name    The problem with this is that people who started using the feature in 7.1 now have broken URLs if they upgrade to a later version.    Proposed Fix  Add in a configuration setting which allows administrators to choose whether they want to show the user-profile page url in the vanity username path, or whether they want to show the vanity path directly from the site root.      This value would be configurable at either the host or portal level (the same as other friendly url settings).    The configuration setting name would be AUM_ShowUserProfileURLInVanityURL.  'True' would be the default value (if the setting was omitted or set to true) and 'False' would be the value required to remove the user profile page URL from the vanity URLs.    As it it set once-only per install or portal creation (an administrator would never change it) it is acceptable that this would have no UI component - the value would be set by altering the value directly at the database level.    The default value for new installs would remain that the vanity url is shown underneath the URL for the user profile page.    Test Case 1  ---------------  Create a new site, create a vanity user profile URL for a specific user.  Verify that the user profile URL shows the URL for the User Profile page (ie, example.com/users/vanity-url).  Add the setting AUM_ShowUserProfileURLInVanityURL to the portal settings table, setting the value to 'False'.  Refresh the site cache    -Expected Behaviour-  The vanity url for the user now shows example.com/vanity-url    Test Case 2  ---------------  Create another portal within the same installation  Assign a vanity URL to a user within the new portal    -Expected Behaviour-  The vanity url shows example2.com/users/vanity-url    Test Case 3  ---------------  Add the setting AUM_ShowUserProfileURLInVanityURL to the Host Settings table, setting the value to 'False'.  Refresh the site cache    -Expected Behaviour-  portal from test case 1 - vanity url does not change  portal from test case 2 - vanity url becomes example2.com/vanity-url  """

This should be possible considering you have all DNN versions software in archive, and you've defined export and import standards for all these versions. Also, a basic implementation could be the beginning, not taking into account multiple languages or site settings, which could then be added in later versions. title: "DNN styling checkboxes and file uploads and others?"
description: """DNN 7 added a 'feature' to automatically restyle every HTML checkbox in the style that DNN thinks it should look.  Same with the File Upload control, and likely others.    Please stop this.  It is never DNN's responsibility to assume anything about how I want my HTML controls styled.  Ever.  Furthermore, it is beyond ridiculous to assume that DNN could possibly know how this would affect the thousands of use cases and custom modules out there.      Yes, I know, you added a check for """".normalCheckBox"""" to prevent DNN from restyling the checkbox.  However, that is completely backwards.  I shouldn't have to add anything to my code to get the default appearance/behavior.  If anything, it should be the other way around and I would add a class to the checkbox if I wanted it styled according to what DNN thinks it should be.    Please fix this."""

title: "Do not throw ViewState MAC failure exception when user changes"
description: """DNN sets the {{ViewStateUserKey}} to the logged-in user's username.  However, when a page is loaded under one user, and then posted by another, there is an error shown.  The KB article [Resolving view state message authentication code (MAC) errors|http://support.microsoft.com/kb/2915218/en-us] states:  {quote}If your application uses the {{ViewStateUserKey}} property, verify that the property's value is the same both when view state is generated and when it is consumed. If you are using the current logged-in user's username, make sure that the user is still logged in and that the user's identity has not changed at the time of postback. If you are using the current user's session identifier, make sure that the session hasn't timed out.{quote}    I'm not entirely sure _how_ one would do that verification, but it appears that it should be possible to reduce or eliminate these errors.    h3. Steps to Reproduce  # While logged out, open the DNN login page in two tabs of the same browser  # Log in on one of the tabs  # Try to login on the other tab    h3. title: "Separate RecordCount and paged rows"
description: """Stored Procedure, which return paged rows from a query, currently return a 2nd recordset with total record count only. This is efficient, if the record count may be calculated with very little overhead, however, a number of stored procedures require exhaustive joins and calculations to determine the rows to return and this needs to be redone for recordcount a second time, which is performed for each page. Especially client side modules will need this number only once upon initial call and the calculation can be omitted for subsequent calls.   I suggest separating record count into a dedicated function, which should follow a naming convention like RecordCount_UsersAll to accompany GetUsersAll stored procedure (which returns records only)."""

title: "SI: Social Groups module Join button improvement"
description: """From Customer:     We are experiencing an issue using the Social Group module, on some groups, clicking the ‘Join’ button is taking some time to process, in the meantime, there is no indication to the user that anything is happening, so they end up clicking the button multiple times, resulting in numerous e-mails being sent to the group owner(s).  I looked into the code that drives this functionality, I noticed in the DotNetNuke.Modules.Groups. ModerationServiceController class there is a JoinGroup method which instantiates a Notification object and calls AddGroupOwnerNotification(). Inside AddGroupOwnerNotification(), the code loads every user in the group, and looks at whether they are the group owner, if so they are sent an e-mail. This is proving to take a long time on groups with a large number of users, since there is no feedback or disabling of the Join button when the user clicks it, for these larger groups, the users are getting confused as to whether or not their mouse click took, and continue to click it, causing one e-mail be sent to group owners for each click of the Join button.  To solve the issue temporarily, not wanting to change the DNN source code, we added some jQuery to the page that finds every Join button and adds an additional click event, which basically disables the button once the user clicks it and changes the text to ‘processing..’. This is fine for now, but ideally we would like to see the AddGroupOwnerNotification() method optimized to better handle larger groups, or perhaps similar jQuery can be added to at least give the user some feedback that their mouse click took. If it helps the jQuery we added to the page is:    jQuery(document).ready(function ($) {  $('li').find('*[id^=""""groupJoin-""""]').each(function () {  $(this).bind(""""click"""", function () {  // release the event handler that it won't fire again  $(this).unbind('click');  // remove underline  $(this).css('textDecoration','none')  // remove the 'href' attribute  $(this).removeAttr('href');  // change text so user knows something is happening  $(this).text('processing...');  });  });  });"""

title: "Stored Procedure CoreMessaging_AddSubscription unable to update values"
description: """stored procedure is missing a parameter to identify a subscription to update and uses a (not necessarily unique) combination of values, it tries to update.  this needs to be fixed as follows:  CREATE PROCEDURE {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}CoreMessaging_AddSubscription]   @SubscriptionId INT,   @UserId INT ,   @PortalId INT ,   @SubscriptionTypeId INT ,   @ObjectKey NVARCHAR(255) ,   @Description NVARCHAR(255),   @ModuleId INT ,   @TabId INT,   @ObjectData NVARCHAR(MAX)  AS   BEGIN      IF  Exists(SELECT @SubscriptionId FROM {databaseOwner}{objectQualifier}CoreMessaging_Subscriptions WHERE @SubscriptionId = SubscriptionId)     BEGIN     UPDATE  {databaseOwner}{objectQualifier}CoreMessaging_Subscriptions     SET     UserId = @UserId ,       PortalId = @PortalId ,       SubscriptionTypeId = @SubscriptionTypeId ,       ObjectKey = @ObjectKey ,       Description = @Description ,       ModuleId = @ModuleId ,       TabId = @TabId,       ObjectData = @ObjectData     WHERE   SubscriptionId = @SubscriptionId       SELECT  @SubscriptionId AS [SubscriptionId]    END   ELSE     BEGIN     INSERT  INTO {databaseOwner}{objectQualifier}CoreMessaging_Subscriptions          (UserId ,        PortalId ,        SubscriptionTypeId ,        ObjectKey ,        Description,        CreatedOnDate ,        ModuleId ,        TabId,        ObjectData)     VALUES     (@UserId ,        @PortalId ,        @SubscriptionTypeId ,        @ObjectKey ,        @Description,        GETUTCDATE() ,        @ModuleId ,        @TabId,        @ObjectData)       SELECT  SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS [SubscriptionId]    END  END  GO"""
input_text:
Title: Stored Procedure CoreMessaging_AddSubscription unable to update values
Description: ""stored procedure is missing a parameter to identify a subscription to update and uses a (not necessarily unique) combination of values, it tries to update. this needs to be fixed as follows: CREATE PROCEDURE {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}CoreMessaging_AddSubscription] @SubscriptionId INT, @UserId INT , @PortalId INT , @SubscriptionTypeId INT , @ObjectKey NVARCHAR(255) , @Description NVARCHAR(255), @ModuleId INT , @TabId INT, @ObjectData NVARCHAR(MAX) AS BEGIN IF Exists(SELECT @SubscriptionId FROM {databaseOwner}{objectQualifier}CoreMessaging_Subscriptions WHERE @SubscriptionId = SubscriptionId) BEGIN UPDATE {databaseOwner}{objectQualifier}CoreMessaging_Subscriptions SET UserId = @UserId , PortalId = @PortalId , SubscriptionTypeId = @SubscriptionTypeId , ObjectKey = @ObjectKey , Description = @Description , ModuleId = @ModuleId , TabId = @TabId, ObjectData = @ObjectData WHERE SubscriptionId = @SubscriptionId SELECT @SubscriptionId AS [SubscriptionId] END ELSE BEGIN INSERT INTO {databaseOwner}{objectQualifier}CoreMessaging_Subscriptions (UserId , PortalId , SubscriptionTypeId , ObjectKey , Description, CreatedOnDate , ModuleId , TabId, ObjectData) VALUES (@UserId , @PortalId , @SubscriptionTypeId , @ObjectKey , @Description, GETUTCDATE() , @ModuleId , @TabId, @ObjectData) SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS [SubscriptionId] END END GO""

title: "Unable to create Lucene writer (lock file is in use)."
description: """When search is used in a webfarm, and running on all servers, it will generate this error:    2013-10-31 00:08:19,635 [RD00155D4434BC][Thread:28][ERROR] DotNetNuke.Services.Exceptions.Exceptions - DotNetNuke.Services.Exceptions.BasePortalException: UrlCrawler - error occured , Error: Unable to create Lucene writer (lock file is in use). Please recycle AppPool in IIS to release lock. ---> DotNetNuke.Services.Exceptions.SearchException: Unable to create Lucene writer (lock file is in use). Please recycle AppPool in IIS to release lock. ---> System.IO.IOException: The process cannot access the file 'C:\Resources\Directory\Sites\root\DotNetNuke\App_Data\Search\write.lock' because it is being used by another process.  at System.IO.__Error.WinIOError(Int32 errorCode, String maybeFullPath)  at System.IO.File.InternalDelete(String path, Boolean checkHost)  at DotNetNuke.Services.Search.Internals.LuceneControllerImpl.get_Writer()  — End of inner exception stack trace —  at DotNetNuke.Services.Search.Internals.LuceneControllerImpl.get_Writer()  at DotNetNuke.Services.Search.Internals.LuceneControllerImpl.Delete(Query query)  at DotNetNuke.Services.Search.Internals.InternalSearchControllerImpl.DeleteAllDocuments(Int32 portalId, Int32 searchTypeId)  at DotNetNuke.Professional.SearchCrawler.Indexers.UrlIndexerImpl.DeleteOldDocsBeforeReindex(IEnumerable`1 portalsIncludedInUrls, Int32 scheduleId)  at DotNetNuke.Professional.SearchCrawler.Indexers.UrlIndexerImpl.IndexUrls(ScheduleHistoryItemsSettings settings)  at DotNetNuke.Professional.SearchCrawler.SearchSpider.SearchSpider.SpiderThread()  — End of inner exception stack trace —    Whilst we are able to fix this in our cloud environment (by running the crawler only on 1 server), I feel we should be able to fix this inherently in the code as well.    To me, it makes no sense to output this type of error, just because the lock file is present. THe fact that the lock file is present just means that we should stop the indexing with the current process, because another process (may be on another server) is currently locking the Lucene index. It should be logged in the scheduler history, with a message something like:    """"Unable to create Lucene writer (lock file is in use). stopping crawler because another process is already active. title: "Reduce css/minify css"
description: """Though in newer DNN versions we have client resourcemanagement, not everyone will/can use this. So it is always a good thing to minimize the number of CSS files in DNN. And it is also a good thing to minimize them.     When I use YSlow, it says the default.css is not minified. I think that is a bad thing...it such an easy thing to do, so I believe the DNN core download should have an optimized set of files by default, and not rely on people optimizing it themselves by using whatever technique available...    When I look at the /admin folder, there still are a lot of modules with individual module.css files. I think there is room for improvement there...    Also when I create a new portal, there is a portal.css file created which in most cases is not necessary, because people are going to use a skin anyway, and styles will be added/overidden in the skin.css file. So perhaps the portal.css should be added as an option rather then as a default."""

title: "Build a SAML Authentication Provider for DNN"
description: """We have several customers who are wanting AD/SSO integration with Cloud-based Solutions in Evoq Content and Evoq Social.    These conversations have come about after the customers have rejected the idea of extending/synchronising their AD into the Azure environment.  In at least two cases, the customers preferred way forward is to integrate with SAML based authentication.    My analysis on this leads to the conclusion we need a SAML based provider that will work with ADFS as well as other SAML based solutions - one customer is using SecureAuth as an Identity Service Provider wrapping their AD installation.    The intention is to have a SAML based provider built quickly and prototyped with an existing Cloud Proof-of-Concept site we already have provisioned.  This would be used to demonstrate to the customer that we can make an Evoq in the Cloud site work with with a SAML provider.  The actual SAML provider could then be included in a future release in the near future."""

title: "Child Site URL Issue on Localhost"
description: """In nearly all of our documentation, videos, WPI, etc. people in our ecosystem most often install DNN at localhost/dotnetnuke.  This is fine for just getting to know how it works in many cases.    If the user then tries to play with multi-tenancy, they may end up creating a child site.  This would make their new URL look like the following:    http://localhost/dotnetnuke/newsitename    Our URL rewriter does not know how to handle this.  The new site will not respond properly.    While this is not a production use case issue, it does give DNN a bad first impression when they first try to use multi-tenancy.  Small things like this are what can make a """"newbie"""" think and tell others that the feature doesn't work."""

title: "DotNetNuke.UI.Navigation.AddNode error"
description: """Upon upgrade of DNN to v 6.2.8, noticed some navigation items were targeting _new windows in hyperlinks.     Investigation revealed a logic bug on DotNetNuke.UI.Navigation.AddNode(), line 234 :  bool newWindow = false;                  if (objTab.TabSettings[""""LinkNewWindow""""] != null && Boolean.TryParse((string)objTab.TabSettings[""""LinkNewWindow""""], out newWindow))                  {                      objNode.Target = """"_new"""";                  }    The error is that the if condition evaluates whether the TryParse test has executed successfully, not the actual result of the TryParse.  Corrected code:  if (objTab.TabSettings[""""LinkNewWindow""""] != null)                   {                      bool newWindow = false;                      newWindow = Boolean.TryParse((string)objTab.TabSettings[""""LinkNewWindow""""], out newWindow);                      if (newWindow)                      {                          objNode.Target = """"_new"""";                      }                  }    The implications of this logic bug are that, whenever the Tab Setting LinkNewWindow exists, regardless of value, this condition evaluates true and DNNNode target member is assigned """"_new"""".  All tabs created since the upgrade to DNN 6.2.8 are getting this TabSetting by default with a value of false. This behaviour is what led me to mark this issue as Major Severity.   It would be nice also if DNN did not store DB records for default values; only create DB records where they differ from default. This would remove a lot of bloated TabSettings from the database, but that's slightly off-topic.    Additionally, I suspect this problem has not yet been reported because the Telerik RadMenu does not seem to exhibit this behaviour; it must ignore this property entirely. It only appears in our custom modules that use the DNNNode collections to construct navigation.    Unknown if this also affects DNN 7. We are running 6.2.8."""
input_text:
Title: DotNetNuke.UI.Navigation.AddNode error
Description: ""Upon upgrade of DNN to v 6.2.8, noticed some navigation items were targeting _new windows in hyperlinks. Investigation revealed a logic bug on DotNetNuke.UI.Navigation.AddNode(), line 234 : bool newWindow = false; if (objTab.TabSettings[""""LinkNewWindow""""] != null && Boolean.TryParse((string)objTab.TabSettings[""""LinkNewWindow""""], out newWindow)) { objNode.Target = """"_new""""; } The error is that the if condition evaluates whether the TryParse test has executed successfully, not the actual result of the TryParse. Corrected code: if (objTab.TabSettings[""""LinkNewWindow""""] != null) { bool newWindow = false; newWindow = Boolean.TryParse((string)objTab.TabSettings[""""LinkNewWindow""""], out newWindow); if (newWindow) { objNode.Target = """"_new""""; } } The implications of this logic bug are that, whenever the Tab Setting LinkNewWindow exists, regardless of value, this condition evaluates true and DNNNode target member is assigned """"_new"""". All tabs created since the upgrade to DNN 6.2.8 are getting this TabSetting by default with a value of false. This behaviour is what led me to mark this issue as Major Severity. It would be nice also if DNN did not store DB records for default values; only create DB records where they differ from default. This would remove a lot of bloated TabSettings from the database, but that's slightly off-topic. Additionally, I suspect this problem has not yet been reported because the Telerik RadMenu does not seem to exhibit this behaviour; it must ignore this property entirely. It only appears in our custom modules that use the DNNNode collections to construct navigation. Unknown if this also affects DNN 7. We are running 6.2.8.""

title: "Support InternalAliases setting for humanFriendly Provider"
description: """In the cloud platform we have detected that the WebRequestCaching provider is ending up in redirect loops when the Alias option of 'Redirect' is used.  This is because the requests to synchronise the cache are made using the machine name and these requests are redirected to use the primary portal alias.    The advanced url rewriter includes a feature to read a setting called 'internalAliases' in the Host Settings.  This is a delimited list of alias names for specific aliases which are for internal use, and will not be redirected when requested.    This functionality needs to be copied into the humanFriendly Url Rewriter so that a customer can switch between advanced and humanFriendly modes and keep using the same Caching Provider.     The Requirements are :  - upon load of the Url Rewriter, read the 'internalAliases' setting and parse the list into a collection of aliases  - for any requests, if the requested portal alias doesn't match the primary portal alias, take no action if the requested portal alias matches an alias in the internalAliases list    The settings name for the internalAliases collection is in the FriendlyUrlSettings.cs file.    Note that this change will also help DNN support reverse proxy implementations.    To Test  - create a site with two different portal aliases (ie domain.com and localhost)  - use the 'redirect' option for the primary portal alias  - set domain.com as the primary portal alias  - request the site on localhost - expected action is that it will redirect to domain.com  - add localhost to the internalAliases setting  - request the site on localhost - expected action is that it will continue normally. """

title: "SI: support Amazon ELB SSL Offloading"
description: """Amazon Elastic Load Balancing SSL Offloading uses 2 headers, that also contain data. Cathal did a bit of research on this and reported this:   http://harish11g.blogspot.co.uk/2012/03/ssl-offloading-elastic-load-balancing.htmlwas the clearest step by step guide, so it would appear that ELB supports ssl-offloading.   Obviously the header value has to be configured in DotNetNuke as well � that took a bit more searching and it seems that amazon use 2 header � seehttp://aws.typepad.com/aws/2010/10/keeping-customers-happy-another-new-elastic-load-balancer-feature.html . The problem here is that both header values always seem to contain data i.e �X-Forwarded-Proto� will contain http or https and �X-Forwarded-Port� will contain 80 or 443. This goes contrary to the behavior or basically every other network device where the existence of the header is sufficient to say that it was forwarded i.e. most simply add x-forwared-proto or x-forwarded with no data, and those such as F5 that allow custom headers don�t allow variant values.   Our ssl-offloaded solution checks for the existence of a header and does not evaluate it�s value � I believe this is why you can�t get it working. I see that Magento has a similar issue (http://www.aschroder.com/2012/07/magento-ssl-offloading-with-amazon-elb/) which suggests they used the same approach. That article has a hack where they�re setting an additional header in apache based on the protocol, and in theory we could do the same (or add code to a page to do the same), but I would recommend not using such a hack. As such ELB would not be supported by our ssl-offloading solution currently, if we want to support this we will need to enhance it to check for the existence of the header variable and (optionally) check for a value stored in that header variable   Furthermore, he comments:  If we want to support ELB (and potentially any others that use this non-standard scheme) we will have to enhance it, I would estimate around 10hrs effort (5 hrs dev, 4hrs QA, 1hr documentation update)."""

title: "Content Items are all Approved"
description: """Problem:  All content items (from the core API) are approved today. If a single module contains multiple pieces of content (2 or more content items displayed at a time in a list view to users) where some can be approved and others are not, there is no way to do this that works in all scenarios today. If a developer tries to handle the approval on their own (which is possible), anything linked to taxonomy/folksonomy (the content has a category or tag) can show up in places outside of the custom module that exposes taxonomy. To work around this, you would need to store the tags/categories separate until approved.      Sample:  In Social Answers, ask a question that is approved and another that is not approved (using a separate tag for each). The tag list displayed will show both tags, but clicking that tag results in 0 results.     Suggestion:  Add an Approved column to ContentItems, set the property to true by default and allow developers to override it on create/update (I believe the existing methods won't require overloads, they take the whole object).     Beyond just impacting the Content Item API (and it's sprocs), Search may index content items (not sure) as well as anything today in the system that returns content items based on tags or categories.     Something like Social can then upgrade the content items in upgrade situations (based on custom tables, per module and set to false where appropriate) and then also update any retrieval sprocs in custom modules so the additional approved column (in say Answers_Post) is no longer necessary)  """

title: "Language Editor Resource Tree does not show all relevant directories"
description: """There is a bug in the Language Editor code introduced in 7.1.2. The code intends to iterate through the site folder structure to find all Resource Directories. The top level directory nodes are statically created, but directories under these are identified dynamically.    The code however, will only iterate through the first directory tree in each branch. For example, under DesktopModules, the following Module folders will be found - Admin, AuthenticationServices, CoreMessaging, etc. Under each of these only the first listed branch is evaluated, to see if the node should be included.    For the Feedback module, there is also an App_Data directory, which appears before App_LocalResources. During evaluation, the code looks down the App_Data structure to find .resx files. When it finds none, it returns 'False' for the whole Feedback tree, so the Feedback module does not appear in the directory tree.    To replicate:-  - Install DNN CE 7.1.2  - Install DNN Feedback  6.4.3  - Navigate through Admin -> Languages -> edit language -> Local Resources -> DesktopModules  - Feedback does not appear in the list    Expected result is that Feedback -> App_LocalResources and relevant .resx files appear in the list."""

Pulled from http://www.chrishammond.com/blog/itemid/2636/after-upgrading-to-dnn-712-site-settings-doesnt.aspx Problem #1 During the upgrade process on 2 of 10 installs I upgraded tonight, the 07.01.02.sqldataprovider file had an error, the error gets logged into the Providers\DataProviders\SqlDataProvider folder in the 07.01.02.log.resources file. The error is System.Data.SqlClient.SqlException (0x80131904): Ambiguous column name 'ModuleId'. at System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection.OnError(SqlException exception, Boolean breakConnection, Action`1 wrapCloseInAction) at System.Data.SqlClient.SqlInternalConnection.OnError(SqlException exception, Boolean breakConnection, Action`1 wrapCloseInAction) at System.Data.SqlClient.TdsParser.ThrowExceptionAndWarning(TdsParserStateObject stateObj, Boolean callerHasConnectionLock, Boolean asyncClose) at System.Data.SqlClient.TdsParser.TryRun(RunBehavior runBehavior, SqlCommand cmdHandler, SqlDataReader dataStream, BulkCopySimpleResultSet bulkCopyHandler, TdsParserStateObject stateObj, Boolean& dataReady) at System.Data.SqlClient.SqlCommand.RunExecuteNonQueryTds(String methodName, Boolean async, Int32 timeout) at System.Data.SqlClient.SqlCommand.InternalExecuteNonQuery(TaskCompletionSource`1 completion, String methodName, Boolean sendToPipe, Int32 timeout, Boolean asyncWrite) at System.Data.SqlClient.SqlCommand.ExecuteNonQuery() at DotNetNuke.Data.SqlDataProvider.ExecuteScriptInternal(String connectionString, String script) ClientConnectionId:cc490fb3-5518-4ff4-bd9a-6e6aa00ca0d7 CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.[GetRecycleModules] @PortalID int AS SELECT OwnerPortalID, PortalID, vw_Modules.TabID, vw_Modules.TabModuleID, vw_Modules.ModuleID, ModuleDefID, vw_Modules.ModuleOrder, vw_Modules.PaneName, vw_Modules.ModuleTitle, vw_Modules.CacheTime, vw_Modules.CacheMethod, vw_Modules.Alignment, vw_Modules.Color, vw_Modules.Border, vw_Modules.IconFile, AllTabs, vw_Modules.Visibility, vw_Modules.IsDeleted, vw_Modules.Header, vw_Modules.Footer, StartDate, EndDate, vw_Modules.ContainerSrc, vw_Modules.DisplayTitle, vw_Modules.DisplayPrint, vw_Modules.DisplaySyndicate, vw_Modules.IsWebSlice, vw_Modules.WebSliceTitle, vw_Modules.WebSliceExpiryDate, vw_Modules.WebSliceTTL, InheritViewPermissions, IsShareable, IsShareableViewOnly, DesktopModuleID, DefaultCacheTime, ModuleControlID, BusinessControllerClass, IsAdmin, SupportedFeatures, ContentItemID, [Content], ContentTypeID, ContentKey, Indexed, StateID, vw_Modules.CreatedByUserID, vw_Modules.CreatedOnDate, LastContentModifiedOnDate, vw_Modules.UniqueId, vw_Modules.VersionGuid, vw_Modules.DefaultLanguageGuid, vw_Modules.LocalizedVersionGuid, vw_Modules.CultureCode, TabModules.LastModifiedByUserID, TabModules.LastModifiedOnDate FROM vw_Modules INNER JOIN TabModules ON vw_Modules.TabModuleID = TabModules.TabModuleID WHERE PortalId = @PortalID ORDER BY ModuleId Which in laymen's terms, is that the """"order by ModuleId"""" conflicts because SQL doesn't know which ModuleId to use. This is a fairly easy fix, you can run the following SQL in your favorite SQL query tool, or even the Host/SQL page of your DNN site. (if you are using a custom databaseOwner or objectQualifier in your web.config file, but sure to modify this SQL to match your database) IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dbo.sysobjects WHERE id = object_id(N'dbo.[GetRecycleModules]') AND OBJECTPROPERTY(id, N'IsPROCEDURE') = 1) DROP PROCEDURE dbo.[GetRecycleModules] GO CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.[GetRecycleModules] @PortalID int AS SELECT OwnerPortalID, PortalID, vw_Modules.TabID, vw_Modules.TabModuleID, vw_Modules.ModuleID, ModuleDefID, vw_Modules.ModuleOrder, vw_Modules.PaneName, vw_Modules.ModuleTitle, vw_Modules.CacheTime, vw_Modules.CacheMethod, vw_Modules.Alignment, vw_Modules.Color, vw_Modules.Border, vw_Modules.IconFile, AllTabs, vw_Modules.Visibility, vw_Modules.IsDeleted, vw_Modules.Header, vw_Modules.Footer, StartDate, EndDate, vw_Modules.ContainerSrc, vw_Modules.DisplayTitle, vw_Modules.DisplayPrint, vw_Modules.DisplaySyndicate, vw_Modules.IsWebSlice, vw_Modules.WebSliceTitle, vw_Modules.WebSliceExpiryDate, vw_Modules.WebSliceTTL, InheritViewPermissions, IsShareable, IsShareableViewOnly, DesktopModuleID, DefaultCacheTime, ModuleControlID, BusinessControllerClass, IsAdmin, SupportedFeatures, ContentItemID, [Content], ContentTypeID, ContentKey, Indexed, StateID, vw_Modules.CreatedByUserID, vw_Modules.CreatedOnDate, LastContentModifiedOnDate, vw_Modules.UniqueId, vw_Modules.VersionGuid, vw_Modules.DefaultLanguageGuid, vw_Modules.LocalizedVersionGuid, vw_Modules.CultureCode, TabModules.LastModifiedByUserID, TabModules.LastModifiedOnDate FROM vw_Modules INNER JOIN TabModules ON vw_Modules.TabModuleID = TabModules.TabModuleID WHERE PortalId = @PortalID ORDER BY vw_modules.ModuleId /* update GetPortalsByUser Procedure */ /*************************************/ IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.[GetPortalsByUser]') AND type in (N'P', N'PC')) DROP PROCEDURE dbo.[GetPortalsByUser] GO CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.[GetPortalsByUser] @userID int AS SELECT dbo.vw_Portals.* FROM dbo.UserPortals INNER JOIN dbo.vw_Portals ON dbo.UserPortals.PortalId = dbo.vw_Portals.PortalID WHERE (dbo.UserPortals.UserId = @userID) AND (dbo.vw_Portals.DefaultLanguage = dbo.vw_Portals.CultureCode) GO /************************************************************/ /***** SqlDataProvider *****/ /************************************************************/ So that addresses problem #1, fixing the SQL script for DNN 7.1.2 that failed to run successfully.""

title: "Redirect URL on login should not include child alias"
description: """h2. The scenario:    * Site Aliases  ** SiteAlias Mapping Mode: _Canonical_  ** Auto Add Site Alias: _False_  ** Aliases:  *** _(Primary) {{secure.example.org/sports}}_  *** _{{sports.example.com}}_  * SSL Settings  ** SSL Enabled: _True_  ** SSL Enforced: _False_  ** SSL URL: _{{secure.example.org/sports}}_  ** Standard URL:  _{{sports.example.com}}_    The redirect after login/registration settings are _not_ set.  There is a custom login page (called Account Login), set as Secure.    h2. Steps to reproduce:  # While logged out, navigate to a page via the non-SSL alias, which requires logging in (e.g. {{http://sports.example.com/Admin}})  # Redirected to {{https://secure.example.org/sports/Account-Login?returnurl=%2fAdmin}}  # Log in with a user who has access to the Admin page    h2. Actual Results:  # After login, redirected to {{https://secure.example.org/Admin}} (which is not a valid alias for the site)  ** _Make sure that you have auto-add turned off, or this will attempt to add an {{Admin}} alias, which will mess up the core's admin directory_    h2. Expected Results:  # After login, redirected to {{https://secure.example.org/sports/Admin}}    Because there are two redirects going on (from insecure to SSL, and via {{returnurl}} parameter), the target of the redirection is lost.  I propose that the {{returnurl}} parameter should not include the child alias, but should be relative to the current site (i.e. {{returnurl=%2fAdmin}} should work whether the site is on a child alias or a parent alias).    Alternatively, the SSL redirect could notice that it's doing a redirect from parent to child while there's a {{returnurl}} query-string parameter, but that seems much more complicated, and only fixes this one place. Actual Results: # After login, redirected to {{https://secure.example.org/Admin}} (which is not a valid alias for the site) ** _Make sure that you have auto-add turned off, or this will attempt to add an {{Admin}} alias, which will mess up the core's admin directory_ h2. Expected Results: # After login, redirected to {{https://secure.example.org/sports/Admin}} Because there are two redirects going on (from insecure to SSL, and via {{returnurl}} parameter), the target of the redirection is lost. I propose that the {{returnurl}} parameter should not include the child alias, but should be relative to the current site (i.e. {{returnurl=%2fAdmin}} should work whether the site is on a child alias or a parent alias). Alternatively, the SSL redirect could notice that it's doing a redirect from parent to child while there's a {{returnurl}} query-string parameter, but that seems much more complicated, and only fixes this one place. It's quite possible there are other places (default alias redirect?) that would do a similar redirect, as well.""

title: "custom user profile properties sometimes are case sensitive, sometimes not"
description: """At some points the user profile properties are case sensitive (so you absolutely need to get it correct), at others they are not.    If you delete a property and create one with the same name but with other upper/lower case characters, a property with the original name is created.    The use case: there is a web-service which adds a property ABC, you accidentatlly create a property called aBC. You can not fix this in the user interface.    When you delete aBC and create a new property ABC, a property aBC is created (restored?) instead.  Although a property is case sensitive, you can not create a second property with the same name but other capitals. When you create a property with the exact same name (which I would have expected to result in a """"already exists""""-error), you update the existing property. The second page with the localised name, has the name already filled in, so you might notice you're updating, not creating.    When you create a property with the same name, but other capitals (again I would have expected an error, or at least a warning that a similar named property exists), the page with localised name is empty, as if you're creating a new property, but you still overwrite the existing property (except it's name).    It seems that the check whether a property name exists is case insensitive, while when accessing the property, then name is case sensitive.    BTW: Why can't you change the property name afterwards??    IMHO property names should be case insensitive. Case sensitivity was something we needed to do when bytes and megahertzes were scarce. You won't have a property 'Name' meaning something else then a property 'name'. Capitals are only for human readability / style, they should not have a meaning."""

title: "Secondary Fallback for language resources"
description: """When you install a new language you can define what is the fallback language. We have two different scenarios:    - fallback language as english:    Example: language Spanish - Spain, fallback: English - USA  on the new language, when a resource is not found, the system looks in the default english resources for it. No problem here.    - fallback language different of english:    Example: language Spanish - Mexico, fallback: Spanish - Spain  language Spanish - Spain, fallback: English - USA  on the new language, when a resources is not found, it will look for the same resource in the fallback language, in this case Spanish - Spain.  If it's not found there, it either fails with an error or returns a blank string.  It would be desirable that in this case the system, again, reverted back to the english (system) default as in the previous case.    Risks:  - verify is the extra round trip to look for resources can be a perf problem  - we could limit the fallback chain to just 2 levels   """

title: "CAPTCHA image issues in IE9, IE10"
description: """Add http header <add name=""""X-Content-Type-Options"""" value=""""nosniff"""" />.   Please refer to OWASP security guidelines for http header here:  https://www.owasp.org/index.php/List_of_useful_HTTP_headers    CAPTCHA image urls don't have a file type like .jpg/.png so the browser must rely on the Content-Type header or else must sniff the image file to guess its file type. The Content-Type in this case is text/html which probably causes IE to stop showing the image. This behaviour doesn't effect Firefox and Chrome browsers.    """

title: "Disable ASP.NET ViewState when not used"
description: """As an enhancement to our products, we should strive for better performance. One area which can add a lot to this is the notorious VIEWSTATE in ASP.NET which is enabled by default.    As an example, I measured the size of the __VIEWSTATE hidden input on the  blogs list view page turned out to be *over 40 KB*. Just by disabling the VIEWSTATE in two lists repeaters on this page by adding *EnableViewState=""""False""""*, as this:   the size jumped down to *less than 17 KB* - a very huge saving in bandwidth.    IMO, it is a very good practice to disable the VIEWSTATE for all ASP.NET controls that contain no user input in them and does not need this state. I found that the VIEWSTATE on this customer's pages is *over 300 KB* while the whole page is *less than 580 KB* - the state is about 52% of the total received data. For example:  \Portals\_default\Skins\_default\WebControlSkin\Default\   contains CSS files that reskin the """"Default"""" theme for various Telerik controls (and quite poorly I might add). title: "Cannot specify current Site Alias as Primary"
description: """In Site Settings you  may specify redirect to primary alias, but the currently used alias cannot be edited, i.e. selected as alias. If the other aliases are currently not accessible, there is no chance to set proper alias as primary.    Suggestion: when switching from non to canonical or redirect, auto-select alias being used by current user as alias. this might be edited inside edit alias, but there needs to be a warning, that specifying an invalid alias may result in an inaccessible site."""

title: "Never Default Admin or Host page as parent page when creating new page"
description: """A common mistake that gets made is that a person installs an extension or goes to the admin/host areas in general, and then creates a new page using the 'Add New Page' functionality.    When doing so, the default parent page is set to the admin or host, depending on what is the current parent.    While this makes sense to set the parent when adding a page in the general content are of the site, I believe it causes confusion withing ordinary users because they create their new pages, which do then not appear in the menu.    After analysing the data from the DNN Trials environment, I found 77 instances of new pages created under the 'host' menu, and 186 instances of new pages created under the Admin menu.  Only a couple of these pages seemed to be named in a manner consistent with creating a new admin menu.    To fix this usability issue, any new page created while the user is currently in the 'host' or 'admin' menus should have the parent page set to 'None', so that the new page will be created at the root of the site.  This is the same behaviour when creating a page from the home page.    The test to clear out the default parent page is when the current page has either host or admin as the parent page, when the new page is being created.    Note that this does not restrict a user from creating a new page under the host / admin menu, but reverses the default so that they will have to explicitly set the parent to host or admin in order to do so."""

Error message:  Message: DotNetNuke.Services.Exceptions.PageLoadException: Input string was not in a correct format. ---> System.FormatException: Input string was not in a correct format. at System.Number.StringToNumber(String str, NumberStyles options, NumberBuffer& number, NumberFormatInfo info, Boolean parseDecimal) at System.Number.ParseInt32(String s, NumberStyles style, NumberFormatInfo info) at DotNetNuke.Modules.Admin.Extensions.EditExtension.get_PackageID() at DotNetNuke.Modules.Admin.Extensions.EditExtension.get_Package() at DotNetNuke.Modules.Admin.Extensions.EditExtension.BindData() at System.Web.UI.Control.LoadRecursive() at System.Web.UI.Control.LoadRecursive() at System.Web.UI.Control.LoadRecursive() at System.Web.UI.Control.LoadRecursive() at System.Web.UI.Control.LoadRecursive() at System.Web.UI.Control.LoadRecursive() at System.Web.UI.Control.LoadRecursive() at System.Web.UI.Control.LoadRecursive() at System.Web.UI.Control.LoadRecursive() at System.Web.UI.Control.LoadRecursive() at System.Web.UI.Control.LoadRecursive() at System.Web.UI.Page.ProcessRequestMain(Boolean includeStagesBeforeAsyncPoint, Boolean includeStagesAfterAsyncPoint) --- End of inner exception stack trace ---    The issue is that the Extension editor ( /DesktopModules/Admin/Extension.EditExtension.cs Line 105 )  is looking for """"PackageID"""" (case sensitive)    public int PackageID          {              get              {                  var packageID = Null.NullInteger;                  if ((Request.QueryString[""""PackageID""""] != null))                  {                      packageID = Int32.Parse(Request.QueryString[""""PackageID""""]);                  }                  return packageID;              }          }    Two possible solutions:  1) As a general rule, it's probably more robust to have every DNN system generated querystring parameter in lower case.  This way, even if the portal is not forcing lower case, it will still work in either mode.  In this specific case, the hyperlink to edit Extension should be changed to use all lowercase querystring parameters and the code in EditExtension.cs should look for lower case querystring parameters.    2) The easy workaround is to add the following to the AUM_ForceLowerCase setting:    '/Host/Extensions/'    SQL:  insert into  {databaseOwner} {objectQualifier}HostSettings  (SettingName, SettingValue, SettingIsSecure)  values ('AUM_ForceLowerCase', '/Host/Extensions/', false)      As an aside, the AUM_ForceLowerCase is really a misnomer as it actually prevents lower case. This should probably be called """"AUM_PreventLowerCase"""" or """"AUM_IgnoreForceLowerCase"""""""

title: "Web API routes regex matches are case sensitive in URLExtension provider"
description: """""""/DesktopModules/.+/API"""" regex matches in URLExtension provider are case sensitive. This results in invalid behavior when Web API is accessed by url that has other case. See attachment for details.    I think match have to be case insensitive since it can influence existing clients who access API by lowercase paths. title: "Search API WebFarm Compatibility -  Lucene Scheduled Flush Job"
description: """In order to provide better consistency of the Index in a web farm scenario we need to break Indexing job in two phases: 1) We should not durectly update Index when someone adds content to Index by calling the API SearchController.Instance.Add. 2) Instead we should store the serialized object SearchDocument in a table in database 3) We should write a scheduled task (to be run every 1 minute) to flush the data from the database into Lucene Index. 4) This will ensure that only one thread / agent is performing Write operation on the index and likelihood of Index corruption will be minimal. 5) This job will be similar to Purge Module Cache Buffer we have in system - A very well known pattern in DNN."""

description: """Scenario: There are 45 documents in Lucene (could be modules / pages / docs). They all have the same word, e.g. George. However, the user has view permission on only 5, and suppose these are found on second page (based on ranking) if search is performed as Host. Regardless if user has permission to see the content or not, we always include 'about xx records' as the total hit. For e.g. if Host does the search, he/she will find 45 hits and total count shown in UI will be 45. However, when a typical user does the same search, it will find only 5 hits (based on security) but indicate about 45 records found. I think this is misleading. With security trimming we'll never be accurate as accuracy will result in perf degradation, but we should try to little bit more closer to reality. Given the current collector model for security triming we should be able to exclude the number of records rejected from the total. We should have unit tests to support the above. title: "search  site crawler  module indexer  optimization  LastContentModifiedDate"
description: """Note from CTO: In the core there is a notion of a LastContentModifiedDate for a module. This property is supposed to let the core know of the last date/time that a module modified its content. It has value in a variety of scenarios – including search indexing. The way it is called today I believe is when a module calls SynchronizeContent – which tells the core to expire its module output cache, etc… In the case of search, when the indexer spins through the modules, it should be able to look at this property to determine if it needs to index the content. This would save the additional processing of using reflection to dynamically call the modules GetSearchItems method – only to get back an empty result set if the content has not changed ( which can be a big performance issue, as everytime the GetSearchItems is called the module is internally hitting the database to retrieve the relevant content ). So I would like to find out if we are using this technique. And I realize that not all modules implement LastContentModifiedDate – those that do not would have a value of NULL in this property – which means that in these cases the search indexer would HAVE to call GetSearchItems – but for those that actually do implement it ( ie. Html/Text ) it would produce very good performance benefits."""

title: "Enhancement request: List of modules should not disappear upon hovering over control panel"
description: """This is an enhancement request for 7.0.1 or a later release.   In 7.0, we have an awesome new control panel called the Control Bar. Currently, when the user clicks on """"Add a module"""", a list of modules is loaded (without a server request) and displayed horizontally, from where modules can be dragged and dropped. However, as soon the user hovers over an item in the control panel, the list of modules disappears. That is, as soon as the user hovers over Host or Admin in the control panel, that menu is displayed and list of modules (which did take some time to load) disappears. This is not the best user experience.    While using and testing 7.0, I found myself wanting this list of modules to remain open/displayed while I browsed other items in the control panel. I wanted this list of modules to remain open while I hovered upon the Host menu items, the Admin menu items and other items in the control panel. I don't mind if the list of modules disappears as soon as I click on an item on the control panel but not while I am hovering over items in the control panel or hovering over menus in the control panel.   Ease of implementation: The list of modules will not disappear upon mouse hovering over a control panel item but will wait till an item is clicked before disappearing. The control panel menus (host, admin, tools etc) can be displayed above the list of modules. This should be quite easy to implement and test. Clicking on a control panel item causes a redirect to a new page anyways, so the only thing to implement here is to NOT hide the list of modules upon a mouse_hover event.   Note: This should not change behavior of other control panel menus. For all other control panel menus (Admin menu, host menu etc), hovering over other items closes the current menu. That is, hovering over Host closes the Admin menu. This is great and should work the way it is. This enhancement applies only to """"Add New Module"""" and """"Add Existing Module"""" options in the Modules menu of the Control Bar."""

title: "Enhancement request: Manually closing popups does not need to refresh the page"
description: """Enhancement request for 7.1 release or later. Not an enhancement request for the current 7.0 release.   Throughout our website, we use popups to accomplish a variety of tasks and workflows. After the popup is displayed, the user either goes ahead with the task (edit content, deploy module, deploy language pack etc.) but there are also many times when the user just closes the popup by manually clicking on the X button on the top-right corner of the popup. When the user closes the popup manually, the popup disappears and then it also refreshes the page underneath. This is an overkill. When the user actually performed an action in the popup, refreshing the page underneath makes sense. But if he just manually closes the popup, there is no need to refresh the page underneath. We should just close the popup on the client side.        Ease of implementation: Very easy to implement. Virtually no testing needed.                Impact: Big improvment in terms of usability. My guess is that almost half of the popups that are rendered/displayed are manually closed without performing an action. This enhancement would improve the """"perceived performance"""" in the user's mind. It would reduce unnecessary roundtrips to the server.  It would increase the usability score of the product.                Use case: User wants to deploy some freely available forge modules. User goes to Host -> Extensions -> More extensions and searches for a product (say Blogs). User then sorts the matching search results. User then explores his first free option and gets a popup. User is done exploring this option and closes the popup to explore the second option. But the page gets refreshed. Now user has to search for the product again and then sort the search results again. This is very drainig and not an acceptable user experience at all. Amazon.com and Bestbuy.com would lose all business if this happened on their websites. Why does our store allow this?"""
